Vous êtes passionné(e) par les soins infirmiers et souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dynamique et bienveillante ? Technician in Biogeosciences 50% (f/m/d)
========================================



















Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL  









The Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL is part of the ETH Domain. Approximately 600 people work on the sustainable use and protection of the environment and on the handling of natural hazards.



The Research Unit Forest and Soil Ecology assesses the impact of climate change and management on forests and their soils. The group Critical Zone dynamics is offering a **two\-year position** as



Technician in Biogeosciences 50% (f/m/d)
========================================



You will work within the recently funded SNSF project FIRE ("Fire Impacts on the Response of terrestrial Ecosystems"). This project investigates how wildfires affect carbon cycling and transit times at the landscape scale, particularly in the deeper unsaturated zone and in groundwater, and over longer periods of time. You will be part of an interdisciplinary team of collaborators based in Switzerland and the USA, and support the team in conducting geochemical analysis (particularly radiocarbon) on environmental samples from recently burned landscapes in the USA. Your main tasks will involve preparation of a range of sample types (gaseous, aqueous, and solid) for stable carbon isotope and radiocarbon analysis. This will be done in collaboration with our partners at the Laboratory for Beam Physics at ETH Zurich, where you will also frequently work. Processing of samples for other types of analysis, e.g., major ion concentrations, general chemistry, will also be part of your duties. You will support and train a PhD candidate and guests from our partner universities in the USA in laboratory procedures. Moreover, you will also assist the team with administrative and logistical duties, e.g., the shipping of samples and materials to and from field sites in the USA.





You preferably hold a Master's degree in environmental or earth sciences or related disciplines, and have demonstrated experience with mass spectrometric methods for geochemical analysis and/or radiocarbon methods. You are familiar with laboratory work, enjoy contributing to methodological advancements, and are interested in interdisciplinary and international research. You are able to work independently, are structured and accurate, communicative and team\-oriented. You have very good written and spoken English language skills. You will be part of a vibrant research group and an international team of leading researchers in biogeosciences, paleoclimatology, and terrestrial geochemistry. The position is based at WSL and initially fixed to two years with the option for prolongation for\- additional two years.



Please send your complete application to Pe, Human Resources WSL, by uploading the requested documents through our webpage. Review of the applications will begin on October 22, 2026\. Applications via email will not be considered. Lechleitner, , will be happy to answer any questions or offer further information. WSL is committed to diversity and inclusion as core values. We actively promote gender equality and foster an open, inclusive work environment.

jobs.description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Illnau-Effretikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Gruppenleitung.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Illnau-Effretikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Gruppenleitung

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Illnau-Effretikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Illnau-Effretikon liegt in der Zürcher Landschaft und bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Arbeitsumgebung mit guter Infrastruktur. Die Region ist dank der S-Bahn-Anbindung schnell mit Zürich verbunden und besticht durch ihre Nähe zu Natur und Erholungsräumen. Zahlreiche etablierte Unternehmen haben sich hier angesiedelt, was ein vielfältiges Angebot an Arbeitsstellen schafft. Sie profitieren von günstigen Mieten gegenüber der Stadt, während Sie gleichzeitig urban erreichbar bleiben.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Gruppenleitung

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
In der Region Illnau-Effretikon besteht eine konstant hohe Nachfrage nach erfahrenen Pflegefachpersonen mit Gruppenleitungsfunktion, da Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich knapp sind. Mit Ihrer Qualifikation auf HF/FH-Niveau eröffnen sich Ihnen ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem lokalen Arbeitsmarkt, insbesondere in Alters- und Pflegeheimen sowie Spitälern. iPersonal vereinfacht Ihren Einstieg durch spezialisierte Vermittlung, fundierte Kenntnisse des regionalen Marktes und die Begleitung beim Bewerbungsprozess, sodass Sie schnell eine passende Führungsposition finden.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Illnau-Effretikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie auf med-ipersonal.ch – täglich aktualisiert.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

- Bewerben Sie sich deshalb jetzt als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Illnau-Effretikon. Wir vermitteln schnell und persönlich, denn gute Fachkräfte verdienen ebenso gute Partner.

jobs.title: Safeguarding and Ethical Leadership Coordinator for MSF Boards and Associations
jobs.description:
SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE
The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, and associative spaces free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB
The Safeguarding and Ethical Leadership Coordinator for Boards and Associations supports the implementation, operationalisation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of MSF’s safeguarding work with boards and associations across the MSF movement. This reflects the International Board’s commitment to minimum standards for safeguarding in associative networks.

The role:
leads coordination and implementation efforts that translate safeguarding principles, commitments, policies, and standards into practical, measurable, consistent, coherent, and sustainable safeguarding practices across MSF’s boards and associative structures.

advances safeguarding culture change by supporting MSF boards in understanding their role in safeguarding leadership and oversight; and by supporting the development of robust safeguarding understanding and putting in place safeguarding measures within associative structures and associations.

contributes to strengthening prevention, detection, reporting, response to safeguarding cases.

promotes accountability and institutional learning on safeguarding across the MSF movement.

ACCOUNTABILITIES
Coordination, design, and implementation :
Lead the coordination, implementation, and training on the ELMS, as well as on safeguarding, and other ethics principles within MSF boards.
Translate safeguarding and ELMS concepts into actionable documents, processes, and initiatives for MSF boards associations/networks in line with existing MSF initiatives on safeguarding.
Develop implementation guidance, tools, frameworks, templates, and operational resources.

Key Accountabilities :
Safeguarding ambitions are translated into practical implementation plans and deliverables.
Implementation progress is systematically tracked, monitored, and reported.
Approaches, tools, trainings, and guidance are developed and used by relevant stakeholders.

Drive safeguarding culture change :
Drive integration of safeguarding as a core organizational practice across MSF boards and associations.
Strengthen safeguarding accountability and leadership engagement, and ownership.
Other tasks assigned by the ISC or the International President or their delegate.

Lead monitoring, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement on Safeguarding and Ethical Governance :
Monitor implementation progress, identify risks and gaps, and drive corrective and improvement actions where needed.
Analyze ELMS and safeguarding implementation, challenges, and lessons learned to inform strategic decision-making.
Produce implementation reports, dashboards, briefing papers, presentations, and governance updates.
Lead learning and knowledge-sharing initiatives related to safeguarding and ELMS implementation and best practices.

Key Accountabilities :
Safeguarding is embedded into MSF associations and boards’ ways of working.
Safeguarding considerations are integrated into associative and boards’ processes.
Organisational awareness and ownership of safeguarding responsibilities is increased across the MSF associations and boards.

Coordinate the framework and response to ELMS and safeguarding complaints involving senior leadership :
Ensure relevant frameworks and processes relating to triage, case management, investigation, and decision-making are implemented for ELMS and safeguarding complaints involving senior leadership (the incumbent will not engage, case management, investigations or decision-making directly, but rather ensure it is in place).
Reception, and coordination, initial review and assessment of safeguarding and ELMs allegations involving senior leadership (i.e. General Directors and board members). Ensure a decision-making panel is formed for ELMS-related complaints, and ensure their decision is reported to the International Board.

Key Accountabilities :
Ensure that ELMs related complaints are properly assigned to relevant experts for case management/investigation.
Ensure a decision-making panel is formed for safeguarding or ELMs-related complaints, and ensure their decision is reported to the International Board.

AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY
The role is responsible under the technical supervision of the ISC and the hierarchical supervision of the International President (or the IP’s delegate). The role will coordinate closely with:
the Board Strengthening Programme concerning board training and direct board support activities with respect to safeguarding and ELMS implementation.
the International Associative Team to ensure appropriate association support and training activities with respect to safeguarding.
the ILD to ensure legal risks and statutory requirements are duly considered.

The role uses subject matter expertise, analysis, independent judgement and translates safeguarding, and ethical governance initiatives (such as the Ethical Leadership and Minimum Standards), and other safeguarding initiatives and concepts into relatable, understood, actionable documents, trainings, and actionable initiatives that support to ensure all parts of MSF have a robust understanding of, and structures that support safeguarding.

The role needs a strong understanding of, safeguarding policies, codes of conducts-including ethical governance principles, and how to draft them for associations (non-staff), alongside an understanding of the role of trustees and Boards as oversight for safeguarding.

The incumbent will also need to understand case management and administrative investigations to be able to explain these concepts and how they relate to oversight and associations.

The incumbent will also need to have good understanding of confidentiality, and act with the utmost discretion, when following up, and arranging that safeguarding and ELMs complaints involving senior leadership are properly and promptly addressed.

Job requirements
Education
A master's degree in relevant field such as law, human rights, administration etc. Or a bachelor's degree combined with significant relevant experience in safeguarding, governance of non-profits.

Experience
A minimum of 5 years implementing safeguarding initiatives, especially with boards.
Strong understanding of case management and administrative investigations in a workplace setting and principles guiding case management and ability to explain these concepts.
Experience working with or as a board member for a non-profit organization.
Experience drafting key safeguarding documents.
Experience in designing and delivering safeguarding training.
MSF experience is an asset.

Knowledge / Skills :
Strong understanding of safeguarding, conflicts of interest and the role of a trustee/governance of non-profit organisations.
Ability to draft appropriate and relevant safeguarding standards/documents and to translate complex concepts into clear actions.
Ability to coordinate and work with a range of stakeholders in a consultative, diplomatic fashion.
Strong writing skills and ability to communicate safeguarding concepts simply to a range of audiences.
A strong understanding of monitoring and evaluation.
Demonstrated experience in coordinating or overseeing highly sensitive cases involving senior leadership; receiving and appropriately triaging sensitive allegations; governance and due-process principles; management of conflicts of interest and recusal; commissioning and oversight of independent investigations; confidentiality, secure information management and data protection; whistleblowing and retaliation considerations; and the ability to navigate complex situations involving boards, senior executives, safeguarding and legal functions.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex implementation and coordination initiatives across diverse stakeholders.
Ability to influence organisational change in multicultural environments.
Strong strategic coordination and implementation management skills.
Perseverance and ability to build consensus.
Independence of judgement and the ability to challenge senior stakeholders, when necessary, alongside diplomacy and consensus-building.
Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and follow-through across multiple workstreams.
Ability to navigate sensitive safeguarding issues with discretion, diplomacy, and sound judgement.
Cross cultural awareness and strong commitment to and understanding of diversity, equity, and inclusion principles.

Languages :
English, other languages are an asset, especially French and Spanish.

Other :
Motivation to work in a humanitarian organisation and a fast paced, dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Resilience & Crisis Management Researcher
jobs.description:
Einleitungstext
The Center for Security Studies (CSS) at ETH Zurich is a center of competence for Swiss and international security policy. It offers security policy expertise in research, teaching, and consultancy.

Projekthintergrund
The Think Tank of the CSS serves as a link between researchers and practitioners in the field of security policy and as a point of contact and reference for the wider public.

The Resilience and Crisis Management Team as part of the CSS Think Tank conducts research and provides policy consulting on a range of fields relating to risks and strategies to prevent, prepare, or respond to disasters and emergencies. The focus is on (a) risks (e.g., changes in the risk landscape, methods for risk assessments, natural hazards); (b) civil protection and crisis management including CBRN (e.g., processes and structures, adaptations, use of new technologies and approaches); (c) societal and socio-technical resilience (e.g., individual disaster preparedness, issues related to critical infrastructure).

Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
As a researcher in the Resilience and Crisis Management Team, you focus on the issue areas outlined and related topics. Depending on your expertise and interests, you will build specialised knowledge and insights and help Swiss authorities address specific challenges. This also includes proactive engagement with different stakeholders, providing on-demand comprehensive policy advice, and presenting your expertise and knowledge clearly and concisely.
You will publish your findings in policy-relevant publications and disseminate your knowledge through dialogue with policymakers and other relevant stakeholders.
Ideally, you would be able to join as soon as possible.

Ihr Profil
At a minimum, you should have a MA/MSc degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. Political Science, Risk Analysis, Resilience, Crisis and Disaster Management, Security Studies, Public Policy or Environmental Sciences). Recent MA graduates are encouraged to apply. We are particularly looking for researchers who have experience and/or interest in one or more of the following research topics: (a) natural hazards and disaster risk reduction; (b) socio-technical resilience; (c) anticipation and risk analysis methods as well as risk communication. An independent, well-organised working style, along with excellent communication skills and the ability to work in an international team are essential.

The CSS is a multilingual working environment, so proficiency in English is required. Knowledge of one Swiss national language – or the willingness to acquire German language skills on the job – is an asset. Work experience in relevant international organisations, think tanks, or government agencies is an advantage, as is knowledge of the Swiss political landscape.

Wir bieten
We offer the opportunity to apply and develop research skills for resilience and crisis management topics, within the environment of a university-based think tank working on security and peace issues.
The term for the appointment is for two years, with the option of extension if there is funding and if there is mutual agreement to continue the cooperation.  
We offer a workplace in the centre of Zurich with attractive working conditions. Further training and the ability to conduct applied research, publish the results in different formats and provide your own process support related to peace mediation are part of the career development and are central elements of our personnel policy.

Neugierig? Sind wir auch.
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

CV
Letter of interest explaining the skills and motivation you would bring to the position
One to two single-authored writing samples (e.g. an academic article, policy brief, or thesis chapter – can be a draft version)
Two references to be approached (in case you are invited to an interview).

Approximately 80% of your time will be directly related to investor engagement and capital raising: identifying prospective investors, developing relationships, presenting the Copenhagen Atomics investment case, managing fundraising processes and helping bring investment discussions to a successful close.

Was einst mit wiederverwendbaren Putztüchern begann, hat sich zu einer international erfolgreichen Unternehmensgruppe mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden und Standorten in ganz Europa entwickelt. Gleichzeitig bietet MEWA ein modernes, stabiles Umfeld mit klaren Strukturen, hoher Kundenorientierung und langfristiger Perspektive.







Im Zuge des weiteren Wachstums suchen wir im **exklusiven Mandatsauftrag** eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die gemeinsam mit einem starken Team den Schweizer Markt aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln möchte.

Du hast Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, gehst offen auf andere zu und schaffst es, mit deiner sympathischen Interesse zu wecken? Dann bietet dir diese Position die ideale Möglichkeit, in den Vertrieb einzusteigen und dich langfristig weiterzuentwickeln – **auch als Quereinstieg möglich.**







Als wichtige Unterstützung des Account Managers bist du die erste Ansprechperson für potenzielle Neukunden und legst den Grundstein für erfolgreiche Geschäftsbeziehungen. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du bei der Planung der Kundenbesuche und sorgst dafür, dass Verkaufsaktivitäten optimal vorbereitet sind. Darüber hinaus recherchierst du neue potenzielle Kunden, erweiterst die bestehende Datenbank und trägst aktiv dazu bei, neue Marktpotenziale zu erschliessen. Mit deinem Gespür für Menschen, deiner Hartnäckigkeit und deiner positiven leistest du einen direkten Beitrag zum Vertriebserfolg.







**Dein Profil**



* Freude am Telefonieren und am aktiven Austausch mit Menschen
* Kommunikationsstarke, offene und sympathische Persönlichkeit

* Freude daran, neue Kontakte aufzubauen und Chancen zu erkennen
* Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, ösischkenntnisse von Vorteil






**Deine Benefits**



Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung und einem hohen Mass an Flexibilität. Du arbeitest vollständig aus dem Homeoffice und profitierst gleichzeitig von den Strukturen, der Stabilität und den Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten eines erfolgreichen Unternehmens. Neben einem Fixlohn profitierst du von einem leistungsorientierten Provisionsmodell mit entsprechendem Verdienstpotenzial und überdurchschnittlichen Sozialleistungen. Für deinen Homeoffice\-Arbeitsplatz wird Dir ein Laptop sowie ein Headset zur Verfügung gestellt. Lead Chemical Process R\&D Scientist
====================================







**Lead Chemical Process R\&D Scientist:** **Pharmaceutical Chemical Process/ chemical drawing tools / R\&D / CDMO / Design of Experiments / Synthetic Organic Chemistry / Leadership \& Project Management / Manufacturing / GMP**/ **English / Deutsch**



  **Background:**



In this function you will lead chemical process R\&D activities to deliver safe, scalable, efficient and sustainable processes as well as drug substance material for projects in clinical development, with a focus on late\-stage development, leveraging internal and external CDMO capabilities.



  



  **The Perfect Candidate:**



The ideal candidate is a PhD/PostDoc\-level organic chemist with 5\+ years of pharmaceutical R\&D experience specializing in late\-stage process optimization and scale\-up. They bring demonstrated leadership in guiding internal project teams and managing CDMO operations, technical transfers, and material supply. Fluent in English, they marry outstanding scientific acumen with strong organizational skills. They are an articulate, collaborative communicator who effectively motivates teams to deliver safe, scalable, and sustainable chemical processes.







  **Tasks \& Responsibilities:**



* Lead Internal \& External Chemical Process R\&D activities: Direct chemical process research and development work, managing an internal team of 1\-5 process chemists and/or leading external activities at contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).
* Oversee end\-to\-end process chemistry workflows, including synthetic route scouting, process optimization, scale\-up, and support for supply activities.
* Coordinate Cross\-Functional Delivery: Synchronize internal laboratory efforts with CDMO timelines to guarantee the timely, safe, and cost\-effective production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and advanced intermediates
* Ensure Quality \& Compliance: Deliver the target compounds following internal quality processes and according to specifications, safety standards and sustainability objectives.


  



  **Must Haves:**



* PhD or Postdoctoral background in Synthetic Organic Chemistry.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in pharmaceutical chemical process R\&D, with demonstrated expertise in late\-stage process development and scale\-up.
* Leadership \& Project Management: Proven track record of leading, mentoring, and driving project deliverables within internal process chemistry teams.
* CDMO Management: Direct experience managing external chemical development, technology transfers, and manufacturing activities at CDMOs.
* Technical \& Software Proficiency: High proficiency with standard office applications alongside core chemistry tools, including chemical drawing tools, literature/patent search engines, Design of Experiments (DoE) applications, analytical software, and project planning platforms. Proficiency in the use of kinetic modeling or scale\-up simulation software is a plus.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.


  



  **Nice to Haves:**



* Familiarity or prior experience working within Manufacturing Practice (GMP) environments is an advantage, though not strictly required.
* Professional working proficiency or fluency in is a plus.

Le nostre persone sono la chiave del nostro successo. Per questo promuoviamo lo spirito di squadra, la responsabilità individuale e le opportunità di crescita professionale in un ambiente internazionale.

Per rafforzare il nostro team commerciale presso la sede di **Bedano**, siamo alla ricerca di una persona motivata e orientata ai risultati per la posizione di  **Manager (m/f/d)**, capace di combinare spirito imprenditoriale, competenze commerciali e una forte attenzione alle esigenze dei clienti.

* Collaborare strettamente con il team interno e con i reparti operativi per garantire un servizio efficiente e di qualità.

jobs.title: Constructeur de voies ferrées
jobs.description:
Nous sommes à la recherche de professionnels passionnés et engagés dans les domaines de la construction pour rejoindre nos équipes dynamiques. Chez Gi Group, nous croyons en la force de l’innovation, de la collaboration et de l'excellence. Nous considérons chaque candidat potentiel comme une source inestimable de compétences et de talents uniques. Rejoignez\-nous dans notre quête constante pour l'excellence ! Nous sommes impatients de découvrir comment votre expertise et votre motivation peuvent contribuer à notre succès commun en qualité de :



**constructeurs de voies ferrées**  

**Vos tâches :**

* Participer à la construction, à l’entretien et à la rénovation des voies ferrées.
* Effectuer la pose et le remplacement des rails, traverses et appareils de voie.
* Réaliser les travaux de ballastage, bourrage et nivellement des voies.
* Assister aux opérations de soudure et de raccordement des rails.
* Utiliser les outils et équipements spécifiques aux travaux ferroviaires.
* Participer au chargement, déchargement et à la manutention du matériel.
* Contrôler l’état des installations et signaler les anomalies.
* Assurer l’entretien courant du matériel et des équipements utilisés.
* Respecter strictement les consignes de sécurité ferroviaire et les normes en vigueur.
* Collaborer efficacement avec les équipes de chantier, de jour comme de nuit selon les besoins.


**Votre profil :**

* Expérience dans le domaine ferroviaire, du génie civil ou de la construction, un atout.
* Expérience en pose de voies ferrées appréciée.
* Bonne condition physique et aptitude au travail en extérieur par tous les temps.
* Personne motivée, fiable et appréciant le travail en équipe.
* Flexibilité pour les horaires de nuit, week\-ends et interventions ponctuelles.
* Capacité à travailler dans le respect des procédures de sécurité.
* Permis de conduire catégorie B indispensable.
* Disponible pour se déplacer sur différents chantiers en Suisse romande.


**Votre candidature**

Si vous êtes prêt à relever le défi et à faire partie d'une équipe qui valorise les employés, envoyez\-nous votre CV en indiquant le poste pour lequel vous postulez. Merci de postuler en ligne.

**À propos de Gi Group**

Gi Group fait partie de Gi Group Holding, un écosystème mondial de services et de conseils en ressources humaines qui soutient le développement du marché du travail et contribue à changer la vie des gens dans 37 pays du monde entier. En Suisse, nous opérons avec les marques Gi Group, Gi Life Sciences, Grafton et Bautech Personal. Nous sommes actifs dans le domaine du recrutement temporaire, permanent et professionnel, ainsi que dans une variété de services RH complémentaires. Avec une présence directe sur 40 sites en Suisse et plus de 200 employés, nous sommes l'une des principales entreprises de placement de personnel sur le marché suisse du recrutement. Gi Group est le spécialiste du recrutement temporaire et permanent et un partenaire précieux pour de nombreuses autres solutions en matière de ressources humaines. Nous changeons des vies en mettant en relation des candidats et des entreprises, et nous travaillons chaque jour à créer de la valeur.

**Interfaces externes :** Fournisseurs internationaux (Asie/Japon/US/UE), Transporteurs, Commissionnaires en douane

**2\. MISSION PRINCIPALE**

Sous la supervision du Responsable Approvisionnements, l'Approvisionneur Junior assure la disponibilité optimale des produits phares de la gastronomie asiatique (épicerie, produits frais/surgelés, sakés, packagings client) tout en garantissant un niveau de stock maîtrisé. Il gère l'intégralité du flux d'approvisionnement depuis la passation de commande à l'international jusqu'à la livraison finale à l'entrepôt logistique B2B, dans le respect strict des réglementations douanières et sanitaires propres à l'agroalimentaire.

Nous recherchons une personne motivée, dynamique et proactive, qui fait preuve d’initiative et d’un bon esprit d’analyse.

Vous êtes capable de prendre du recul face aux situations, d’identifier les problèmes et de proposer des solutions concrètes, plutôt que de vous arrêter aux difficultés rencontrées.

Vous avez le sens des responsabilités, êtes autonome et savez faire preuve de remise en question. Vous accueillez les remarques constructives avec ouverture et les considérez comme des occasions de progresser.

Une bonne base de connaissances dans le domaine est souhaitée, mais une longue expérience n’est pas indispensable. Nous accordons davantage d’importance à votre motivation, à votre capacité de réflexion et à votre volonté d’apprendre.

Une formation et un accompagnement seront assurés afin de vous permettre de développer vos compétences et d’évoluer dans votre fonction.

**3\. MISSIONS ET ACTIVITÉS LOGISTIQUES**

**A. Gestion opérationnelle des importations (grand import \+ europe)**

**Calculer et planifier :** les besoins de commandes selon l'état des stocks, les prévisions de ventes commerciales et la saisonnalité des produits (ex: pics de fin d'année, festivals).

**Coordonner :** le transport international (FCL/LCL maritime, aérien) en lien direct avec les transitaires et optimiser le taux de remplissage des conteneurs.

**B. Pilotage des stocks et respect de la chaîne de valeur agroalimentaire**

**Surveiller la rotation :** les dates limites de consommation (DLC) et dates de durabilité minimale (DDM) afin de minimiser la démarque sur les produits ultra\-frais et secs.

**Ajuster en continu :** les niveaux de stock par rapport à la capacité de stockage multi\-températures de l'entrepôt (sec, frais à \+4°C, surgelé à \-18°C).

**Anticiper :** les ruptures de stock sur les produits stratégiques (ex: riz premium, sauces soja de spécialité, sakés de garde) et alerter immédiatement la force commerciale en cas de retard de conteneur.

Consultant en recrutement IT \- H/F
===================================

Membre du groupe Sigmalis, actif depuis 2007 dans le conseil et l’ingénierie en informatique, Sigmalis Talent Services accompagne les entreprises dans l’identification et l’attraction d'experts IT et de cadres, en proposant une offre complète en recrutement: placement fixe, délégation en régie, mission temporaire et executive search.

Notre expertise en recrutement depuis plus de 20 ans en Suisse Romande, associée à une compréhension approfondie des métiers technologiques et des enjeux RH, nous permet de vous proposer des opportunités pertinentes dans des environnements professionnels réellement adaptés à vos attentes. Notre priorité est d’assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d’un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe.

### Description du poste

**Votre mission**

En tant que **Consultant·e en recrutement IT**, vous prenez en charge l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu'au suivi des candidats.

Vous intervenez aussi bien sur les recrutements destinés à renforcer les équipes de consultants du groupe Sigmalis que sur les mandats confiés à Sigmalis Talent Services par ses clients.

Votre rôle ne consiste pas uniquement à identifier des CV : vous cherchez à comprendre les parcours, les compétences, les motivations et les aspirations professionnelles afin de créer des mises en relation pertinentes et durables.

**Vos principales responsabilités**

* Comprendre les besoins de recrutement, les environnements techniques et les profils recherchés,
* Définir et déployer les stratégies de sourcing et d'approche directe les plus adaptées,
* Rédiger et publier des offres d'emploi attractives et ciblées,
* Identifier et approcher des candidats via les différents outils, réseaux professionnels et techniques de chasse de tête,
* Analyser les candidatures et évaluer leur adéquation avec les exigences techniques, professionnelles et humaines du poste,
* Préparer et conduire des entretiens approfondis et structurés,
* Rédiger des comptes rendus d'entretien précis permettant de restituer les compétences, l'expérience, les motivations et les éléments déterminants de chaque candidature,
* Accompagner les candidats tout au long du processus et assurer un suivi régulier et professionnel,
* Garantir la qualité et la mise à jour des informations dans notre ATS et constituer des viviers de talents sur les profils régulièrement recherchés,
* Développer une relation de proximité avec les équipes internes du groupe et comprendre leurs besoins actuels et futurs,
* Contribuer à l'attractivité de nos opportunités et à notre marque employeur.


### Profil recherché

Vous bénéficiez de 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans le sourcing et le recrutement de profils IT au sein d'une agence de recrutement ou d'une société de services informatiques **en Suisse romande**.

Vous disposez également des compétences et qualités suivantes :

* excellente maîtrise des méthodes de sourcing, de recherche directe et de chasse de tête,
* bonne connaissance des principaux métiers et environnements de l'informatique,
* connaissance du marché de l'emploi et du tissu économique de Suisse romande,
* capacité à conduire des entretiens structurés et à évaluer une candidature au\-delà des seuls éléments du CV,
* français langue maternelle ou niveau équivalent, avec d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, bon niveau d'anglais vous permettant de conduire des entretiens avec des candidats anglophones,
* sens de l'organisation, rigueur et capacité à gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités simultanément,
* excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de la communication,
* autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats,
* goût du travail en équipe et capacité à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs et métiers,
* respect absolu de la confidentialité et de l'éthique inhérentes au métier du recrutement.


Nous recherchons une personne qui souhaite s'investir dans la durée, développer son expertise et contribuer activement à la croissance de notre activité.

**Rejoindre Sigmalis Talent Services, c'est…**

**Intégrer un groupe suisse à taille humaine**, dans lequel les échanges sont directs et les responsabilités réelles.

**Exercer pleinement votre métier de recruteur**, de l'analyse du besoin à l'accompagnement du candidat, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité des recrutements.

**Évoluer au contact de spécialistes de l'IT**, qui permettent de mieux comprendre les métiers, les environnements techniques et les enjeux rencontrés par nos clients.

**Construire des relations de proximité avec les candidats**, en privilégiant la qualité des échanges et du suivi plutôt qu'une approche purement quantitative du recrutement.

**Travailler sur des missions variées**, aussi bien pour les besoins internes du groupe que pour des entreprises et organisations de Suisse romande.

Enfin, nous accordons une importance particulière à **l'éthique, la confidentialité, la qualité du travail réalisé et au respect des engagements pris envers nos candidats comme envers nos clients**.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette approche du recrutement et souhaitez poursuivre votre parcours dans un environnement spécialisé IT ?

Nous serons heureux de découvrir votre candidature et d'échanger avec vous sur votre parcours et vos aspirations professionnelles.

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil, nous recevrons avec plaisir votre candidature qui doit comprendre votre cv **ainsi que votre dossier complet (copies de diplômes, certificats de travail, etc…).**  

**Nous ne répondrons qu'aux profils qui correspondent à ces pré\-requis.**

jobs.title: Global Technical Manager (f/m/d) – Product Biology Disease Control (Fungicides)
jobs.description:
Company Description
At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.
Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.

Job Description
Role Scope
Design, communicate and implement technical development strategies for new products and innovative technologies, working across R&D and Marketing. Provide scientific and agronomic expertise, market and competitor foresight, and lead global field-trial implementation to deliver market-competitive products and customer value

Responsibilities:
•    Lead the global technical development of new AI’s plus key strategic projects, from early field testing through to product launch and AI lifecycle management,
•    Plan and coordinate harmonized field trial programs, liaising with research, the regions, and countries - assembling teams to deliver data efficiently and on time.
•    Provide technical positioning for AI’s and design and communicate technical strategies for product use and development plans to deliver agreed business objectives.
•    Translate data into compelling recommendation to support decision make
•    Provide technical support to launch plans, meeting marketing and customer needs.
•    Lead biology activities within global MPTs, BSRTs, AIM Teams according to portfolio.
•    Foster technical networking, as well as actively seeking contacts with customers and key influencers to develop and support solutions.
•    Actively look for new approaches to enhance or re-position a product’s value proposition.
•    Drive strategic innovation and creativity in projects and solutions, identifying new market opportunities for active ingredients, formulations and use of technology.
•    Technically support current and new third-party products, as necessary.
•    Lead and enable global Resistance Management strategy execution across Research, Development, regions and countries, according to portfolio.
•    Partner with data scientists and digital experts to gain efficiency and insights into the development program and value proposition creation.
•    Sustain efficient knowledge management of data and information.

Qualifications
A person who combines strong CP Development technical foundations with intellectual curiosity, sound judgement and an appetite for innovation and change. Who recognizes that how results are achieved through constructive behaviors, collaboration and integrity-is as important as what is delivered.
•    Excellent knowledge of agronomy, farmer practices and agricultural sciences, supported by an MSc or Ph.D in agronomy.
•    Broad knowledge of agribusiness and new technologies in crop protection
•    Experience working across broader global markets-meaning multiple regions-is required
•    At least five years’ experience delivering development projects in country and region, and at least five years of local market experience in agronomy and disease control.
•    In-depth knowledge of technical profiles, properties and positioning of Syngenta and competitor products and associated technologies.
•    Experience of working directly with R&D activities, primarily in Development, and familiarity with fungicides.
•    Recognized technical expertise related to disease control, with experience planning, implementing and managing field trials.
•    Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, technical integrity, resilience and effective communication in a multifunctional, multicultural environment.
•    Ability to connect insights from multiple trials and diverse information sources to develop clear, evidence-based recommendations.
•    Experience in data analysis and visualisation techniques to communicate results clearly for non-technical audiences.
•    Openness to adopting and developing new approaches, including data, digital tools, artificial intelligence, and knowledge management.
•    Ability to bring local insights into global plans and translate global strategies into local approaches.
•    Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective partnerships across R&D, Marketing, regions and functions.
•    A willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis.
•    Fluency in written and spoken English.

Additional Information
We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:
•    We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
•    A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
•    The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
•    Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
•    You will benefit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working arrangements, an attractive bonus system, an onsite doctor, a fitness room, a canteen, and other benefits such as family-friendly initiatives and child and family allowances.
Please submit your complete application, including an English CV, copies of diplomas/certificates, and work certificates (if applicable).
Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

IT\-Solution und Security Architekt:in 100%
===========================================

Du bist davon überzeugt, dass das Potential der Digitalisierung den Gesundheitsmarkt weiter revolutionieren wird, und möchtest Deine fachlichen Skills einsetzen, um das Beste für unsere Kunden herauszuholen und sie zu begeistern?

Wir sind ein stark expandierendes und innovatives KMU im Medizin\- und Bankwesen sowie im Integrationsumfeld komplexer Cloud\-Projekte. Unser Kerngeschäft in der Medizin liegt in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb der schweizweit modernsten Arztsoftware amétiq siMed und dem einzigartigen medizinischen Ökosystem amétiq cloud mit über 7’000 Benutzern. Wir sind damit die erste Adresse für die Digitalisierung der Arztpraxis entlang der gesamten Prozesskette.



**Für die Verstärkung des internen IT\-Teams suchen wir eine:n**

Deine
-----

Du hast eine Schlüsselrolle, in der Du eine hochsichere und moderne IT\-Architektur mitgestalten kannst und gleichzeitig ganz nah an der technischen Umsetzung stehst. In dieser Position schlägst Du die Brücke zwischen strategischer Architektur, stabiler Systemlandschaft und moderner Cyber\-Security. Du evaluierst zukunftsweisende Technologien, optimierst mit schrittweiser Modernisierung die Architektur für mehr Effizienz in Entwicklung und Betrieb und wirkst aktiv bei der Umsetzung mit. Dabei arbeitest Du auf Augenhöhe mit unseren System Engineers, der Administration und unserem hauseigenen Systemprovider zusammen.



Deine Aufgaben
--------------

* Architektur \& Innovation: Du konzipierst und verantwortest Optimierungen unserer IT\-Architektur, evaluierst neue Technologien und treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Infrastruktur voran.
* Security \& Identity Management: Du hältst die Sicherheit unserer Architektur auf einem hohen Niveau, sicherst Datenflüsse ab und gestaltest moderne Identitäts\- und Zugriffstrukturen (IDP).
* Hands\-on Integration: Du konzipierst nicht nur, sondern bringst Dich aktiv ein, indem Du neue Grundstrukturen direkt umsetzt und integrierst.
* System\- \& Provider\-Schnittstelle: Du arbeitest eng und partnerschaftlich mit den System Engineers sowie mit den Administratoren zusammen und steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Systemprovider im gleichen Firmenkonstrukt.
* Daten \& Analytics: Du designst und optimierst performante Datenarchitekturen für komplexe Datenbanken und datenintensive Workloads (Data Pipelining).
* Qualitäts\- \& Belastungstests: Mit Deinem Verständnis für moderne Testverfahren und Load\-Tests stellst Du die Performance und Ausfallsicherheit der Systeme unter realen Bedingungen sicher.
* Strukturen hinterfragen: Du bringst den Mut und die Expertise mit, bestehende Strukturen („Challenging von Systemen“) konstruktiv zu hinterfragen und zu optimieren.




Dein Profil
-----------

* Infrastruktur\- \& Systemnähe: Du hast eine ausgeprägte Leidenschaft für IT\-Infrastrukturen und moderne Tools; das Arbeiten nah an der operativen Systemlandschaft begeistert Dich.
* Security \& IDP\-Experte: Du verfügst über fundierte, starke Kenntnisse im Bereich IT\-Security sowie in der Konzeption und Verwaltung von Identity\-Provider\-Strukturen (vorzugsweise mit Keycloak und MS Entra).
* Daten\- \& Tool\-Know\-how: Du kennst sich bestens mit Datenbanken und Datenflüssen aus und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit Werkzeugen wie Apache Spark und Apache NiFi mit.
* Repository\- \& Code\-Verständnis: Du bist vertraut mit der strukturierten Ablage und Integration von Systemstrukturen in Software\-Repositories (z. B. Git).
* Container \& Orchestrierung: Du besitzt solide Grundkenntnisse in Kubernetes sowie im Bereich der Container\-Orchestrierung.
* Zukunftstechnologien: Du hast ein starkes Interesse an Trends wie «Künstlicher Intelligenz» (AI) und bringst die Fähigkeit mit, deren Nutzen für die Infrastruktur zu bewerten.
* Mindset: Du bist ein starker Teamplayer, der komplexe Abhängigkeiten schnell durchschaut und Freude daran hat, technologische Standards aktiv mitzugestalten.




Das erwartet Dich
-----------------

* Eine enge, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit einem etablierten Systemprovider innerhalb des gleichen Firmenkonstrukts – für kurze Wege und maximale Synergien.
* Direkter Gestaltungsspielraum mit modernen Tools und Plattformen (Kubernetes, Keycloak, Spark, Apache NiFi sowie zukunftsweisende AI\-Anwendungen).
* Bei uns ist die Kultur des Hinterfragens bestehender Strukturen und das schrittweise Modernisieren ausdrücklich erwünscht – Deine Ideen verändern die Architektur von morgen.
* Faire und marktgerechte Entlöhnung.
* Regelmässige Mitarbeiter\-Infoanlässe und Team\-Events, Apéros, jährlicher Wintersporttag etc.
* Engagement für soziale Verantwortung: Ein Teil unseres Gewinns wird für Projekte eingesetzt, die von Mitarbeitenden vorgeschlagen und ausgewählt werden.
* Moderne Arbeitsplätze, flexible Arbeitsformen im Büro und im Homeoffice.
* Zentraler Arbeitsort – nur 150 Meter vom Bahnhof Pfäffikon SZ entfernt – mit vielfältigen Verpflegungsmöglichkeiten und Naherholung am See.
* Gratis\-Parkplätze in der Tiefgarage und um das Büro herum.
* Variantenreiche Möglichkeiten zur Verpflegung am Mittag und Naherholung am Seeufer (nur 10 Minuten zu ).

Principal Data Architect
========================

Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and . We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses.



If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey.



**Role**



As a Principal Data Architect, you will provide strategic guidance and long\-term vision across data and AI, working closely with our clients to solve complex data challenges, from platform modernisation and governance to real\-time architectures and AI operationalization. You will design and deliver data architectures and strategies that are fit for purpose, balancing technical rigour with business value, while bringing the curiosity and conviction to challenge conventional thinking and push the boundaries of what data and AI can do for our clients.



**How you’ll make impact**

* **Trusted Advisor:** You guide our clients towards successful solutions to their data challenges. You'll lead design sessions, architecture reviews, proof\-of\-concept projects and evaluation of new data technologies and vendors.
* **Early Engagement \& Vision:** You take part in pre\-sales and sales activities to help create a compelling vision for our clients' data strategy, modernisation and governance journeys, including transitions to cloud\-native data platforms, data meshes, real\-time data architectures, and AI\-native platforms.
* **Architecture \& Implementation:** You design sophisticated architectures for data and AI projects, implementing them together with your team while inspiring your stakeholders.
* **Methodology \& Concepts:** You bring rigorous methodology to every engagement, applying agile DevOps and DataOps practices to keep delivery on track, while ensuring architectural decisions are grounded in deep conceptual understanding of data platforms, data mesh, security and governance.
* **Cloud Expertise:** You feel at home in both cloud and on\-premises environments. In the cloud, you design optimal solutions on Azure, AWS, and GCP, knowing when each platform is the right fit.
* **Data Engineering:** You lead your team to success in flagship projects with solid data engineering knowledge, ensuring clean and maintainable code, efficient data models and robust pipelines.
* **AI Operationalization:** You take data and AI projects from prototype to production readiness, with a strong focus on traceability, transparency, and reproducibility as foundations for governed and compliant AI.
* **Thought Leadership \& Consulting:** You promote understanding of AI and data technologies, share your knowledge both internally and externally, and invest in growing the talent around you.




**What’s important to us**

* You bring deep expertise in AI and data solutions, along with a nuanced understanding of their possibilities and limitations.
* You have a passion for clean, maintainable software architecture in data platforms and have taken on responsibility in technical mandates in agile environments both as an architect and as an engineer within your career.
* You have proven experience leading the technical aspects of pre\-sales activities and bid management, shaping winning proposals and translating client needs into compelling solution narratives.
* You are proficient across multiple data platforms and cloud environments, including Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks and Snowflake, and are comfortable with distributed processing, data modelling, API design, containerisation, serverless computation, data governance, and data security.
* With your positive attitude and strong self\-motivation, you take responsibility for proposals, client projects and the further development of our data and AI competencies. You make confident decisions and can clearly explain your reasoning, balancing technical rigour with pragmatism to keep delivery on track.
* Excellent communication skills on management level as well as with technical experts in both and English are essential.
* You hold a technical degree in Computer Science, or a comparable field.




**What we offer**

jobs.description:
Get to know Climeworks
Climeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions.

Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment.

By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society.

We foster a dynamic environment and are building a global purpose driven team. We are looking for disruptive thinkers, passionate achievers and inspiring leaders that are ready to take on the world’s greatest challenge.

Will you join us?

Your mission
Job description
Technical Direction: You define and maintain the technical direction for the Electrical Department.  You lead the development of fit-for-purpose EIC specifications, design philosophies, and basis of design for execution Globally. You ensure owner requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to contractors, and validate design assumptions against operability and safety, and ensure compliance with local and regional codes and regulations.

Contractor management: You review and approve contractor submissions for electrical systems and power distribution, enforce owner requirements, provide technical clarifications, and ensure adherence to schedule, quality, safety, and operability. You set clear expectations for execution methods, field quality controls, and turnover documentation needed for safe operation and maintenance.

System Reliability & Innovation: You lead initiatives to improve reliability and performance of Electrical systems, troubleshoot issues, and implement preventive measures. You evaluate and introduce emerging technologies such as energy efficiency solutions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: You act as the primary Electrical interface with process, instrumentation and controls, mechanical, and project management teams to ensure integrated designs. You identify and mitigate Electrical risks during design and operation phases and support project teams with scope, cost, and schedule estimates.

Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement: You supervise and coach junior team members, provide guidance on technical challenges, and drive lessons-learned sessions to maintain a strong knowledge base and promote continuous improvement.  You maintain thorough records of technical decisions, design bases, vendor information, and lessons learned for future operational use.

Cold-Weather and Constructability: As our next DAC plant could be in a cold or hot weather environment, you incorporate climate conditions into the Electrical design and execution planning (extreme heat, freeze protection, winterization, insulation/heat tracing philosophy, cold start/commissioning constraints). You ensure the design is constructable and able to operate and be maintained through cold or hot conditions, including consideration of temporary works, for instance winter work sequencing, and interface constraints with cold-weather activities.

Your story
Requirements
Professional Experience: You have a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent and have at least 10 years of experience in process plants various climates as an Electrical Engineer.  You have experience leading teams.

Project Experience: You have hands-on involvement in at least one full-cycle project in the mining, water treatment, oil and gas or other comparable industries, covering all phases from FEED and detailed design to construction, commissioning and start-up; preferably in remote/seasonally constrained execution environments.  You have expertise in low and medium voltage electrical systems, industrial instrumentation, and control systems.

Cold-Weather Industrial Plant Experience: You have hands-on experience working with industrial plants in cold-weather environments (e.g. Canada, Nordic countries, or similar climates) and understand the operational, maintenance, and safety challenges associated with extreme weather conditions.

Communication & Collaboration: You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and can liaise with diverse stakeholders, including third-party vendors in IP-sensitive collaborations.

Working Style: You are precise, adaptable, and reliable, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. You are comfortable driving decisions and owning them in the office and under field constraints, including winter productivity and schedule risk.  You are highly organized, able to plan and prioritize work for yourself and others, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.

Language Skills and Travel: You are fluent in English and ready to travel up to 40% of your time (including extended site presence during peak design, engineering, construction and commissioning periods).

Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.

What we offer:

Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.

Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.

Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.

Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.

Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.

Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.

Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

Formalities:

This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.

We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

We are a private Single/Multi\-Family Office dedicated to managing the wealth, investments, and lifestyle needs of a prominent family. We pride ourselves on discretion, excellence, and long\-term stewardship.

We are seeking a detail\-oriented, highly discreet, and proactive professional to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will support the daily operations of the family office, assisting with both financial administration and high\-end lifestyle management.

* **Investment Operations Support:** Support trade settlements, capital calls/distributions, and investment record keeping.

* **Advisor Coordination:**Liaise with external tax, legal, banking, and wealth advisors.
* **Lifestyle Management:**Coordinate family\-related services, including visas, properties, and events.
* **Confidential Documentation:**Prepare confidential documents, presentations, and correspondence.
* **Ad\-Hoc Support:** Handle ad\-hoc requests and administrative tasks with discretion and a service\-oriented mindset.
* **General Office Administration:**Support office administration and office upkeep.


**Requirements**

* 2\+ years of experience in a family office, private banking, asset management, or corporate finance environment.
* Full\-time availability and willingness to work 100% on\-site in Pfäffikon, Schwyz.
* Valid Swiss work permit.
* Fluent in English; native\-level Japanese preferred.
* Well\-organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong analytical, administrative, and software skills.
* High level of discretion, professionalism, and integrity.
* Fast learner with a proactive mindset and strong sense of ownership.

jobs.title: Toimistosihteeri, Pelastus- ja ensihoitopalvelut, Hallintopalvelut
jobs.description:
Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen pelastus- ja ensihoitopalveluiden tehtäväalue vastaa pelastustoimen ja ensihoidon järjestämisestä Pirkanmaalla. Resurssien ja jatkuvuudenhallinta on yksi tämän tehtäväalueen toimialueista, mihin sisältyvät pelastus- ja ensihoitopalveluiden tukitoiminnot kuten resurssitoimisto, kehittämispalvelut, tekniset palvelut sekä palvelulinjan välittömät hallinnolliset yhteistyö- ja tukipalvelut. Hallinnollisia yhteistyö- ja tukipalveluita ovat muun muassa johdon tuki, asiakirjahallinto, päätösvalmistelu, johtoryhmien kokoushallinta, taloushallinto sekä muut hallinto- ja toimistopalvelut.

Toimistosihteerin tehtävään kuuluu pelastus- ja ensihoitopalveluiden myyntilaskutuksen hoitaminen ja ostolaskujen käsittely sekä niihin liittyvät tukitehtävät. Tehtäviin sisältyy mm.:
yleislaskutus Intime weblaskutuksella
laskutusta tukevien tietojen tarkastaminen
ostolaskujen käsittely P2P-järjestelmässä
asiakaspalvelu puhelimitse ja laskutuksen yhteissähköpostien kautta
yhteistyö em. tehtäviin liittyvien sidosryhmien ja asiakkaiden kanssa.

Tehtäviin voi kuulua myös
ensihoitolaskutus Codea-järjestelmässä ja kiireettömien potilassiirtotehtävien laskutus e-Potkussa
ensihoitajien opastaminen laskutukseen vaikuttavien tietojen kirjaamisessa.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on vähintään soveltuva perustutkinto. Eduksi katsotaan kokemus monipuolisista taloushallinnon tehtävistä.

Onnistut tehtävässä, jos sinulla on:
itsenäinen, aktiivinen ja joustava työote
kyky työskennellä tehokkaasti, ennakoida tilanteita ja tehdä ripeitä päätöksiä
vahvat asiakaspalvelu- ja yhteistyötaidot
hyvät tietotekniset taidot ja yleisten toimistojärjestelmien sujuva hallinta
hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taito sekä valmius hoitaa työasioita myös englanniksi.

Tehtävä on määräaikainen ajalla 1.12.2026 - 31.12.2027. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, päivätyö 36,25 tuntia viikossa. Tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä tehdään hakijan suostumuksella henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (Turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014). Lisätietoa turvallisuusmenettelystä ja selvityksen kohteen oikeuksista löytyy osoitteesta www.supo.fi.

Kiinnostuitko tarjoamastamme tehtävästä? Jätä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmässä. Olemme alustavasti suunnitelleet pitävämme haastattelut maanantaina 9.11.2026.

jobs.description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both French and English

  • Commercially rigorous — accurate pipeline management, disciplined forecasting

 

Languages

  • French — native or bilingual (essential)

  • English — fluent, business-level (essential)

  • Additional languages a plus

 

Education

  • Degree in **Business, Marketing, Communications, Languages, or a creative discipline** — or equivalent professional experience
