jobs.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de notre département R&D, vous rejoignez l’équipe Studio, en charge du développement de notre outil de conception et de configuration d’entrepôts robotisés.

De la modélisation d’un entrepôt en 3D au dimensionnement d’une solution Skypod (solution robotisée de stockage et de préparation de commandes pour les entrepôts logistiques), en passant par l’optimisation des coûts et la préparation du déploiement, Studio accompagne les équipes Exotec à chaque étape de leurs projets.

En tant que Senior Java Software Engineer, vous contribuez à faire évoluer cet outil stratégique en concevant et développant son backend et ses API. Vous intervenez sur des problématiques techniques variées, allant des moteurs de règles métier aux intégrations avec l’écosystème Exotec, avec un objectif : proposer des solutions fiables, performantes et adaptées aux besoins des utilisateurs.

En lien étroit avec les équipes techniques, produit et métier, vous participez activement aux choix de conception et à l’amélioration continue de Studio, afin de faciliter la conception et le déploiement des solutions robotiques Exotec à travers le monde.

Vos missions

  • Développer le backend de Studio : concevoir et faire évoluer les services Java et Spring Boot, les API et les fonctionnalités liées à la conception 3D, au dimensionnement des solutions et au calcul des coûts.
  • Concevoir les intégrations : développer et maintenir les connecteurs avec les outils de chiffrage, AutoCAD et les API de l’écosystème Exotec, notamment ICT et MCP.
  • Garantir la qualité du produit : assurer la performance, la robustesse et la fiabilité des applications, analyser les incidents de production et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du code.
  • Contribuer à la livraison continue : participer aux processus CI/CD, aux releases et à la validation des évolutions avec GitLab.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes : recueillir les besoins des utilisateurs, travailler avec les équipes produit, frontend, commerciales et projets, et participer aux rituels agiles de l’équipe.

Profil

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation de niveau Bac+5 en informatique ou en informatique industrielle, et justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en développement web.

Vous disposez des compétences suivantes :

  • Vous maîtrisez Java et l’écosystème JEE, notamment Spring et Spring Boot.
  • Vous avez une bonne connaissance des technologies web et de la conception d’API.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL, ainsi qu’avec les environnements Linux.
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils de gestion de versions et de développement collaboratif, notamment GitLab.
  • Vous connaissez idéalement un framework JavaScript, tel que React ou Vue.js.
  • Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel.

Structuré(e), rigoureux(se) et imaginatif(ve), vous savez prendre des initiatives et proposer des solutions pragmatiques. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes à l’aise pour collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés, dans un environnement de travail convivial.

Poste soumis à astreinte.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, composée de 6 ingénieurs, vous contribuez à améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la disponibilité des systèmes robotiques Exotec.

Notre mission : exploiter les données et analyser les défaillances pour améliorer la robustesse et la durée de vie de nos systèmes, tout en réduisant les arrêts opérationnels.

À l’interface entre hardware et software, vous identifiez les causes racines des défaillances, développez des outils d’analyse et pilotez des améliorations techniques. Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du système, de l’analyse des données terrain au développement et à la validation de solutions concrètes.

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, vos missions sont les suivantes :

  • Contribuer à l’évolution des systèmes : travailler avec les équipes de conception pour améliorer les composants, les sous-systèmes et les architectures hardware.
  • Concevoir et réaliser des essais : définir des protocoles de test, mener des expérimentations sur des systèmes dédiés à la R&D et mesurer l’efficacité des améliorations apportées.
  • Enrichir votre connaissance des systèmes sur le terrain : participer au support client pour mieux comprendre les conditions d’utilisation, investiguer les problèmes rencontrés et identifier de nouvelles pistes d’amélioration.

Votre profil

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.

jobs.title: CDI - CREATIVE DESIGNER - BRAND CONCEPTS (H/F)
jobs.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE

Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact.

 

VOS MISSIONS

  • Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion.
  • Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison.
  • Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés.
  • Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image.
  • Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison.
  • Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…).
  • Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations.
  • Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants.
  • Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports.
  • Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication.

 

VOTRE PROFIL 

  • Excellente culture graphique et artistique.
  • Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques.
  • Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs.
  • Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere.
  • Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint.
  • Très bonne maîtrise du motion design.
  • Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création.
  • Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes.
 
Le poste est situé rue de Lisbonne dans le 8è arrondissement de Paris.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description:
Diabolocom is the leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience management (CX) platform. It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel. 
 
Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth.


About the role

To support our growth, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our HR team in Paris.

You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire.

A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions.

You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role.

You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department.

We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices.


What you will do

  • Manage recruitment processes from A to Z, from the initial briefing with the hiring manager through sourcing, interviews, coordination of the selection process, offer management and contract signature.

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, challenge requirements when relevant and translate them into an effective recruitment and sourcing strategy.

  • Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles, including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles.

  • Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting, identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications.

  • Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches.

  • Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment.

  • Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process.

  • Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience.

  • Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process.

  • Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators.

  • Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes.

  • Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices.


    • What we are looking for

  • You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment.

  • You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team.

  • You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant.

  • You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach.

  • Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels.

  • You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly.

  • You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders.

  • You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals.

  • You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices.

  • You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers.

  • Ability to build, manage and improve recruitment dashboards would be a strong plus for this role.

  • You are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.

  • Spanish would be a strong plus, as would experience recruiting across several European or international markets.


    • What's in it for you

  • A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture.

  • The opportunity to work on challenging searches across Software Engineering, AI, Infrastructure, Product, business and leadership roles.

  • Exposure to an international environment and stakeholders across multiple countries.

  • A Talent Acquisition team where you can operate autonomously while continuing to learn and develop your expertise.

  • The opportunity to contribute to the evolution of our recruitment practices and have a visible impact on how we attract and hire talent.

  • An office in the heart of Paris, close to Opéra Garnier.

  • A hybrid working model, with up to 2 days of remote work per week.

  • Lunch vouchers (€11/day via Swile).

  • High-quality IT equipment.

  • Regular company and team events

    • Salary range for the role

    An annual gross package (fix +performance based bonus) ranging from 50 000 euros to 55 000 euros.

    Interested in joining us? Let’s talk.



     
    As part of our hiring process, please note that any employment offer will be subject to a background check, including verification of your identity, educational credentials, and previous employment history.

Jouw werkuren kunnen vallen tussen 7 à 8 uur en tussen 19 uur. Zondagen zijn om te zonnen of om te rusten want dan ben je zo vrij als een vogel.

Wil jij in een brandschone moderne werkomgeving werken waar het vlees rechtstreeks vanuit het slachthuis toekomt en waar je tal van voordelen krijgt?

Samen met jouw collega beenhouwer maak je alles even lekker vers en ga je helemaal voor het fijnere beenhouwerswerk.

Je hebt ervaring met het versnijden van vlees.

jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.description:
About Evora Labs

Evora Labs develops technology for the operation, integration, and management of battery energy storage systems and other distributed energy assets.

Our platform helps energy asset owners integrate assets, achieve market readiness, maintain operational availability, and manage technical requirements across energy markets and grid  services.

About the role

As Tech Lead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day engineering of the Evora platform: the cloud backend, the operator frontend, the EMS edge software that runs at battery sites, and the infrastructure that connects them.

  You will work close to real assets. The code you write reads Modbus registers from live battery systems, runs prequalification tests against the Swedish TSO's technical requirements, ingests Nordic and continental market data, and dispatches setpoints that a safety envelope on the edge is the last line of defense for.

  The position combines hands-on full-stack development, system architecture, ownership of the edge and integration layer, technical leadership of a small team, and continuous translation of  field experience from live BESS projects into the product.

Key responsibilities

  - Own the architecture and technical roadmap of the Evora platform across backend, frontend, edge, and cloud infrastructure.

  - Design and build backend services in Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, asyncpg, Alembic) on top of TimescaleDB, Redis, and MQTT.

  - Develop and maintain the EMS edge software: Modbus and vendor-protocol drivers, register maps, control loops, safety envelope, and store-and-forward telemetry over AWS IoT Core.

  - Build operator-facing product in the Next.js and React frontend: fleet monitoring, asset and site management, the visual workflow builder, dashboards, and market explorers.

  - Own the prequalification engine that drives FCR-N, FCR-D, FFR, aFRR, and mFRR test programs, validates the response against TSO technical requirements, and produces the evidence and

    application values.

  - Integrate battery management systems, power conversion systems, meters, inverters, EV chargers, and heat pumps through Modbus, vendor cloud APIs, and gateway hardware.

  - Build and operate the market-data pipelines (ENTSO-E, Svenska kraftnät, Nord Pool style sources) that feed spot, ancillary, and forecast views.

  - Extend the platform's agent layer: LLM-driven operations assistants, morning briefings, diagnosis and remediation workflows, and the AI workflow builder, using Claude on AWS Bedrock.

  - Run the AWS infrastructure with Terraform: EC2, IoT Core, ECR, S3, IAM, and the CI/CD pipeline that ships backend images and the Vercel-hosted frontend.

  - Keep the full-system test suite (app, broker, edge, database) green and extend it as the control loop grows.

  - Support commissioning of live BESS sites together with the operations and prequalification team, and investigate communication, control-system, and data issues in the field.

  - Set engineering standards for code review, testing, migrations, observability, and documentation, and grow the team as Evora scales.

  - Contribute technical expertise in customer discovery, partner integrations, and pre-sales discussions.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built and operated production software end to end and who is comfortable going from a battery's register map to a React component in the same day.

  You should have:

  - University degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, automation, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  - Several years of professional experience building and operating backend systems in Python, preferably with FastAPI or a similar async framework.

  - Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, and experience with time-series data at scale (TimescaleDB, continuous aggregates, compression, partitioning).

  - Experience building modern web frontends with TypeScript and React, preferably Next.js.

  - Experience with industrial or IoT communication: Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, or comparable protocols, and with software that runs on edge devices or gateways.

  - Experience running software on AWS or a comparable cloud, including infrastructure as code (Terraform), containers, and CI/CD.

  - Ability to read technical documentation, device specifications, and grid or market requirements, and turn them into working, tested software.

  - Experience leading technical work: setting architecture, reviewing code, and mentoring engineers.

  Meritorious experience

  It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:

  - Battery energy storage systems, EMS, BMS, PCS, meters, or other distributed energy resources.

  - Nordic ancillary-service markets and prequalification for FCR, aFRR, mFRR, or FFR.

  - Electricity-market data sources such as ENTSO-E, Svenska kraftnät, or Nord Pool.

  - LLM-based applications, tool-calling agents, or AI-assisted operational tooling.

  - Workflow or orchestration engines (Temporal or similar) and event-driven architectures.

  - Federated learning or privacy-preserving analytics on distributed data.

  - Edge hardware, balena or similar fleet management, and cellular gateways.

  - Full-system or hardware-in-the-loop testing of control systems.

Personal profile

You are technically hands-on and enjoy owning a system from the field device up to the user interface.

You work systematically, write code that others can read and test, and are comfortable investigating problems that span hardware, communications, databases, and user-facing product.

What we offer

  You will join Evora Labs at an early stage and take a central role in shaping how distributed energy assets are integrated, qualified, and operated through software.

  The position provides the opportunity to work across the whole stack, from Modbus registers on a battery site to market participation and AI-assisted operations, and to set the technical direction of a growing engineering team.

  The role is based in Stockholm.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer, powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data, and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach.

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions, across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

  • Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

  • Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

  • Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

  • Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems.

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential, with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

You will play a key role in delivering ML initiatives across the company, helping turn promising ideas into reliable production systems. You'll work on everything from model development and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, while contributing to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices

Your responsibilities

 

ML Systems & Delivery

  • Deliver end-to-end ML use cases (recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation models, etc.).

  • Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models where appropriate.

  • Balance speed of delivery with robustness and reliability.

ML Lifecycle & Reliability

  • Drive improvements across the ML lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring, iteration).

  • Establish KPIs and monitoring standards to track model performance over time.

  • Ensure continuous alignment with product and safety objectives.

  • Help improve the reliability and observability of production ML systems.

Platform & Standardization

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform through tools, workflows, and reusable components.

  • Help establish and promote scalable ML engineering practices across teams.

  • Contribute to improving self-service ML capabilities where relevant.

Legacy & Advanced Use Cases

  • Take ownership of legacy models and realign them with current business needs.

  • Improve, retrain, and integrate them into modern pipelines.

  • Contribute to best practices around LLM usage in moderation, recommendation, and other product domains.

  • Explore and implement advanced ML approaches where relevant.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering, MLOps, Backend Platform, and Product teams.

  • Act as a bridge between ML, platform, and business stakeholders.

  • Provide technical leadership on ML initiatives and help improve engineering practices across teams.

  • Share knowledge and help raise the overall ML maturity of the organization.

 

Our technical environment / ML scope

  • ML frameworks: PyTorch

  • Languages: Python (data stack)

  • Core topics: Neural networks, LLMs, data sampling

  • Use cases: Recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation

  • Ecosystem: Data Engineering, MLOps pipelines, Backend Platform

 

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in ML / Data, including work on large-scale datasets (datasets of hundreds of gigabytes).

  • You have strong expertise in modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch or JAX).

  • You are highly proficient in Python (data ecosystem).

  • You have strong knowledge of neural networks and practical experience with LLM-based systems.

  • You understand ML systems end-to-end (data → training → deployment → monitoring).

  • You have strong experience in production ML systems, not only research.

  • You demonstrate strong product sense and can align models with business needs.

  • You are pragmatic and impact-driven, balancing experimentation with delivery.

  • You are able to explain complex ML topics clearly (strong pedagogy).

  • You operate well under ambiguity and can structure complex problems.

  • You are able to drive technical decisions and influence stakeholders through expertise and collaboration.

 

In your first 6 months, you will

  • Deliver an end-to-end ML use case to validate impact and execution.

  • Audit and improve lifecycle management of existing ML models.

  • Refactor and retrain at least one legacy safety model.

  • Build reusable ML components that improve development efficiency across teams.

  • Improve monitoring and observability of production ML systems.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices.

  • Help move critical ML systems toward more reliable and measurable long-term operation.

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with a Talent Acquisition Manager

  • Interview with Mikael (Platform Engineering Director)

  • Technical case study

  • Cultural fit assessments

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A highly flexible remote work policy, 2 days at the office per month, with monthly team events.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

jobs.title: Scientific Product Director, Clinical Prediction
jobs.description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

Our clinical-prediction offer gives pharma partners the evidence to guide decisions before and during clinical development. We are looking for a Scientific Product Director to turn this science into sellable products: decide what gets developed and when, define what each capability can claim and output, and shape how results are delivered to partners.

You will report to Gustave Ronteix, CTO and co-founder, and work daily with a tight-knit interdisciplinary team composed of Computational Biology, Data Science, R&D, Platform Strategy & Operations, BD and Pharma Partnerships.

What you'll do

1. Own the product roadmap

  • Design and build a scalable product capable of derisking and accelerating clinical development of drug candidates based on Orakl’s scientific capabilities

  • Turn signals from BD, Pharma Partnerships and R&D into capability definitions: specs, target metrics, validation plan, in- vs out-of-scope definition, cost to deliver

  • Set priorities and dates with Engineering and Data Science; flag slippage early and make the trade-offs

  • Identify productization-gaps from delivery audits and analysis, and feed recurring ones back into the roadmap

2. Oversee product maturity and decide what we sell

  • Maintain the capability catalog: what is available now, in beta or on the roadmap, and what each can and cannot claim

  • Contribute to the final decision of when a capability is ready to sell (based on Data Science’s validation evidence) versus what is not-yet sellable in the pipeline, and communicate it internally

  • Oversee the scientific case for each capability: white papers, application notes, posters

3. Design how results reach partners

  • Design the reports, data packages and dashboards partners receive, and direct the engineers who build them

  • Own the deliverable contents: figures, statistical summaries, methods, limitations

  • Embed the approved claims and the QC checklist in every template, so Pharma Partnerships can produce a correct deliverable at scale

  • Keep templates current as the validated envelope changes, and pull or revise one when it no longer applies

What we're looking for

Must have

  • PhD or equivalent in cancer biology, pharmacology, biostatistics or computational biology

  • 8+ years in translational oncology, biomarker or diagnostics development, computational-biology platforms or preclinical CRO services, including 2+ owning a product roadmap

  • Technical depth: you read and understand production code, and can brief and review the work of engineers who build our reports and dashboards

  • You judge evidence: from a validation pack - back-tests, calibration, biomarker cutoffs -, you can state a claim the data supports and refuse the one it doesn't

  • You have experience working at the intersection of scientific and business departments within fast-growing companies

  • You know how pharma decides: you have seen proposals, SOWs and due-diligence questions, and know what a go/no-go decision needs from a prediction

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have

  • You have seen bespoke research work turned into something repeatable and sellable

  • Scientific authorship: Posters, talks, papers or white papers; a presence at AACR, ASCO, ESMO or SITC

  • Regulatory: exposure to regulated or quality-managed environments

  • Therapeutic or preclinical knowledge: ADC, immuno-oncology or targeted therapy; organoid or in-vitro pharmacology

  • Clinical-trial design or Trial statistics: adaptive designs, sample size, endpoints

  • Templated reporting: report-generation frameworks or web front-end

What we offer

  • Mission: work on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Ownership: a product function to build from the ground up.

  • Impact: pharma teams make real portfolio decisions with what you define.

  • Team: an exceptional crew of clinicians, biologists, engineers and data scientists, most with a PhD.

👉 More about Orakl here and here

Interview process

  1. Intro call (30 min) with Gustave Ronteix, CTO

  2. Case interview (1h)

  3. Case study (take-home)

  4. Conversations with BD, Pharma Partnerships, the Engineering / Data Science leads and Platform Strategy & Operations.

  5. References: 2-3, including a direct manager

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money. 



In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for a Sales Development Manager in New York, NY or San Francisco, CA that will recruit, develop, & lead a highly driven and hardworking team of Sales Development Representatives (Inbound) & Business Development Representatives (Outbound). We are looking for someone who is passionate about building a winning team and coaching & elevating the craft of new sellers at Notion. The Sales Development team is the first interaction with prospective Notion customers and is key to the success of our Sales organization!



At Notion the Sales Development team is responsible for driving new business opportunities and expanding market share through qualified pipeline, as well as driving the business forward by developing the next generation of top closers. As the Sales Development Lead you will be responsible for delivering both revenue and talent for our business. You will focus on the Recruitment, Enablement and Execution of your team to assure the continued successful trajectory of this strategically important department.



Our ideal candidate for this role has proven experience in managing, building and encouraging a team to achieve daily, weekly and monthly/quarterly targets in addition to delivering feedback to marketing and sales operations about lead quality and process improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 1. As an AMER Sales Development Manager, you will work directly with Sales Managers, cross functionally with Marketing Leadership, & Revenue Operations Leadership in creating and developing Notion’s Sales Development strategy, process and playbooks

 2. Partnering with regional leaders across Sales Strategy, Marketing, and Sales teams to plan territory mapping and pipeline development programs

 5. Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to ensure we capitalize on the massive market opportunity ahead of us

 6. Help build the foundations of Sales at Notion: As an early member of our sales org, you'll be instrumental in helping define our sales assisted motions.

 7. Join a fantastic team at a magical time: We've hit profitability and over 100 million users with a small team, which gives us a huge green field to work with. You'll join at the perfect time to shape how we grow from here.

 8. Meaningfully shape our future product: As you engage with customers, you'll gain insights to help us serve them better — and work with the product to inform what we do next.

 9. Elevate your skills as we tackle our most impactful challenges: We've achieved more than teams 10x our size in less time — and there's so much more to do and learn.
    
    


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Experience including either
   
   - 1-2 years managing a high-performing Sales Development team
   
   - 1-2 years Account Executive experience (and strong performance) at a SaaS company; after having successfully made the leap from Sales Development to Account Executive 

 - Strong track record of achieving sales targets across team and individual goals

 - Skilled in managing and coaching early-career salespeople

 - You have strong, recognized leadership skills with a focus on empowerment, positive mindsets, collaboration, and the ability to inspire a team of direct reports

 - You are comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of a high growth startup

 - You have a growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of an early stage team

 - You view setbacks as learning opportunities, not failures

 - You have a high EQ and exceptional interpersonal skills, the ability to manage influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building

 - You have an analytical mindset and enjoy problem-solving as part of a regional leadership team

 - You have strong empathy for customers and a passion for revenue and growth

 - You have a good understanding of value selling

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've built new business sales playbooks or processes

 - You've been a first or early hire at a fast-growing start-up before

 - Experience leading and improving Sales Development critical metrics

 - Experience running successful weekly and monthly team meetings

jobs.title: Geophysicist within exploration
jobs.description:
Combine geophysical analysis with hands-on fieldwork and contribute to mineral exploration in a varied role with excellent opportunities to grow.

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

As a Geophysicist within our Mineral Exploration team, you will bridge the gap between advanced data processing and practical field operations. Your responsibilities naturally follow the seasons—dedicating summer periods to dynamic fieldwork and ground data acquisition and focusing during the winter months on comprehensive data processing, 3D modelling, interpretation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    Data Processing & Interpretation: Process, model, and interpret multidisciplinary geophysical data to delineate targets and refine geological models.
    Field Acquisition: Lead and participate in hands-on geophysical surveys and data collection campaigns across active exploration sites.
    Exploration Strategy: Provide critical geophysical insight to optimize drilling programs and advance mineral exploration initiatives.
    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with exploration geologists and specialists across LKAB, including geotechnics and mining operations.
    Project Participation: Engage flexibly in a wide variety of project stages as organizational needs and strategic exploration priorities evolve.

You will work both independently and together with others. Close collaboration with fellow geophysicists, geologists and field technicians is essential for success in this role, as exploration projects rely on combining different areas of expertise and perspectives. The varied assignments and opportunities to participate in different projects provide excellent potential to develop within your professional field.

What you bring

We are looking for a geophysicist who thrives in a dynamic environment where fieldwork, data interpretation and collaboration go hand in hand. You have a structured and solution-oriented way of working, communicate your findings clearly and can translate complex data into valuable insights. You enjoy working closely with colleagues from different disciplines and contribute to a collaborative team environment. You are reflective and thoughtful in your decision-making, with an ability to balance technical opportunities with responsible use of resources to create sustainable and effective exploration solutions.

We are looking for someone who has:

    Education: Higher university degree in geophysics. Strong background in physics.
    Experience in mineral exploration: Candidates with several years of relevant experience in mineral exploration will be given preference. However, all applications will be considered and reviewed based on the overall qualifications and experience of the candidate.
    Good spoken and written english
    Valid B driving licence for manual transmission vehicles

It is an advantadge if you have:

    Geophysical Software:Proficiency in industry-standard software packages such as Oasis montaj (Seequent), Mira Geoscience, Leapfrog Geo, Maxwell, ModelVision,GeoTools.
    Electromagnetic Methods: Practical and theoretical experience with EM methods, with particular emphasis on Magnetotellurics (MT / AMT).
    Proficiency in Swedish, or a genuine willingness to learn.

What we offer

In addition to the general benefits we offer — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer the following to those who do not currently live in Sweden:

    Relocation support for you and your family.
    Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs.
    LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture.
    The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days.

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Start: According to agreement

Location: Kiruna

Type of Employment: Permanent, full-time monday-friday, daytime

Contact: For more information about the position, please contact our hiring manager Ana Braña Bergshjort ana.brana.bergshjorth@lkab.com

Please submit your application by date 8/11-2026.

Union representatives Kiruna/ Svappavaara:

    Sakari Alanko, Unionen, +46 980-725 08
    Ledarna Norra, ledarna.norra@lkab.com
    Peter Johansson, Akademikerföreningen, +46 980-718 79

At LKAB, we are leading the transformation of our industry toward a sustainable future. Just as we aim to reshape the world, we are committed to developing every individual on our team, both personally and professionally. Are you ready to help shape the future of the mining and mineral industry?

jobs.description:

Suomen vuodenaikojen vaihtelevuus on rikkaus, mutta se asettaa haasteita pukeutumiselle. Kotimaisena myymälänä tunnemme Suomen sääolosuhteiden vaatimukset parhaiten, ja Luhta Brand Store tekeekin muodikkaan käytännöllisestä pukeutumisesta helppoa.

Haemme Rovaniemen Luhta Brand Store myymälään myyjää 15h/vko määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen

Oletko energinen, luonteeltaan palvelualtis, oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen asiakaspalvelija? Jos vastasit kyllä, niin tämä tilaisuus voisi olla sinua varten!

Millaiseen rooliin olisit tulossa meille?

Myyjän tehtävissä toimit vastuullisena myyjänä asiakaspalvelutyössä noudattaen ketjun asiakaslupauksen ja asiakastyytyväisyys-tavoitteiden mukaisia toimintaohjeita. Myyjä toteuttaa myyntityössä ketjukonseptin mukaista myynnin toimintamallia. Yrityksemme arvot, sisäinen yrittäjyys, uudistuminen, yhdessä tekeminen ja vastuunotto, ohjaavat sitä, miten saavutamme tavoitteemme.

Myymälämme täydentää jokaisen vaatekaapin kengistä asusteisiin. Aina ajanmukaisesta tarjonnasta on helppo löytää toimivia asukokonaisuuksia ulkoiluun ja vapaa-aikaan – niin luonnonhelmaan kuin kaupungillekin, kotioloihin ja harrastuksiin. Kotimaisuus näkyy myös tuotevalikoimassamme: Luhdan laajan malliston lisäksi löydät myymälästä laadukkaita tuotteita monilta muilta kotimaisilta merkeiltä, joihin lukeutuvat muun muassa Icepeak, Rukka ja Your FACE

Tehtävä on määräaikainen sesonkiapu, keskimäärin 15h/vko sopimustunneilla. Käytössämme on 26 viikon tasoittumisjakso. Määräaikaisuuden kesto on 14.3.2027 saakka.

Miten onnistut parhaiten tässä tehtävässä?

Onnistut tehtävässä parhaiten, jos työssäsi olet joustava, ennakkoluuloton, rohkea ja työnteosta innostuva tiimipelaaja sekä asiakaspalveluhenkinen ammattilainen. Työ sopii hyvin esim. opiskelijalle tai lisätunteja haluavalle.

Sinulla on kyky kohdata ihmisiä palveluhenkisessä ilmapiirissä, haluat kehittyä työssäsi, nautit myyntityöstä ja olet asenteeltasi positiivinen ja helposti lähestyttävä. Motivoidut huipputuloksista ja olet valmis tekemään töitä niiden eteen.

Edellytämme hakijoilta täysi-ikäisyyttä ja sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Sinulla pitäisi olla joustavuutta tehdä työvuoroja myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuina. Katsomme kokemuksen kaupan alalta eduksesi.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme sinulle hyvän perehdytyksen ja monipuolisen myyjän tehtävänkuvan ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä. Meillä pääset työskentelemään mukavien työkavereiden ja asiakkaiden sekä laadukkaiden, tunnettujen ja kotimaisten brändien parissa.

Meillä pääset tekemään asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityötä sekä naisten että miesten vaatteiden, mutta myös jalkineiden parissa. Työhösi kuuluvat myös muut myymälätyöskentelyyn liittyvät tehtävät myymälässä ja kassalla ja huolehdit myymälän perusrutiinien ylläpidosta päivittäisessä työssäsi.

Tarjoamme sinulle Kaupan työehtosopimuksen (B) mukaisen palkan ja yrityksen henkilöstöedut.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jos kiinnostuit tästä mahdollisuudesta, lähetäthän hakemuksesi liitteineen mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 20.10.2026. Huomioithan, että hakemus tulee jättää rekrytointijärjestelmämme osoitteessa https://careers.luhta.com [https://careers.luhta.com/].

Tarkoituksenamme on edetä rekrytoinnissa mahdollisimman nopeasti ja pidämme haastatteluita sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä jo hakuaikana. Viestimme kanssasi muun muassa sähköpostitse, joten tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi. Ilmoitamme kaikille hakijoille rekrytoinnin etenemisestä mahdollisimman pian hakuajan päättymisen jälkeen.

Työ alkaa: mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan

Työaika: keskimäärin 15h/vko, käytössä 26 viikon tasoittumisjakso

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across multiple industries—empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities.

Overview:

We are looking for a world-class robotics professionals to join our R&D hub in the Zurich area. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that enable robots to understand and interact with the world with unprecedented generalization. You will work on the intersection of large-scale foundation models and real-world robotic execution, bridging the gap between state-of-the-art research and deployed embodied intelligence.

Your Responsibilities:

Research & Development:

  • Design, implement, and scale VLA models and foundation architectures for robotic manipulation and navigation.

Scaling Laws & Data:

  • Develop strategies for multi-modal data collection, synthetic data generation, and efficient fine-tuning of large-scale models.

Algorithm Optimization:

  • Optimize model inference for real-time robotic applications without compromising reasoning capabilities.

Publication & Visibility:

  • Contribute to the global research community by publishing high-impact papers at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, CVPR, ICRA, CoRL, etc.).

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with the Core Robotics and Hardware teams to integrate AI models into our physical platforms.

Qualifications:

Academic Excellence:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field, with a focus on Deep Learning and Computer Vision.

Proven Research Track Record:

  • Significant publications and citations at major conferences such as NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, IROS, or CoRL.

Professional Background:

  • Experience working in leading AI research environments

Technical Mastery:

  • Deep expertise in PyTorch or JAX, experience with Transformers, Diffusion Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Domain Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Vision-Language models and their application to Action/Control loops in robotics.

Location:

Zurich Area, Switzerland:

  • This role is based in our Zurich office, offering a vibrant ecosystem for robotics and AI.

What We Offer:

  • Free meals at the workplace.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home when needed.

  • Direct collaboration with founders and world-leading AI experts.

  • Access to large-scale compute clusters and proprietary robotic datasets.

  • A key role in shaping the future of embodied AI.

  • Competitive compensation and a relocation package for the Zurich area

LÄHIHOITAJA, tule mukaan Kerttulankaareen!

Työhösi kuuluu tehtäviä sekä ympärivuorokautisen hoivan, kuin yhteisöllisen asumisen puolella.

Meille on tärkeintä, että jokainen asukas saa elää turvallista, arvokasta, yksilöllistä elämää ja että työntekijämme viihtyvät ja voivat hyvin työssään. Työkavereiksi etsimme hyviä tyyppejä.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu ikäihmisten päivittäinen hoito ja avustaminen, lääkehoidon toteuttaminen ja yhteistyö muun hoitohenkilökunnan kanssa.

Tarjoamme avoimen ja joustavan työilmapiirin, mukavat työkaverit, toimivan työympäristön, lakisääteistä laajemmat työterveyspalvelut, ateriaedun sekä ePassin ylläpitämään työkykyäsi! Tehtävään valittavan henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuajalla.

Hyvinvointikeskus Kerttulankaari on suunniteltu ikäihmisten pitkäaikaisasumiseen. Hyvinvointikodit Kerttu ja Kaapo käsittävät yhteensä 60 ympärivuorokautisen palveluasumisen paikkaa. Hyvinvointikeskuksessa on myös 43 yhteisölliseen palveluasumiseen suunniteltua vuokrattavaa senioriasuntoa.

Olemme savuton työpaikka. Myös hyvinvointikeskusten ja -kotien pihapiirit kuuluvat savuttomaan alueeseen.

Ikifit on täysin kotimainen, ikäihmisten palvelujen ammattilainen. Päätehtävämme on tuottaa korkealaatuista, kokonaisvaltaista ja yksilöllistä palvelua asiakkaillemme. Monipuoliset palvelumme parantavat ikäihmisen arkea ja elämänlaatua.

jobs.title: Construction & Facilities Manager (12-Month Parental Cover)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Construction & Facilities Manager to plan, coordinate, and manage how Axel Arigato physical spaces are built, refurbished, and maintained - from stores to showrooms and pop-ups. Do you like seeing a project through from first plan to opening day, on time and on budget? You’ll own the budget for these spaces, working closely with contractors, landlords and teams across the business to keep each one safe, functional and well maintained. It’s a year of growth: three new US projects are live, and European expansion into the UK is underway. Come join us.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This role suits someone who stays calm under pressure and is organized by default. You plan carefully, follow through, and keep contractors, landlords and colleagues aligned when timelines get tight. You’re comfortable managing external partners across several markets, you hold suppliers to a clear standard, and you look for ways to make each project run smoother than the last.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

    

Own time schedules, RACI, budgets, labor and risk mitigation plans for every construction and refurbishment project.

    

Lead projects from start to close-out, coordinating subcontractors and keeping landlords, contractors and internal stakeholders updated on progress.

    

Review, adapt and execute lease, supplier and maintenance agreements through a transparent procurement process that reduces business risk.

    

Run snag, punch and QC reports and follow up on execution, so every store opens to standard.

    

Manage preventive and corrective maintenance with our facilities partners in the US and EU, tracking both performance and cost.

    

Bring commercial design feedback into each project to keep store quality and customer experience consistent.

    

Set and follow up department goals each quarter, making responsibilities clear and ensuring tools and resources to deliver.

    

Partner with other departments to share knowledge and improve how we work together.

ARE YOU THE ONE?

We seek people with most of the following:

    

A background in building and construction, through PMP or similar training in construction or facilities management, or 5+ years of experience in retail construction or facilities management.

    

Experience leading a team or working in a similar role.

    

A solid understanding of construction and maintenance requirements for commercial spaces.

    

Experience managing external service providers across multiple markets.

    

Strong time management and clear, confident verbal communication.

    

A problem-solving mindset and the initiative to act on it.

    

Familiarity with lean and/or agile ways of working.

    

Confidence in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, with AutoCAD, SketchUp or Asana as a plus.

HERE’S HOW TO APPLY

If you want to shape how our physical spaces are built and cared for, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply by submitting your CV in English. Please do not include a photo or date of birth with your application; our recruitment process is competency-based.

We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

CONTRACT TYPE & START DATE

Estimated starting date: January 2027. Contract type: Fixed-term contract for 12 months, covering parental leave. Full-time. Location: Gothenburg, Sweden. On-site at our central office.

A BIT ABOUT AXEL ARIGATO

Founded in Sweden in 2014 by Albin Johansson and Max Svärdh, Axel Arigato was born with a disruptive mindset, modernising and democratising the sneaker landscape through a blend of style, quality, community and a digital-first approach.

Grounded in Scandinavian minimalism and elevated with playful, intentional details, every piece is designed with care: crafted to move globally, worn with individuality.

What began online expanded into physical spaces built for energetic cultural exchange: stores and experiences where conversations, performances and unexpected activations dissolve the boundaries between brand and culture.

Today, Axel Arigato continues to evolve with purpose via a people-powered approach. It shows up where culture happens: on streets, at events and across cities.

Built on curiosity. Driven by connection.

OUR VALUES

DROP: Diversity, Respect, Openness and Passion are our core values. They are the foundation for our current state and what we will always bring with us to the future.

jobs.title: Rakennesuunnittelun projektipäällikkö, betonirakenteet
jobs.description:
Oletko kokenut rakennesuunnittelija, joka haluaa yhdistää projektien vetämisen ja vaativan betonirakenteiden suunnittelun? Haluaisitko vastata hankkeiden suunnittelukokonaisuuksista niin, että johdat tiimiä, mutta pysyt samalla kiinni myös itse suunnittelutyössä?
Haemme Seinäjoen tiimiimme rakennesuunnittelun projektipäällikköä monipuolisiin suunnitteluprojekteihin.
Rakennesuunnittelun projektipäällikkönä johdat rakennesuunnittelua hankkeiden alusta loppuun. Vastaat suunnittelun kokonaisuudesta, ohjaat suunnitteluryhmää, huolehdit aikatauluista ja resursseista sekä pidät aktiivisesti yhteyttä asiakkaaseen ja muihin sidosryhmiin. Osallistut myös itse suunnitteluun ja varmistat, että ratkaisut ovat teknisesti korkeatasoisia ja toteutuskelpoisia.
Tehtäväkuvaa voidaan räätälöidä oman erikoistumisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan. Meille on tärkeää mahdollistaa kehittymisen ja kasvun paikkoja – saat projekteja, jotka vastaavat kokemus- ja osaamistasoasi ja tarjoavat tilaisuuksia oppia uutta. Emme pelkää antaa vastuuta ja luotamme osaajiimme.
Työskentelemme 28 paikkakunnalla, joista oma toimipisteesi sijaitsee Seinäjoella.
Avaimia tehtävässä menestymiseen
Projektipäällikön tehtävässä edellytämme vähintään kahdeksan vuoden kokemusta betonirakenteiden rakennesuunnittelusta, sisältäen myös projektipäällikön vastuita. Koulutustaustasi on soveltuva rakennusalalta (DI / RI / Ins. AMK), ja hallitset niin statiikan perusteet kuin kantavien rakenteiden mitoituksen. Käytät sujuvasti Office-työkaluja sekä AutoCAD- tai Tekla Structures -ohjelmistoa. RFEMin ja muiden alan ohjelmistojen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Sinulla on erittäin vaativien betonirakenteiden suunnittelijan pätevyys tai edellytykset hakea pätevyyttä.
Koska teet paljon yhteistyötä paitsi Swecolaisten kollegoidesi myös asiakkaiden kanssa, tarvitset hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja kykyä viestiä sujuvasti ja selkeästi suomen kielellä. Toimit luontevasti osana tiimiä, mutta et kaihda myöskään itsenäisiä työtehtäviä. Otat vastuun omasta suunnittelutyöstäsi etkä arkaile keksiä uusia tapoja tehdä asioita. Avoin suhtautuminen ja kiinnostus erilaisia rakennesuunnittelun tehtäviä kohtaan auttaa sinua menestymään työssäsi.
Mitä lupaamme sinulle
- Mutkaton Sweco-porukka. Olet osa mutkatonta työyhteisöämme, jossa työilmapiirin pinnalla päällimmäisenä väreilee välittömyys ja kunnioitus toisiamme kohtaan. Tuemme, arvostamme ja kannustamme toisiamme – siihen voit luottaa.
- Transforming society together. Swecolla olet mukana luomassa tulevaisuuden kaupunkeja ja kestävämpää yhteiskuntaa – olet oikeasti vaikuttamassa. Olet tärkeässä roolissa edesauttamassa ja mahdollistamassa liiketoimintaa, jossa konkreettisesti rakennetaan kestävämpää ja toimivampaa yhteiskuntaa päivittäisessä työssä, tuhansilla suunnittelupöydillä, työmailla ja studioilla ympäri Suomen.
- Maailma avoinna. Swecolaisia on yhteensä 23 000 ympäri Euroopan, ja Suomessa meitä on 28 paikkakunnalla 3 300 henkeä. Kansainvälinen ja laaja organisaatiomme tarjoaa mahdollisuuksia työskennellä eurooppalaisten kollegojen kanssa – tai vaihtaa toimipistettä Suomessa elämäntilanteesi mukaan.
- Oma urapolku ja koulutusmahdollisuudet. Meille on tärkeää, että pääset kehittymään ja suunnittelemaan omannäköistä urapolkua ja tässä me kuuntelemme sinua. Monipuolisia koulutusmahdollisuuksia sinulle tarjoaa oman Sweco Akatemiamme koulutustarjonta.
- Monipuolinen ja kattava henkilöstöetukokonaisuus, jonka sisältöön pystyt itse vaikuttamaan.
- Työnantajana olemme joustava, ja työsi ja yksityiselämäsi kestävä yhteensovittaminen on meille prioriteetti. Työtä teemme siellä, missä se on mielekkäintä hybridityöskentelyn käytäntöjämme hyödyntäen.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, EMEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Notion EMEA Recruiting team acts as trusted business partners who craft a thorough, inclusive, and curated interviewing experience. We believe hiring exceptional talent, at the right time, is the best path forward to achieve our company’s ambitious goals.


We’re looking for a Go-to-Market Recruiter to support our growth across key Go-to-Market (GTM) teams in EMEA, with an emphasis on Sales. In this role, you'll help shape our recruiting strategy, manage full-cycle hiring efforts, and ensure a delightful yet rigorous hiring process.
We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to leaders across the GTM org, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing through successful close

 - Design and implement creative sourcing strategies to attract diverse top talent across EMEA markets

 - Ensure scalable and structured hiring plans with consistent evaluation processes while creating thoughtful candidate experiences

 - Partner with cross-functional teams including Total Rewards, People Operations, and People Partners to drive holistic talent strategies

 - Leverage AI tools, to innovate recruiting processes and provide data-driven insights on market conditions

 - Champion and scale best practices while thoughtfully adapting for regional nuances




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, GTM functions

 - Proven track record of identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional talent across various levels

 - Experience coaching and advising hiring managers through our recruiting process while keeping talent density as a priority

 - Ability to build diverse candidate pipelines and guide hiring managers in creating inclusive teams

 - Outstanding communication, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality recruiting experiences

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes

 - Fluency in an additional European language

The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €85,000 - €95,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS
