jobs.title: Quality Technician to CLC1, Lund
jobs.description:
Would you like to contribute to developing quality, processes and ways of working in a global organization where continuous improvement is a natural part of everyday operations?

We are currently looking for an engaged and driven Quality Technician for CLC1 (Configuration and Logistics Center) at Axis. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with operations, has a structured approach and is motivated by creating sustainable improvements.

About CLC1
At CLC1 (Configuration and Logistics Center), we are responsible for warehousing, production and distribution of products to Axis subsidiaries and customers around the world. We also provide services to other parts of Axis and continuously develop our processes, methods and ways of working to meet future requirements.

With us, you will have the opportunity to work in a modern, technology-driven environment together with dedicated colleagues who continuously strive for improvement and high quality.

Your Role
As a Quality Technician, you play a central role in the CLC1 organization, ensuring that our processes and quality routines function effectively and are followed in daily operations. You will serve as an important link between Supply Chain Quality (SCQ) and the CLC1 organization and actively contribute to developing our quality work.

The position is full-time and based on site at CLC1, with no hybrid work option. It reports to the CLC1 Manager.

Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will among other things:

* Ensure that work instructions and process documentation are up to date at CLC1, relevant and effective in supporting the business.

* Structure, develop and maintain onboarding and buddy program materials.

* Act as the SPOC (Single Point of Contact) between CLC1 and Supply Chain Quality (SCQ).

* Administer and follow up on NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports).

* Follow up on quality deviations, identify root causes and drive corrective actions.

* Actively work with continuous improvements in quality, processes and ways of working.

* Monitor and maintain compliance with ISO 14001 requirements within the organization.

* Support the organization in quality-related matters and contribute to a strong quality culture.

Who Are You?
We are looking for someone with a strong quality mindset and a genuine interest in continuous improvement. You are structured, analytical and able to transform identified improvement opportunities into concrete actions. At the same time, you are communicative and enjoy collaborating with many different functions and stakeholders.

We believe that you:

* Are detail-oriented and work systematically.

* Have strong analytical skills and the ability to find sustainable solutions.

* Take initiative and enjoy driving activities forward.

* Are skilled at creating structure and documenting processes.

* Are a team player with strong collaboration skills.

We Would Like You to Have

* Experience in quality management, process development or similar roles.

* Strong administrative skills and experience working with documentation.

* Good communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Meritorious

* Experience working with the IFS ERP system.

* Experience with ISO 14001.

* Knowledge of Lean and improvement methodologies such as A3 problem solving, Fishbone Analysis or similar tools.

Requirements

* Previous experience from manufacturing, logistics or warehouse operations.

Why Axis?
At Axis, you will have the opportunity to influence and develop operations within an international organization characterized by innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement. You will become an important part of a team where quality and development are in focus and where your ideas and initiatives make a difference.

Application
Does this sound like the right role for you? Welcome with your application!

Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so do not wait to submit your application. The position may be filled before the application deadline.

In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Petter Lindh at +46735843762

jobs.title: Struktureret cybersikkerhedskonsulent til nyoprettet stilling
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at styrke cybersikkerheden i en organisation, hvor it understøtter uddannelse, forskning og professionel praksis hver dag? I Team IT udvider vi teamet med en kollega, der får en central rolle i arbejdet med governance, risk og compliance inden for cybersikkerhed.

Som vores nye cybersikkerhedskonsulent bliver du bindeled mellem sikkerhedskrav, it-løsninger samt den praktiske hverdag i organisationen. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores informationssikkerhedskonsulent og øvrige kolleger i Team IT, hvor systemadministratorer og andre tekniske specialister bidrager til implementering og tekniske kontroller. Din opgave bliver at skabe struktur, overblik og sikre fremdrift på vores cybersikkerhed, så politikker, retningslinjer og kontroller bliver konkrete, dokumenterede og anvendelige i praksis.

Din profil
Du trives i krydsfeltet mellem cybersikkerhed, dokumentation, risikostyring og organisatorisk forankring. Du skal ikke være den, der selv konfigurerer alle tekniske løsninger - men du skal kunne forstå sikkerhedskravene godt nok til at omsætte dem til klare politikker, retningslinjer, kontroller og opfølgningsaktiviteter.

Du er analytisk, struktureret og god til at skabe fremdrift i opgaver, hvor der både er behov for overblik, dokumentation og dialog med forskellige fagligheder. Du kan kommunikere klart med både tekniske specialister og administrativt personale, undervisere og forskere. Du har lyst til at være med til at opbygge en ny funktion, hvor rammer, metoder, arbejdsgange og organisationen skal modnes over tid.

Du har erfaring med implementering af CIS18 kontrollerne eller statens tekniske minimumskrav til it-sikkerhed og også gerne ISO 27001/27002. Har du samtidig viden om informationssikkerhed og GDPR, er det et plus. Det vigtigste er dog, at du har interesse og erfaring indenfor cybersikkerhed og kan omsætte krav og rammeværk til noget, der kan bruges i en travl it-organisation.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Stillingen er ny, og du får derfor mulighed for at være med til at præge både indhold, prioriteringer og arbejdsform i samarbejde med resten af teamet. Opgaverne vil udvikle sig, men vil blandt andet omfatte:
  • Udarbejdelse, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af politikker, retningslinjer og procedurer inden for cybersikkerhed.
  • Opbygning og dokumentation af kontroller, der understøtter compliance med relevante sikkerhedskrav og rammeværk.
  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af udvalgte kontroller, herunder opfølgning på observationer, afvigelser og forbedringstiltag.
  • Samarbejde med systemadministratorer om tekniske kontroller, hvor du bidrager med krav, dokumentation og opfølgning, mens den tekniske implementering typisk udføres i driftsmiljøet.
  • Gap-analyser, modenhedsvurderinger og opfølgning i forhold til CIS18, statens tekniske minimumskrav og relevante dele af ISO 27001/27002.
  • Bidrag til risikovurderinger, beslutningsgrundlag og prioritering af sikkerhedstiltag.
  • Understøttelse af audit-, tilsyns- og complianceaktiviteter med dokumentation og statusoverblik.
  • Tæt samarbejde med informationssikkerhedskonsulenten om sammenhængen mellem cybersikkerhed, informationssikkerhed, GDPR og organisatoriske krav.
  • Formidling og awareness af sikkerhedskrav og anbefalinger på cybersikkerhedsområdet, så de bliver forståelige og anvendelige for både it-kolleger og øvrige dele af organisationen.

Dine kolleger
I Digital er vi 27 medarbejdere fordelt på 3 teams, der brænder for at lave gode digitale løsninger til hele Absalon. Vi har et bredt katalog af services og kompetencer i brugersupport, netværk, systemudvikling, projektledelse, didaktik, læringsteknologier, digitalisering, rapportering, analyser med mere.

Vi anstrenger os for at være servicemindede og kompetente partnere, i alt hvad vi laver. Vi har en uhøjtidelig omgangsform og vores lattermuskler er veltrænede. Vi nyder gerne kage, men vi har også en sund og varieret kantineordning og mulighed for at træne i vores fitnesslokale eller på de mange trapper, der er på campus. Vi holder til på Absalons nye campus lige ved Slagelse station, og du vil få en af Slagelses bedste udsigter fra dit skrivebord.

Stillingen hører til i Team IT, hvis primære ansvarsområder er server- og netværksdrift, devicehåndtering, cybersikkerhed, support, integrationer, informationssikkerhed m.v.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest den 1. januar 2027.
  • Afhængigt af din anciennitet og uddannelsesbaggrund vil en forventet løn ligge mellem 35.000 kr. og 45.000 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension. Hertil kommer der et pensionsbidrag på 16,68% eller 18,07% afhængig af din uddannelsesbaggrund.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder Brian Andersen på telefon 7248 3037 eller bran@pha.dk.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 9. november 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler den 16. november og evt. 2. samtaler den 23. november.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: ADAS System Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects since 2007 – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential.

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience.

We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:

Brief Call: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris Consulting: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!

Case study: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.

As every role is different, we adapt the process accordingly, always focusing on the best possible candidate experience. We look forward to meeting you!

Job description

Join Amaris Consulting as an consultant for one of our clients, specialized in ADAS System Engineer and contribute to high-impact automotive projects within the Engineering scope. You will support the design and specification of software requirements for driver information systems, with a focus on ADAS Surround View features and seamless integration across existing and future vehicle models.

Your missions

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

RaySearch is expanding its machine learning capabilities and is looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to join our headquarters in Stockholm. This is an office-first role.

You will help build our model development platform: the systems that take clinical data through curation, training and validation to deployed models. Our deep learning models are used in RayStation, our treatment planning system, at cancer clinics worldwide. The platform you build is how the next generation of these models gets made.

This is not primarily a model development role. Your focus is the platform, data and infrastructure that let ML engineers develop, validate and deploy models reliably.

About the job

You will join RaySearch's Machine Learning department and help build a platform that covers the full model lifecycle, from clinical data coming in to validated models going out.

The work spans:

    Data curation and management: ingesting, organizing and validating large clinical datasets and medical images, with ETL, databases and storage that keep track of where data came from and how it was used.
    Model training: reproducible training pipelines orchestrated with Flyte, for dose prediction, segmentation, detection, classification and image registration, with monitoring of training runs.
    Validation: automated evaluation and reporting that connects data, method, code and results, including web-based tools for reviewing images, contours, radiotherapy plans and validation outcomes.
    Deployment and ML integration: getting models into production and integrated into our software products, including inference optimization.
    Operations: monitoring training and evaluation runs, keeping services and databases up to date, and troubleshooting when things go wrong.
    The platform is used by multiple teams and projects, so good design matters: well-designed APIs, solid documentation and reliable services. You will own services from design to operation and work closely with ML engineers, software developers, infrastructure teams, medical physicists and product teams.

Your profile

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys building systems that help others do their best work. You are pragmatic: you know when a simple solution is enough and when the problem needs a more scalable architecture. You care about reliability, automation and developer experience. You like building platforms that are robust and well-designed enough to serve many different users.

You don't need to spend your days training neural networks. You do understand how ML development differs from traditional software engineering, and you find problems like reproducibility, data lineage, model versioning, large datasets and GPU workloads interesting.

Requirements

    M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning or equivalent experience, and at least 5 years of professional software engineering.
    Strong Python skills and experience designing backend services and APIs.
    Solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling, such as PostgreSQL.
    Experience with containers, for example Docker, and with designing, running and troubleshooting production services.
    Good engineering practices: automated testing, code review, CI/CD and observability.
    Experience contributing to architecture decisions in large, shared codebases.
    Excellent spoken and written English.

Meriting

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:

    ML platforms and MLOps tooling, such as MLflow and experiment tracking.
    PyTorch, and model deployment or inference optimization, such as TensorRT.
    Workflow orchestration and ETL. We use Flyte, but experience with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster or similar is just as relevant.
    Kubernetes, cloud platforms and infrastructure as code.
    Designing platforms and APIs used by many teams or users, including access control and security.
    Operating production services with high reliability requirements.
    Web application development.
    Medical imaging (DICOM, RT structures), healthcare technology or other regulated, safety-critical environments.

Our Culture 

At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide. 

Our Offer 

We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package. 

Application 

Please apply for the position through the application form below. Selection and interviews will be ongoing. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

jobs.title: Consultant Interventional Cardiologist
jobs.description:
Consultant Interventional Cardiologist – PCI On-Call Service

Department of Cardiology, Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark

The opportunity
Are you an experienced interventional cardiologist looking to join a highly specialised university hospital with a strong clinical, academic and collaborative environment?

The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is seeking one or more Consultant Interventional Cardiologists from the EU/EØS to join our team. We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.

The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.

This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.

The position
Your primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.
Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.

Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.

What we offer
  • The opportunity to work in a busy university hospital with an established PCI service and a broad range of specialised cardiology services.
  • Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
  • A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.
  • An academic environment: Opportunities to participate in clinical research, teaching and the development of new treatment pathways.
  • Supportive colleagues and leadership: We value professional respect, constructive collaboration and a positive working environment.
  • Flexible working arrangements: Working hours and duty schedules are organised within the applicable employment framework.
  • An international perspective: The opportunity to join a university hospital committed to clinical excellence, research, education and continuous improvement.

Qualifications and experience
Essential requirements
  • You hold specialist certification in cardiology.
  • You have or are able to obtain a Danish Authorization to practice medicine
  • You are fluent in or command a professional working proficiency in Danish. Norwegian or Swedish (B2/C1 level)
  • Or are willing to learn Danish
  • You can perform PCI procedures independently.
  • You have the clinical judgement and professional skills required to manage patients with ischaemic heart disease.
  • You communicate effectively and work constructively with colleagues across clinical disciplines.
  • You can maintain an overview and make sound clinical decisions in a demanding and sometimes unpredictable environment.
  • You are committed to high standards of patient care, patient safety and continuous professional development.
  • You are willing to contribute to the department's clinical, organisational and educational activities and to take on the leadership and supervisory responsibilities associated with a consultant position.

Desirable qualifications
  • Experience participating in a PCI on-call service.
  • Experience from a university hospital or another highly specialised cardiac centre.
  • Experience in complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
  • A PhD, or other research qualifications or a strong record of scientific publications.
  • Experience in clinical research, teaching or quality improvement.
  • Experience in a PCI on-call service is an advantage but is not essential, provided you are an independent PCI operator and are motivated to acquire the necessary competencies following an appropriate period of training and induction.

About the Department
The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is a large, specialised and research-active department providing advanced care across a broad range of cardiovascular conditions, including ischaemic heart disease, cardiac arrhythmias, heart failure, valvular heart disease, thoracic aortic aneurysms, pericardial diseases, thromboembolic disorders and dyslipidaemia.

Our department performs approximately:
  • 6,000 invasive procedures annually
  • 8,000 inpatient admissions annually
  • More than 30,000 outpatient consultations annually
  • Approximately 14,000 echocardiographic examinations annually

Our medical team comprises doctors at different stages of postgraduate training and 32 consultant cardiologists, including two professors.
We provide inpatient and outpatient services, operate a cardiac catheterisation laboratory and maintain a dedicated cardiology research unit.
Our work is guided by a shared commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and involving patients and their families in shared decision-making. We also have a strong responsibility for undergraduate medical education and postgraduate specialist training.
The department operates across three hospital sites in Aalborg, Thisted and Hobro, with the vast majority of clinical activity based at the newly built Aalborg University Hospital.

Salary and terms of employment
This is a full-time position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable Danish collective agreement.
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.
Further details regarding the on-call arrangement and employment conditions can be discussed with the Head of Department or Lead Senior Physician Bent Raungaard tlf. 27201096, e-mail: b.raungaard@rn.dk
 
Application
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be arranged continuously. The advertisement will be withdrawn once the position has been filled.
Please submit your application by email to:
Ljubica Vukelic Andersen
Head of Department of Cardiology
Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark
Email: ljubica.andersen@rn.dk
Telephone: +45 30 38 25 10

Please include:
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV).
  • Letter of motivation
  • Proof of specialist certification in cardiology.
  • List of publications, if applicable.

The assessment process will follow the applicable Danish requirements for consultant appointments, including assessment of competencies across the seven physician roles.

jobs.title: Bli behandlingsfamilj hos Perspektiva
jobs.description:
Bli behandlingsfamilj hos Perspektiva

Har du erfarenhet av behandlingsarbete med barn och unga, till exempel från HVB, skola, socialtjänst eller öppenvård, och vill göra skillnad i en ungdoms vardag över tid?

Som behandlingsfamilj hos Perspektiva tar du emot en ungdom i ditt hem och blir en viktig vuxen i ungdomens förändringsarbete. Du har ett behandlingsteam runt dig och får regelbunden handledning, stöd i planeringen och nära kontakt med din konsulent hos Perspektiva.

Teamarbete

Du blir en del av teamet kring ungdomen och arbetar utifrån en tydlig plan; från kartläggning och målsättning till aktiv behandling och planerad utslussning. Du får använda din erfarenhet av bemötande, struktur, känsloreglering och relationsskapande i en vardag där du kan följa ungdomens utveckling över tid.

För dig som söker något annat

Att vara behandlingsfamilj är inte ett vanligt jobb, utan en livsstil som behöver fungera för hela familjen. Det innebär ett stort ansvar och en vardag som kräver flexibilitet, men kan också ge större frihet att styra över din tid och skapa ett arbetsliv som passar familjens liv. Ett arvode likt en heltidslön som socialpedagog utgår samt en omkostnadsersättning enligt SKR:s rekommendationer.

Det kan passa dig som vill:

• Bygga en stabil relation och finnas kvar över tid, inte bara under ett arbetspass.

• Använda din behandlingskompetens i en hemmamiljö.

• Ha ett självständigt uppdrag, med ett team nära när det behövs.

• Ha ett arbete som är en naturlig del av vardagen, snarare än bundet till fasta arbetstider och pass.

• Låta en ungdom bli en del av familjens liv under en längre tid.

Vi söker dig som

Du har gärna erfarenhet från exempelvis HVB, skola, socialtjänst, psykiatri, öppenvård eller annat arbete med barn och unga. Du behöver vara trygg i att möta starka känslor, konflikt och motstånd med ett bibehållet lugn, relationen i fokus och respekt för ungdomen.

Minst en vuxen behöver ha god tillgänglighet för skolkontakter, vård, umgänge, möten och situationer som kräver flexibilitet. Du deltar i introduktion, handledning och uppföljning tillsammans med Perspektiva.

Nyfiken?

Hör av dig för ett förutsättningslöst samtal om uppdraget och om det kan passa er.

Primary location:
TAMPERE

Haemme nyt Sale Terälahden tiimiin APULAISPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ vakituiseen 32–37,5 h/vko työsuhteeseen. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Me Pirkanmaan Osuuskaupassa sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Sale Terälahti on paikallisten, lomalaisten ja ohikulkijoiden suosima kyläkauppa, joka palkittiin vuoden 2024 Laatuloikkaaja-tunnustuksella. Jätä hakemuksesi meille, jos sydämesi sykkii lähikaupan tahdissa hyvälle arjelle ja merkitykselliselle työlle paikallisen yhteisön keskellä. 💚

Apulaispäällikön vastuullisessa roolissa pidät huolta laadukkaasta asiakaspalvelusta, yhteisistä tavoitteista, tuloksellisesta toiminnasta sekä henkilökunnan viihtyvyydestä ja hyvinvoinnista. Sale Terälahden myymäläpäälliköllä on vetovastuu kahdesta yksiköstä, joten pääset myymäläpäällikön poissa ollessa vastaamaan koko myymälän toiminnasta yhdessä tiimin kanssa.

🙌 Apulaispäällikkönä toimit arjessa tiimin rinnalla työskennellen fyysistä voimaa ja ripeyttä vaativissa kuormanpurku- ja hyllytystehtävissä.

Edellytämme sinulta aitoa asiakaspalveluasennetta sekä mahdollisuutta tehdä vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä. Myymälä palvelee asiakkaitaan ma–la klo 8–21 ja su klo 10–20, kesällä aukioloajat ovat laajemmat ma–la 8–22 ja su 10–22. Sale Terälahti sijaitsee noin 39 kilometrin päässä Tampereen keskustasta. Tehtävän sijainnin vuoksi edellytämme oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

💎 Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen marketkaupan vastuutehtävistä sekä näytöt menestyksekkäästä tiiminvetämisestä.

Työmme on tänä päivänä digitaalista, ja siksi odotamme sinulta toimeen tarttuvaa ja sujuvaa otetta järjestelmiin ja myymälän tietoteknisiin työvälineisiin. Tehtävässä onnistut, kun hallitset peruskäytön keskeisissä myymäläjärjestelmissä ja opit mielelläsi uutta.

Apulaispäällikkönä käytät työssäsi sekä kassajärjestelmää että mobiililaitteita ja hyödynnät myymälän taustajärjestelmiä arjen sujuvoittamiseksi. Työ sisältää myös sähköisten hintanäyttöjen ja tuoteskannauksen käyttöä sekä MS Office -ohjelmien käyttöä.

Tarjoamme sinulle ylivoimaiset,koko Suomen kattavat henkilökuntaedut.

Tehtävästä maksetaankaupanalantyöehtosopimuksenC-palkkaluokan mukaista palkkaa kokemusvuosien mukaan sekä vaativamman työn lisää. Lisäksi maksetaan mahdolliset vuorokohtaiset lisät.

📞 Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa myymäläpäällikkö Susanna Okker, puh. 010 767 2032, susanna.okker@sok.fi.

🔥 Innostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 21.10.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten kannattaa toimia ripeästi.

Olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin hakijoihin rekrytointiprosessin edetessä ja kutsumme soveltuvimmat ehdokkaat haastatteluun. Osana rekrytointiprosessia teetämme soveltuvuusarvioinnin jatkoon eteneville. Mahdollisiin suositusten tarkistuksiin käytämme Refensa-järjestelmää.

Pirkanmaan Osuuskauppa on yksi S-ryhmän yhdeksästätoista alueosuuskaupasta. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli 1 184,1 miljoonaa euroa ja liiketuloksemme 33,5 miljoonaa euroa. Meillä työskentelee yli 3 000 palvelualan ammattilaista noin 115 toimipaikassa ympäri Pirkanmaan: Prismoissa, S-marketeissa, Saleissa, ruoan verkkokaupassa, Sokoksella, Emotioneissa, S-Pankissa, Kukittamoissa, parturi-kampaamoissa, ravintoloissa ja ABC-liikennemyymälöissä. Olemme pokanneet Suomen innostavimmat työpaikat -tunnustuksen vuodesta 2016 lähtien. Osuuskauppana tavoitteemme on tehdä Pirkanmaasta parempi paikka elää. #pokkaajasydäntä

jobs.title: PhD fellowship in Veterinary Virology
jobs.description:
Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are offering a PhD fellowship in Veterinary Virology commencing 1st of February 2027.

Our group and research
Forskningsgruppen udfører forskning og undervisning inden for områderne enzootiske og zoonotiske virusinfektioner hos dyr. Forskningen vil de kommende år fokuseres på influenza infektioner i dyr, med fokus på zoonotiske aspekter af svine influenza virus. Gruppen bestå pt af ca. 20 forskere, phd studerende, studentermedhjælpere og 2 andre labornater. Vi har altid meget travlt, men har et godt arbejdsmiljø med masser af humor, kageklub og fleksible arbejdsopgaver og hvor alle hjælper alle.

The research group for Veterinary and Zoonotic Virology consists of around 20 members and as the name states work on both veterinary and zootonic viruses with a main focus on swine influenza A virus. We utilize different molecular methods such viral isolation in cells, qPCR/PCR, sequencing, ELISA and different immunological assays. The research group is very social and we have journal club, cake and breakfast club and Friday bars etc.

Project description
The PhD project will be on cross-reactive vaccines for swine influenza A virus. The first part of the project will be focussed on establishing immunological assays in the laboratory and generating hyperimmune serum in pigs experimentally for following antigenic characterization of Danish swine influenza A virus. The second part of the PhD will be on selecting representative vaccine strains testing them first experimentally in pigs and afterwards in the field.

Principal supervisor is Professor Lars Erik Larsen, Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, lael@sund.ku.dk, phone: +4540998434

Start: 1 February 2027

Duration: 3 years as a PhD student

Job description
Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:

  • Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.
  • Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points.
  • Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team.
  • Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project
  • Teaching and disseminating your knowledge.
  • Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project
PhD Programme Description:
The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., [relevant degrees]).

Qualifications:
If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).

If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.

As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.

Other important criteria are:

  • The grade point average achieved
  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Previous publications
  • Relevant work experience
  • Other professional activities
  • A curious mind-set with a strong interest in veterinary virology
  • Language skills
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and the project will be carried out in collaboration with Statens Serum Institute, Landbrug og Fødevarer and Ceva Animal Health.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is 1st of February 2027 or after agreement.

The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree.

Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 27,800 DKK/Roughly 3,700 EUR (October 2021 level) plus pension.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

Questions
For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website: https://healthsciences.ku.dk/phd/guidelines/

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format:

1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)

2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

3. Certified copy of original Master of Science diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD fellowship employment, your master’s degree must be equivalent to a Danish master’s degree. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database: https://ufm.dk/en/education/recognition-and-transparency/find-assessments/assessment-database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science.

4. Publication list (if possible)

Application deadline: [Wednesday 4 November 2026, 23.59pm CET

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.

The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.

Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You find information about the recruitment process at: http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Arbeidstid: Ved behov - med mulighet for flere vakter i ferier

Oppstart: Så snart som mulig, intervjuer kjøres fortløpende

Vi søker fleksible ekstrahjelpere!

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som klargjører er du ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til standard. I samarbeid med våre utleierepresentanter planlegger du behovet for leiebiler og leverer disse i henhold til plan. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg i samarbeid med stasjonsleder. Det vil også være dager hvor du møter våre kunder og må hjelpe disse på en best mulig måte. 

  • Klargjøre leiebiler i henhold til våre standarder (vask mm)

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Oversikt og kontroll på bestillinger og tilgjengelig bilpark

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Holde orden i utstyr og på arbeidsplassen

Kvalifikasjoner

Som klargjører har ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer til våre kunder. Vår hverdag styres av våre kunders behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. 

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (politiattest)

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor fysisk arbeidskapasitet

  • Strukturert med ordenssans

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. jobs.title: IT Service Coordinator - Sales & Marketing
jobs.description:
Keep business-critical applications running smoothly by connecting users, support teams, technical specialists and external vendors. As our IT Coordinator at Salesforce Mining, you coordinate operational support, drive issue towards resolution and help maintain reliable, high-quality services.  



This is a great opportunity to build your career within the segment while gaining broad operational experience:

    Coordinating issues that span multiple teams and systems.
    Work with stakeholders across the business, IT and external service providers.  
    Contribute to continuous improvements in service quality and user experience.  



About your job

You coordinate day-to-day operational support of business applications and the delivery of application management services. By monitoring support performance, aligning activities across teams and maintaining clear stakeholder communication, you help safeguard application availability, service quality and user satisfaction.  



Job responsibilities

    Coordinate incidents, service requests and problems involving multiple teams, systems and service dependencies.  
    Oversee ServiceNow queues, application health, support trends and operational risks, following tickets through resolution.
    Connect business users, application support teams, technical specialists and external vendors, including gathering information and managing escalations.  
    Coordinating major incidents, root cause analyses and corrective actions that improve service stability.  
    Track service performance against agreed service levels and operational objectives, providing reports and relevant data.
    Maintain support documentation and support the transition of new capabilities into application management, including readiness and hypercare activities.  



Location

This position is in Sandviken.

Your profile

You have a relevant university-level education and a couple of years of experience in IT service coordination, application support or a related field. A sound understanding of service management helps you connect stakeholder needs with practical action and keep work moving across several teams.  



Your background includes

    A Bachelor of Science degree or another relevant university-level, data related program.  
    Experience coordinating operational support, incidents, service requests or problems.
    An understanding of how ITIL incidents, problems, change and knowledge processes work together.
    Good written and spoken English.
    It’s a plus if you have an ITIL certificate.  



Clear communication and collaboration come naturally to you. You facilitate discussions, create structure and take ownership of progress from initial request to resolution. With sound business judgement, you understand stakeholder needs, notice emerging trends and act proactively.  

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.  



Contact information

For further information about this position, please contact Ellen Nilsson, hiring manager, ellen.nilsson@sandvik.com



We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.



Union contacts – Sweden  

    Cecilia Mickelsson, Unionen, +46 (0)70-616 90 89
    Erik Kjerf, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)70-616 36 72
    Olle Hansson, Ledarna, +46 (0)70-650 57 43



Recruitment Specialist: Karin Wallón



How to apply

Send your application no later than October 26th, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0096752.  



We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.



To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.    



Business area Mining is a global leading supplier of equipment and tools, parts, service, digital solutions and sustainability-driving technologies for the mining and construction industries. Applications include rock drilling, rock cutting, loading and hauling, tunneling and quarrying. In 2025, sales were approximately SEK 63 billion with about 18,400 employees.

Tjänsten kombinerar aktiv försäljning, kundbesök och plockservice i butik, vilket gör att du får en nära relation till kunderna och en bra förståelse för hur försäljningen fungerar ute i butik.

Om rollen

Som säljare hos oss ansvarar du för att utveckla samarbeten med både nya och befintliga kunder i Norra Stockholm med omnejd.

Arbetet är praktiskt, varierat och relationsdrivet – du arbetar både med försäljning och med att säkerställa att våra produkter exponeras på bästa sätt hos kund.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

    Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga kundrelationer
    Bearbeta nya och befintliga kunder med fokus på ökad försäljning
    Planera och genomföra kundbesök i regionen
    Säkerställa att våra produkter exponeras och säljer bra i butik
    Erbjuda plockservice hos vissa kunder, där du fyller på och organiserar sortimentet i butik
    Arbeta mot kunder inom dagligvaruhandel (ICA, Coop, Hemköp m.fl.) samt hotell och caféer

Arbetet innebär resor med bil och du utgår hemifrån, vi ser gärna att du bor centralt i säljregionen.

Vi söker dig som motiveras av kundkontakt, resultat och eget ansvar.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har erfarenhet av försäljning och gärna från dagligvaruhandel eller HoReCa (meriterande)

Dina personliga egenskaper

    Positiv, förtroendeingivande och professionell
    Relationsskapande och serviceinriktad
    Strukturerad och bra på att planera ditt arbete
    Tävlingsinriktad med hög egen motivation

    Garantilön kombinerat med provisionsmodell.
    Ett varierat arbete med mycket kundkontakt.
    Möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt och resultat.

Vi anställer omgående, så tveka inte att söka om du känner att rollen skulle passa dig!

Vi strävar alltid efter att arbeta med engagemang, ansvar, nytänkande och glädje. Vi vill göra skillnad på riktigt. Hos oss finns kollektivavtal, friskvård och närvarande chefer.

Kurera Omsorg söker nu en trygg, lyhörd och engagerad personlig assistent till en kvinna över 60 år, bosatt i centrala Stockholm.

Arbetet innebär att ge stöd i vardagen utifrån kundens individuella behov och önskemål. Arbetstiderna är förlagda till dag- och kvällspass, vardag och helg. Ej assistans på natten.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Säljchef till Polfärskt Bröd Halland

Nu tar Polfärskt Bröd nästa steg, vill du vara med på resan?

Polfärskt Bröd har genom åren byggt upp en framgångsrik organisation för att sälja och samdistribuera bröd från olika bagerier. Vår lokala förankring och det starka entreprenörskap som genomsyrar hela vår organisation kombinerat med den stordrift vi får genom samordnad kedjedrift har gjort oss framgångsrika på marknaden.



Till ett av våra 24 distriktsbolag, Polfärskt Bröd Halland med lager och kontor i Falkenberg söker vi nu en engagerad och driven Säljchef. Vår organisation i Halland består av ca 16 heltidstjänster varav 10 säljare som bearbetar ca 90 kunder inom DVH i regionen. Bolaget omsatte 2025 ca 87 MSEK och har potential att utvecklas ytterligare. Därför söker vi nu en Säljchef som vill jobba med affärsutveckling och långsiktig försäljning.

Om rollen

Polfärskt Bröd Halland har som mål att bygga relation till kund, bygga det interna teamet och självklart öka försäljning till befintliga kunder. Vi har även fokus på att sätta starka rutiner och struktur för att säkra möjligheter att jobba mot vår vision att bli en värdeskapande och älskad partner till våra kunder och partners.

Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med bolagets VD och bidra till ökad lönsam försäljning inklusive långsiktig strategi, planering inför kommande säljcykler, lokala kampanjer/säljtävlingar samt säkra starkt kategoriarbete för att långsiktigt utveckla brödkategorin inom distriktet.

I rollen som Säljchef är du ansvarig för att coacha och utveckla säljorganisationen så att de kan göra sitt bästa jobb ute hos kund varje dag. Tjänsten är rörlig inom regionen och ansvar är kopplat till aktuellt behov och kan formas och justeras i relation till kompetens, nuläge och förutsättningar inom teamet. Tjänsten är heltid och du rapporterar till VD.



Vi söker

Vi söker dig med stort engagemang och mycket vilja! Du brinner för ledarskap och försäljning samt att bidra till utveckling framåt. Du gillar att jobba långsiktigt men är även en person som brinner för att vara ute i vår vardag och är prestigelös – vi jobbar tillsammans! Då vår försäljning baseras på goda långsiktiga relationer med butiker, bör du vara en person med god social förmåga att bygga relation på både kort och lång sikt. Du har erfarenhet från DVH, har tidigare haft en coachande roll och bör även ha goda kunskaper i kategori samt space management för att kunna förstå och agera rådgivare till våra kunder på bästa vis. Utöver detta har du god datorvana och hanterar Officepaketet obehindrat. Du bor någonstans inom vår region (Falkenberg med omnejd).

Vi erbjuder

Vi erbjuder dig ett stort ansvar i ett bolag med välkända varumärken och högt engagemang! Hos oss får du möjlighet att skapa, påverka och utveckla. Med dina erfarenheter och kunskaper kommer du få utveckla, hålla ihop och sätta din prägel på vår försäljning. Med stort kvalitetsfokus i alla led är vi inne i en tillväxtresa. Du kommer vara en nyckelperson i denna resa hos oss.

Låter detta som din nästa utmaning?

Då är du varmt välkommen med din ansökan via annonsen på www.ansokan.halland@polfarskt.se senast 6 november 2026. Vid eventuella frågor kontakta VD Torbjörn Claesson på 0703-145113 eller torbjorn.claesson@polfarskt.se.

Om oss

Polfärskt Bröd är en rikstäckande distributör av bröd och kakor till dagligvaruhandeln. Organisationen omsätter ca 3,1 miljarder kronor och säljer och levererar några av marknadens starkaste varumärken inom matbröd så som Polarbröd, Korvbrödsbagarn, Fazer och Skogaholm. Polfärskt säljer även bröd från Åkes Äkta Hönökakor, Hatting och Brödverket samt kaffebröd från Gille och Hägges.

Tillsammans med våra kunder och partners skapar vi attraktiva, lönsamma och säljande brödavdelningar i Sveriges alla dagligvarubutiker. Detta gör vi genom lokalt ägandeskap och central gemenskap i en unik kombination.

Totalt har Polfärskt över 1100 anställda varav över 500 säljande distributörer som utgår från 31 strategiskt utplacerade brödterminaler över hela Sverige. Läs mer på www.polfarskt.se.

Om UNIQ DIALOG

År 2007 slog Uniq Dialog upp sina dörrar och sedan dess har vi format oss till att bli en ledande kraft i Malmö, en plats där ungdomar tar sina första förtroendefulla steg in i arbetslivet. Sedan starten har vi äran att ha blivit utsedda till "Årets Jobbkomet" i Malmö.

Ta steget in i en värld av möjligheter och bli en del av vår framgångsrika resa.

Om arbetet

Söker du ett extrajobb som du kan kombinera med skola eller liknande? Vill du lära dig mer om försäljning? Då har du hittat rätt! Vi på UNIQ Dialog söker efter nya kandidater till vår säljavdelning!

Arbetet består av att erbjuda prenumerationsprodukter till kunder som sedan tidigare har en koppling till produkten, men kan även omfatta försäljning av tjänster, marknadsundersökningar eller mötesbokning. Du representerar alltid välkända varumärken inom respektive segment. Kunderna som kontaktas har i de flesta fall använt produkten tidigare vilket gör att försäljningen bygger på en befintlig relation med kunden.

De första dagarna kombinerar vi teori med praktik och du kommer att få lära dig allt du behöver för att sälja på alla typer av kundunderlag. Alla som jobbar här är måna om att du som börjar hos oss ska trivas och få den hjälp som just du behöver för att lyckas riktigt bra! Vi erbjuder alla verktyg som du behöver i form av utbildning, kontinuerlig coachning och säljtävlingar.

Du väljer ditt eget schema och får dessutom lön varje fredag!

För att söka till oss behöver du nödvändigtvis inte ha erfarenhet från försäljning sedan tidigare - men givetvis är det meriterande! Det absolut viktigaste för oss är att du som söker är:

- En mästare på svenska i tal och skrift

- Du gillar utmaningar och älskar tanken på att din insats bestämmer din lön

- Du är en energibomb, alltid på G och vet hur man kommunicerar effektivt

Resten bidrar vi med!

Vi erbjuder dig

    

Omfattande produkt- och säljutbildningar för att du ska bli en expert inom området

    

Daglig coachning och stöd för att du ska nå din fulla potential

    

En fartfylld och dynamisk arbetsplats där du utmanas och får möjlighet att växa

    

Spännande utvecklingsmöjligheter som hjälper dig att bygga din karriär inom försäljning

    

Inspirerande tävlingar som ger dig chansen att belönas för ditt hårda arbete

    

Trygghet genom kollektivavtal som värnar om dina rättigheter och förmåner

    

Möjligheten att arbeta med välkända varumärken och skapa starka relationer

    

Vårt fulla engagemang för att stötta din framgång och personliga utveckling

    

Ett team av likasinnade personer som delar din entusiasm och passion för försäljning

jobs.title: AI Product Owner
jobs.description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups, and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future, and we want you to be part of it.

We are now scaling the use of AI across Husqvarna Group and are looking for an AI Product Owner to lead a part of our AI portfolio use cases across our organization.

You will join our AI Hub, our AI Center of Excellence, working at the intersection of business and technology to accelerate the leverage and value of AI.

About the role:

In this role, you will own the direction, prioritization and development of a portfolio of machine-learning use cases, including areas such as prediction, forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, and computer vision. As our AI function and portfolio evolve, your scope may be adjusted to reflect changing business priorities, emerging opportunities and the needs of the AI Hub.

Working alongside other Product Owners, each responsible for a defined area of the broader AI portfolio, you will help shape a coherent and scalable approach to AI across Husqvarna Group.

This is an active product ownership role where you will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and drive initiatives through the full product lifecycle. You will ensure that solutions address genuine business needs, have the right data and operational foundations, and deliver sustainable value beyond experimentation and technical delivery.

Working closely with business stakeholders, operational teams, technical specialists and governance functions, you will bring structure and focus to a complex and evolving AI landscape.

Your main responsibilities include:

    Own the direction, performance and evolution of a portfolio of machine-learning use cases, adapting its scope as business priorities, technologies and organizational needs evolve.
    Identify and qualify opportunities by understanding business problems, users, workflows, expected value and the operational conditions required for success.
    Own and prioritize the backlog and roadmap, balancing business value, strategic fit, feasibility, data readiness, user impact, risk, cost and reuse potential.
    Drive initiatives through the full product lifecycle, from discovery and experimentation to production, adoption, continuous improvement and eventual retirement.
    Bridge business and technology, translating needs into delivery-ready requirements and enabling clear decisions across business stakeholders, data and AI specialists, engineering teams and governance functions.
    Ensure solutions have the necessary data, integrations, evaluation methods, operational ownership and responsible AI controls to deliver sustainable value at scale.
    Drive adoption and measurable impact, using user feedback, solution performance and business outcomes to guide decisions, communicate progress, and continuously improve the portfolio.

You will report to our VP of AI Value Acceleration.

About you:

You’re an adaptable and accountable Product Owner who thrives in complexity and brings structure, focus, and momentum to areas that are still developing. You combine strategic product thinking with hands-on execution and are comfortable moving between portfolio direction, individual use cases, delivery decisions and adoption challenges.

You are technology-aware but problem-led, and you do not assume that AI, or one particular type of AI, is always the right solution. You build trust across business and technology, make informed decisions despite ambiguity, and remain focused on sustainable business outcomes.

Your skills and background:

    A university degree in engineering or another relevant technical field, such as computer science, information technology or data science, or equivalent professional experience.
    Strong experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or equivalent leader of digital, data, analytics, automation or AI-enabled products.
    Experience managing a portfolio or roadmap spanning multiple business areas, stakeholder groups and delivery teams.
    A broad understanding of applied AI, with relevant knowledge of machine learning and an interest in generative AI, intelligent automation and emerging AI capabilities.
    The ability to engage credibly with data scientists, AI and ML engineers, software teams, architects and platform specialists without needing to be the technical solution owner.
    Strong business and product judgement, including the ability to qualify opportunities, challenge assumptions, prioritize investments and make difficult trade-offs.
    A data-driven approach that combines user feedback, product analytics, evaluation results, operational measures and business-performance data.
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to make complex AI concepts understandable and relevant to different audiences.
    A collaborative and low-ego working style, with the flexibility to share, transfer or take on responsibilities based on what best serves the overall AI portfolio.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Location

The preferred location for this position is Stockholm, Sweden, although the role can also be based at our other main sites in Huskvarna or Jonsered.

How we work

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your Application:

Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we find the right person. For more information about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Johan Odelfelt at johan.odelfelt@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application, we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice.

jobs.title: Experienced Consultant | People Consulting | Stockholm
jobs.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of people, change and business transformation? EY People Consulting is growing and looking for experienced consultants with a passion for change management who can help organizations translate transformation ambitions into meaningful and sustainable change.

In Sweden, our team of around 60 consultants across Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö is part of a strong Nordic and global network, working to create real impact for our clients and their people.



The opportunity



Together with our clients, we drive transformation from ambition to execution, creating positive experiences of change. We help organizations understand, prepare for and navigate the people-related impact of transformation through structured change management, stakeholder engagement, communication, learning and adoption.

As technology and AI reshape organizations, we believe people remain at the core of successful transformation. People Consulting helps clients set a clear strategic direction and design scalable, AI‑enabled ways of working that create long‑term value at the intersection of people, technology and business.





Your key responsibilities



As an experienced consultant, you work in teams with EY colleagues and directly with clients in large‑scale transformation initiatives - from analysis and design to implementation and adoption.

You are encouraged to identify new business opportunities, build relationships, and help strengthen our market presence as People Consulting continues to grow.





To succeed in this role, you need to:



    Be passionate about change management, organizational transformation and the human side of transformation
    Lead and deliver workstreams within People Consulting engagements, including designing and facilitating workshops with senior client stakeholders
    Translate complex transformation challenges into clear, actionable deliverables and solve complex problems using creative, strategic, and analytical methods and tools
    Communicate complex change in a clear, engaging and audience-focused way
    Have a genuine interest in AI and a working understanding of how it is reshaping organizations, work and value creation
    Be a curious, continuous learner who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is energized by change and new technology
    Contribute to proposal development and capability building within People Consulting
    Build strong, trust-based relationships with clients and colleagues, and coach and support junior consultants



Skills and attributes for success  



You combine a structured and analytical approach with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, engaging stakeholders at different levels and adapting your approach as transformation needs evolve. You understand that successful change requires both a clear direction and practical support that helps people adopt new behaviors, processes and ways of working.





Qualifications



    Relevant university degree (e.g., business, industrial engineering, strategic HR, economics, behavioral sciences)
    4–6+ years of relevant work experience after graduation
    Practical experience in change management, organizational transformation or another closely related area
    Experience taking ownership of deliverables and working independently in client engagements
    Experience translating concepts into implemented solutions and realized impact
    Solid understanding of AI and digitalization from a business and transformation perspective
    Strong analytical, communicative and relationship building skills
    Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)
    Advanced skills in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
    



Meriting qualifications



    Background in management consulting
    Experience with AI and datadriven transformations
    Advanced proficiency in Swedish, spoken and written
    



We are looking for someone who shares EY’s values



At EY, you work on high impact assignments with leading organizations, in an inclusive and trusted culture that offers continuous development, early responsibility, and flexible ways of working. Read more about what EY can offer you at ey.com/careers.  





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.  



Please submit your application no later than 8thth of November 2026. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis. We will review applications after the summer period starting from late August 2026 and plan to start interviewing in September, with interviews conducted on a rolling basis thereafter.



Selection and interviews are ongoing. If you have questions about the role, please contact Jesper Johansson at Jesper.Johansson1@se.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Adrian Lyng at Adrian.Lyng@se.ey.com. Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Enhetschef hemtjänsten, Hammarstrand
jobs.description:
Tycker du också om närhet och gemenskap? Som när man tilltalar varandra med förnamn, och när alla använder samma fikarum och kaffekoppar. Och tycker du också om trygghet och frihet? Som när man är sedd och bekräftad, men har så högt i tak så att man kan prova sina vingar ibland. Det gör vi.

Hitta hem till oss som Enhetschef hemtjänsten med placeringsort i Hammarstrand!

jobs.title: Experienced Consultant | People Consulting | Gothenburg
jobs.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of people, change and business transformation? EY People Consulting is growing and looking for experienced consultants with a passion for change management who can help organizations translate transformation ambitions into meaningful and sustainable change.

In Sweden, our team of around 60 consultants across Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö is part of a strong Nordic and global network, working to create real impact for our clients and their people.



The opportunity



Together with our clients, we drive transformation from ambition to execution, creating positive experiences of change. We help organizations understand, prepare for and navigate the people-related impact of transformation through structured change management, stakeholder engagement, communication, learning and adoption.

As technology and AI reshape organizations, we believe people remain at the core of successful transformation. People Consulting helps clients set a clear strategic direction and design scalable, AI‑enabled ways of working that create long‑term value at the intersection of people, technology and business.





Your key responsibilities



As an experienced consultant, you work in teams with EY colleagues and directly with clients in large‑scale transformation initiatives - from analysis and design to implementation and adoption.

You are encouraged to identify new business opportunities, build relationships, and help strengthen our market presence as People Consulting continues to grow.





To succeed in this role, you need to:



    Be passionate about change management, organizational transformation and the human side of transformation
    Lead and deliver workstreams within People Consulting engagements, including designing and facilitating workshops with senior client stakeholders
    Translate complex transformation challenges into clear, actionable deliverables and solve complex problems using creative, strategic, and analytical methods and tools
    Communicate complex change in a clear, engaging and audience-focused way
    Have a genuine interest in AI and a working understanding of how it is reshaping organizations, work and value creation
    Be a curious, continuous learner who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is energized by change and new technology
    Contribute to proposal development and capability building within People Consulting
    Build strong, trust-based relationships with clients and colleagues, and coach and support junior consultants



Skills and attributes for success  



You combine a structured and analytical approach with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, engaging stakeholders at different levels and adapting your approach as transformation needs evolve. You understand that successful change requires both a clear direction and practical support that helps people adopt new behaviors, processes and ways of working.





Qualifications



    Relevant university degree (e.g., business, industrial engineering, strategic HR, economics, behavioral sciences)
    4–6+ years of relevant work experience after graduation
    Practical experience in change management, organizational transformation or another closely related area
    Experience taking ownership of deliverables and working independently in client engagements
    Experience translating concepts into implemented solutions and realized impact
    Solid understanding of AI and digitalization from a business and transformation perspective
    Strong analytical, communicative and relationship building skills
    Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)
    Advanced skills in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
    



Meriting qualifications



    Background in management consulting
    Experience with AI and datadriven transformations
    Advanced proficiency in Swedish, spoken and written
    



We are looking for someone who shares EY’s values



At EY, you work on high impact assignments with leading organizations, in an inclusive and trusted culture that offers continuous development, early responsibility, and flexible ways of working. Read more about what EY can offer you at ey.com/careers.  





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.  



Please submit your application no later than 8thth of November 2026. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis. We will review applications after the summer period starting from late August 2026 and plan to start interviewing in September, with interviews conducted on a rolling basis thereafter.



Selection and interviews are ongoing. If you have questions about the role, please contact Jesper Johansson at Jesper.Johansson1@se.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Adrian Lyng at Adrian.Lyng@se.ey.com. Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Produktionstekniker
jobs.description:
Din nya utmaning

Vår produktion växer och som en del av vår fortsatta expansion bygger vi nu upp ett nytt team på en ny produktionssite vid vårt huvudkontor i Helsingborg. Som Produktionstekniker blir du en del av vår växande produktionsverksamhet och får möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av både våra arbetssätt, team och produktion framåt.

Du kommer främst att arbeta med montering av våra högteknologiska produkter i ett varierat arbete där kvalitet står i fokus. Här får du möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens, ta ansvar och vara med på vår fortsatta tillväxtresa.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

    

Montering av både mekaniska och elektroniska delar i MilDefs produkter.

    

Utföra mindre omfattande lödning av elektroniska komponenter och ledningar.

    

Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar för att öka effektiviteten och kvaliteten i produktionsmiljön.

Det här bidrar du med

    

Har en teknisk utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.

    

Erfarenhet inom elektronikmontering från en relevant produktionsmiljö.

    

God datavana.

    

Du är ordningsam, strukturerad, noggrann och har ett stort tekniskt intresse.

    

Social kompetens och en lagspelare som bidrar till ett effektivt samarbete.

    

Förmåga att läsa tekniska arbetsinstruktioner, manualer och enkla ritningar.

    

Uttrycker dig med mycket god förmåga på både svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Lär känna oss

På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Det gör vi bland annat genom att erbjuda attraktiva förmåner samt hälsofrämjande initiativ, som wellness-aktiviteter på arbetstid.

Vill du veta mer om MilDef, våra produkter och vår kultur? Läs mer här MilDef.com

För mer information om rollen, vänligen kontakta Elin Hovbrandt, HR.

Viktig information

Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.

På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan anställning, oavsett befattning, förutsätta bakgrunds- och säkerhetsrelaterade kontroller.

MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.
