jobs.title: Perhetyöntekijä, lastenhoitaja, lähihoitaja, Hoiva ELSI Oy, Helsinki ja Vantaa, Helsinki
jobs.description:
Hoiva ELSI Oy hakee perhetyöntekijöitä kasvavaan joukkoonsa Helsingin ja Vantaan alueille. Tarjolla työtä yksittäisistä kertaviikkoisista vuoroista useampaan työvuoroon viikossa.

Vuoroja on tarjolla pääosin arkisin 8-20 aikavälillä ja toisinaan myös viikonloppuisin. Voit itse valita työskentelyalueesi ja tuntimäärän. Yksittäinen vuoro voi olla kestoltaan 3 tunnista eteenpäin.

Työssä auttaa menestymään:

\-kokemus jo aivan pienten vauvojen hoidosta

\-hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomenkieli taito sekä muu kielitaito (englanti)

\-se ettei ole allerginen lemmikkieläimille

\- mahdollisuus liikkua laajemmalla alueella

\-mahdollisuus iltatyöskentelyyn

\- savuttomuus

Hoiva ELSI tarjoaa palvelua lapsiperheille, pääosin alle kouluikäisten lasten perheisiin. Toimintamme tukee ja auttaa perheitä lastenhoitoon- ja kasvatukseen sekä arjen sujumiseen liittyvissä asioissa. Työskentely tapahtuu asiakasperheiden kodeissa.

Haemme Sinua hoito- ja sosiaalialan ammattilainen, jonka kiinnostuksen kohteet ovat lapsiperheiden kanssa tehtävässä työssä, joka haluat tehdä työtäsi asiakaslähtöisesti. Edellytämme sinulta lähihoitajan tutkintoa tai vastaavaa (lastenohjaaja, päivähoitaja, lastenhoitaja) tai riittäviä (vähintään 60 op) AMK opintoja (sosionomi). Odotamme aiempaa kokemusta lasten ja perheiden kanssa tehtävästä työstä. Kaikilta työntekijöiltä edellytetään hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja nuhteetonta rikostaustaa. Rikosrekisteriote on esitettävä ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Tarjoamme Sinulle taatusti mielenkiintoisen, monipuolisen kuin myös haasteita tarjoavan työn, kiinnostuksesi ja kokemuksesi pohjalta räätälöidyt työajat ja työn sisällön. Työsi tukena on kaksi kokenutta esimiestä, säännölliset koulutukset ja virkistystoimintaa työyhteisön kanssa. Työstä maksamme kilpailukykyisen palkan vuorolisineen sekä lomakorvauksen jokaisen palkan yhteydessä. Kun teet vuorokaudenaikana kaksi työvuoroa, maksamme siirtymä- ja ruokataukokorvauksena tunnin palkan.

PAIKAT TÄYTETÄÄN HETI SOPIVAN HENKILÖN LÖYDYTTYÄ!

Katso lisää toiminnastamme ja arvoistamme www.hoivaelsi.fi. Ole rohkeasti yhteydessä ja kysy lisää työstä ja tarjoamistamme eduista! Keskustelemme mielellämme kanssasi työskentelymahdollisuuksistasi meillä. Hakemukset sähköpostitse elsi@hoivaelsi.fi tai nettisivujemme työnhakulinkin kautta. Lisää mukaan ansioluettelosi! tuntityö sopimuksen mukaan

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer (Mechanical)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced mechanical commissioning professional to coordinate mechanical and integrated commissioning on a major data centre project in Seinäjoki. You will support delivery from design and construction readiness through testing and final handover, coordinating with contractors, vendors, the project team and client to ensure mechanical systems are fully tested and all Level 0–5 commissioning and turnover documentation is complete.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Planning, Design & Coordination**

- Develop commissioning activities within the project programme, aligned with stakeholder and contract requirements.

- Review the issued-for-construction design and report commissioning risks, opportunities, scope gaps and programme impacts.

- Coordinate mechanical readiness reviews before start-up and testing, confirming completion, QA/QC records, RAMS, permits, access, isolations, controls, temporary requirements and vendor attendance.

- Provide commissioning input at coordination, design, integration, discipline, OFCI and CFCI meetings.


**Technical Reviews & Commissioning Controls**

- Review and comment on technical submittals, RFIs, vendor test scripts, commissioning RAMS and related commissioning documentation.

- Review contractor and vendor test packs against the design, employers requirements, approved submissions and applicable standards.

- Attend factory tests and complete site or vendor QA/QC inspections against approved requirements.

- Manage commissioning records, evidence, approvals and reporting in SharePoint, EIDA and project platforms.


**Testing, Integration & Performance Verification**

- Witness field testing and commissioning activities, record results and report defects, deviations and incomplete works.

- Coordinate CFCI and OFCI vendors and track commissioning progress from Level 0 to Level 5.

- Coordinate with the integration team to capture programme crossovers, dependencies, deliverables and beneficial-use areas.

- Analyze functional performance logs and monitoring data with the BMS contractor and other specialists to verify system performance.


**Management, Reporting & Quality**

- Provide discipline updates at weekly commissioning meetings and close assigned actions promptly.

- Monitor construction progress with the mechanical, electrical and CSA discipline leads to identify scope gaps, missed opportunities and risks arising from programme variance.

- Maintain a daily commissioning diary and issue a concise weekly report in the agreed project format.

- Review mechanical commissioning certification and submit traceable evidence for authorized approval.


**Turnover & Handover**

- Coordinate mechanical turnover packs at each commissioning level, verify supporting evidence, and prepare EIDA forms for authorized approval.

- Support integrated systems testing, client witnessing, demonstrations, operator training and final transition to operations.


**Commissioning Scope**

- Mechanical plant and systems, including chillers, cooling towers or dry coolers, pumps, heat exchangers, ventilation systems, fuel systems where applicable, water-treatment systems, drainage and associated controls.

- BMS interfaces, control sequences, alarms, trends, functional performance testing and integrated operation.

- Mechanical interfaces with electrical systems, fire alarm, life-safety systems, utilities and specialist vendor packages.

- Factory and site testing, flushing, pressure and leak testing, balancing, start-up, functional, failure-mode and integrated systems testing.

- Digital commissioning records, tagging, test packs, certification, turnover dossiers and final handover evidence.


**Qualifications & Experience**

- Mechanical, Building Services or related qualification, with 5+ years commissioning experience on large industrial, mission-critical or data centre projects.

- Proven ability to plan, manage and execute full integrated systems testing, including development and completion of IST documentation on a digital platform.

- Thorough understanding of Finnish and European building regulations, standards, codes, commissioning practices and mechanical system integration requirements.

- Strong organization and prioritization skills, with a record of meeting deadlines and budgets.

- Strong communication and reporting skills with clients, contractors, vendors and project management.

- Demonstrated ability to coordinate contractors, vendors and multidisciplinary interfaces while maintaining collaborative working relationships.


**What We Offer**

You'll play an important role in commissioning the mechanical systems of a major data centre project in Seinäjoki, working closely with contractors, vendors, and multidisciplinary project teams to ensure systems are tested, verified, and ready for operation. From design reviews and construction readiness through functional testing, integrated systems testing, and final handover, youll help coordinate activities, resolve technical issues, and ensure commissioning documentation is complete and traceable. We offer competitive compensation, a lunch benefit, and the opportunity to develop your expertise in a dynamic, international project environment.

jobs.title: Commissioning Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced commissioning professional to lead the overall commissioning programme on a major data centre project in Seinäjoki, ensuring coordinated delivery from design and construction readiness through integrated systems testing, final handover, and transition to operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Commissioning Strategy & Leadership**

- Own the commissioning strategy, execution plan, team structure, system boundaries, tagging process and governance.

- Lead, manage and coordinate the mechanical, electrical, controls and integrated commissioning teams, setting clear responsibilities, priorities and performance expectations.

- Act as the primary commissioning interface with project management, construction, design, QA/QC, HSE, planning, commercial, client and operational teams.

- Chair daily coordination, weekly management, readiness, integration and handover meetings. Record and close decisions, actions and constraints.


**Programme, Planning & Readiness**

- Develop and maintain the integrated commissioning programme, linking construction completion, vendor activities, energisation, system start-up, functional testing, IST and handover milestones.

- Maintain the commissioning resource plan, tracking personnel, vendors, temporary requirements, permits and test equipment against the programme.

- Lead readiness reviews and confirm construction, QA/QC records, permits, access, ownership, isolations, temporary requirements and vendor attendance before energisation or testing.

- Monitor progress, forecast constraints and implement recovery plans where commissioning milestones are at risk.


**Technical Governance & Quality**

- Oversee commissioning input to design reviews, technical submittals, RFIs, RAMS, inspection and test plans, test scripts, switching procedures and vendor documentation.

- Ensure test procedures and acceptance criteria comply with contract requirements, approved design, manufacturer guidance, Finnish and European standards and industry best practice.

- Provide governance for factory witness testing, site acceptance testing, energisation, functional performance testing and integrated systems testing.

- Track defects, non-conformances, punch-list items and technical risks to agreed closure dates, supported by weekly ageing reviews and completion evidence.


**Integration, Testing & Handover**

- Own the Level 0 to Level 5 commissioning process across CFCI and OFCI systems, including mechanical, electrical, BMS, EPMS, life-safety and specialist vendor interfaces.

- Own project LOTO and area-control permits for commissioned and energised systems, including access, boundaries, authorised personnel and transfer of control.

- Lead the development, approval and execution of the integrated systems testing plan, scenarios, scripts, safety controls and final reports.

- Coordinate beneficial-use areas, phased turnover, client witnessing, demonstrations, operator training and transition to operations.

- Ensure turnover packs, commissioning records, certificates, red-line drawings, O&M information and final dossiers are complete and accepted at each stage.


**Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

- Support control of commissioning expenditure across direct labour, subcontractors, specialist vendors, temporary plant, test equipment, material requirements and variations, working with the commercial team to identify forecast changes and protect the approved budget.

- Report weekly and monthly on WBS progress, readiness, resources, lookaheads, risks, defects, late deliveries, recovery actions and key decisions.

- Maintain effective relationships with the client, contractors and vendors and resolve interface issues before they affect safety, quality or programme.

- Maintain consistent use of EIDA, SharePoint and other project platforms for commissioning schedules, tagging, test evidence, approvals, defects, turnover status and management reporting.


**Qualifications & Experience**

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent recognised professional or trade qualification supported by relevant commissioning leadership experience.

- At least five years experience in a Commissioning Manager role on large-scale data centre, mission-critical, industrial or similarly complex projects, or demonstrable equivalent experience supported by broader commissioning leadership responsibility.

- Proven experience managing multidisciplinary commissioning teams and contractor and vendor delivery, supported by extensive commissioning knowledge of the mechanical, electrical, controls and life-safety systems typically installed on data centre projects.

- Strong knowledge of commissioning Levels 0–5, including digital completion controls, energisation, functional testing, IST, turnover and operational handover.

- Thorough understanding of Finnish and European regulations, codes, standards, safety requirements and accepted commissioning practice.

- Excellent leadership, planning, decision-making, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

- Ability to produce high-quality management reports, presentations, programmes, risk assessments and technical documentation.

- Fluency with both written and spoken in English.


**Desirable Criteria**

- Previous hyperscale or enterprise data centre commissioning management experience.

- Experience managing phased handover and live operational interfaces on multi-building or campus projects.

- Authorised Person, switching, safety management or recognised commissioning certification.


**What We Offer**

Youll lead commissioning activities on a major data centre project in Seinäjoki, working with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, vendors, and the client to ensure safe and successful delivery from initial readiness through final handover and transition to operations. We offer competitive compensation, a lunch benefit, and a dynamic, international project environment.

jobs.title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated Graduate Electrical Engineer to support the Senior Electrical, Electrical Package Managers, Electrical Supervisors, Design Manager and wider site engineering team on a major data centre project in Seinäjoki, gaining practical experience across design coordination, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning and handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Site Engineering & Package Support**

- Provide day-to-day engineering and administrative support to the Senior Electrical Managers, Electrical Package Managers, Electrical Supervisors, Design Manager and wider engineering team, including technical coordination, short-term planning and work-area readiness.

- Work with supervisors, subcontractors, vendors, BIM personnel and field engineers to support safe and efficient installation progress.

- Assist with RFIs, technical queries and interface issues, escalating matters that require senior engineering input.


**Design, Procurement & Technical Assurance**

- Assist in reviewing specifications, drawings and design information for scope, compliance, constructability and coordination requirements.

- Support the review and tracking of technical submittals, shop drawings, equipment schedules, material selections and installation proposals under the guidance of senior engineers.

- Support material take-offs, procurement records, delivery tracking and readiness checks for electrical equipment and materials.

- Maintain design-change and field-engineering records, ensuring information is updated and communicated to the relevant team members.


**Construction, Interfaces & Reporting**

- Support coordination of electrical interfaces with Mechanical, CSA, ICT/ELV, BMS, Fire Protection, Logistics, Design, Procurement and Commissioning teams.

- Update progress trackers covering subcontractor activities, manpower, materials, quality, risks and constraints, and report issues to the package team.


**Electrical Systems**

- Support delivery of HV/MV and LV distribution, transformers, switchgear, generators, UPS, batteries, busbar, protection, earthing, lighting, metering, controls and associated ICT/ELV and BMS interfaces.


**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

- Support compliance checks against project HSE requirements, approved design, specifications, Finnish regulations, IEC/EN standards and client requirements.

- Assist with QA/QC inspections, test records, non-conformance tracking and punch-list closure in accordance with approved inspection and test plans.


**Testing, Commissioning & Handover**

- Support FAT, SAT, electrical completion, energization readiness, commissioning and Integrated Systems Testing.

- Support test documentation, system turnover, as-built records, O&M manuals, snag closure and final handover.

- Maintain the combined asset register, coordinating updates across project systems and supporting accurate handover information.

- Monitor and enforce compliance with the project asset naming convention, identifying and correcting inconsistencies.

- Maintain cable reference records and support consistent cable identification across drawings, schedules, installation and testing documentation.


**Qualifications & Experience**

- Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.

- Graduate-level role; ideally two years of relevant electrical engineering, construction or site-based experience.

- Interest in developing practical knowledge of electrical installation, testing, commissioning and project handover.

- Basic understanding of electrical distribution systems, switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS, batteries, earthing, protection and controls.

- Ability to read engineering drawings and schedules, with an interest in developing BIM/CAD and technical-document review skills.

- Organised and detail-focused, with the ability to maintain registers, trackers and technical records accurately.

- Good communication, teamwork and problem-solving skills, with fluent written and spoken English and a willingness to learn in a site-based environment.


**Desirable Criteria**

- Academic project experience related to data centres, mission-critical facilities, building services or construction is beneficial.

- Familiarity with electrical testing, commissioning, asset information, cable schedules or handover documentation.


**What We Offer**

You'll have the opportunity to build your career in electrical engineering by working alongside experienced engineers, package managers, supervisors, and other specialists on a major data centre project in Seinäjoki. You'll gain hands-on experience across the full project lifecycle, from design coordination and installation to testing, commissioning, and handover, while developing your technical knowledge and understanding of complex electrical systems. With guidance from an experienced project team, you'll be encouraged to learn, take on responsibility, and grow into your role. We offer competitive compensation, a lunch benefit, and the opportunity to develop your skills in a dynamic, international project environment.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a site-based Mechanical Engineer to support the Mechanical Package Managers, Design Managers and site team on a major data centre project in Seinäjoki. You will provide practical support across design, construction, quality, commissioning and handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Site Engineering & Delivery Support**

- Support look-ahead planning, design coordination, sequencing, access, logistics and work-area readiness.

- Monitor subcontractor and vendor activities, confirm work follows approved information, and raise technical, quality or programme concerns.

- Help resolve RFIs, technical queries, non-conformities and site issues with the design, construction and commissioning teams.


**Design, Procurement & Technical Assurance**

- Review drawings, specifications and calculations for scope, constructability, maintainability, access and coordination.

- Review submittals, shop drawings, equipment schedules, P&IDs, hydraulic calculations and installation proposals for approval by the relevant lead.

- Support procurement reviews, material approvals, vendor coordination and equipment delivery readiness.

- Check that materials and equipment are received, stored, protected and handled correctly.

- Keep clear records of design changes, field instructions, deviations and scope clarifications.


**Construction, Interfaces & Reporting**

- Coordinate interfaces with Electrical, CSA, BMS, Fire Protection, ICT/ELV, Logistics, Design, Procurement, Commissioning and Operations teams.

- Track progress, inspections, constraints, defects and close-out actions, and provide clear updates.

- Join coordination meetings, site walk-downs and clash reviews to maintain safe, workable construction areas.


**Mechanical Systems**

- Support installation and inspection of cooling plant, chilled- and condenser-water systems, AHUs, CRAH/CRAC units, CDUs, pumps, heat exchangers, pipework, water treatment, ventilation, plumbing, drainage, fire-protection interfaces and BMS controls.

- Check that resilient mechanical distribution, controls, alarms and failover arrangements follow the approved design and sequence of operations.


**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

- Support safe working and compliance with permits, approved designs, project standards, Finnish regulations and client requirements.

- Review method statements, risk assessments and inspection plans, and support inspections, non-conformance follow-up and punch-list closure.


**Testing, Commissioning & Handover**

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer (Electrical)
jobs.description:

**Technical Reviews & Commissioning Controls**

- Review submittals, RFIs, test scripts, RAMS, switching procedures, inspection plans and technical documents.

- Review test packs against the design, employers requirements, approved submissions, manufacturer instructions and applicable standards.

- Attend factory witness tests and undertake QA/QC inspections on site or at vendor facilities when required.


**Testing, Energization & Integration**

**Management, Reporting & Handover**

- Lead electrical commissioning meetings and issue reports, minutes and actions.

- Maintain a daily commissioning diary, issue weekly reports and escalate safety, quality, technical or programme risks with clear mitigation actions.

- Verify turnover packs and support client witnessing, training and operational handover.

- Low-voltage switchboards, busbar systems, power distribution units and final distribution.

- Earthing, bonding, lightning protection, metering, EPMS interfaces, power-quality monitoring, alarms, controls, communications and verification of electrical system data points and sequences.

jobs.title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.


About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 02.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

jobs.title: Tiimiesihenkilö, uinninopetus
jobs.description:
**FitPit on yksi pohjoismaiden suurimmista uintipalveluita tuottavista yrityksistä. FitPit on ohjannut yli 200 000 tuntia uintia kaikissa sen muodoissa ja FitPitin palveluita käyttää viikoittain yli 2000 asiakasta ja yksittäisiä käyntejä FitPitin palveluissa on yli 2 000 000. Tavoitteena on tarjota ainutlaatuista, kokemuksellista, turvallista ja asiakaslähtöistä 5 tähden palvelua jokaiselle uimarille.**

Nyt haemme FitPitin energiseen tiimiin tiimiesihenkilöä uimaopettajille. Tiimiesihenkilön pääasiallisena tehtävänä on vastata tiimin arjesta, hyvinvoinnista ja kehittymisestä, ja toimia samalla itse aktiivisesti uinninopettajana.

Tässä roolissa noin 50 % työstäsi koostuu käytännön asiakastyöstä eli uinninopetuksesta eri kohderyhmille. Loput työstä painottuu oman tiimin johtamiseen, toiminnan kehittämiseen ja vastuualueiden koordinointiin. Tämä rooli sopii henkilölle, joka haluaa yhdistää käytännön tekemisen, ihmisten johtamisen ja toiminnan kehittämisen. Pääset vaikuttamaan aidosti oman tiimisi arkeen, asiakaskokemukseen ja siihen, miten FitPit kehittyy tulevaisuudessa.

**MITÄ ME TARJOAMME SINULLE**

Saat mahdollisuuden liittyä mukaan kasvavaan liikunta-alan yritykseen, jossa jokainen asiakas on yhtä tärkeä ja jokainen työntekijä on tasa-arvoinen. Me FitPitillä haluamme rakentaa tulevaisuutta välittäen ympärillä olevista asioista. Olemme muutoskykyinen organisaatio, jossa työntekijöiden palaute kuullaan ja jossa työntekijöiden kehittyminen on tärkeää. Lisäksi liittyessäsi tiimiimme saat seuraavaa:

- Kokoaikaisen (37,5h/vko) ja vakituisen työsuhteen

- Monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen roolin

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa tiimin arkeen ja kehittymiseen

- Tiimin ja organisaation tuen arjen johtamiseen – et jää yksin vastuusi kanssa (HR ja muu organisaatio)

- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä esihenkilönä nopeasti kasvavassa organisaatiossa

- Liukuva työaika ja etätyöskentely mahdollisuus

- Epassi 200 € vuodessa

- Palkkaus 2700-3200 €/kk riippuen kokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi + bonukset


**MITÄ TYÖSI TULEE PITÄMÄÄN SISÄLLÄÄN**

- Uinninopetus ja uinninvalvonta eri kohderyhmille

- Oman tiimin arjen johtaminen ja tukeminen

- Kehityskeskusteluiden, one-to-one-keskusteluiden ja varhaisen tuen keskusteluiden pitäminen

- Oman tiimin viikkopalavereiden vetäminen ja aktiivinen läsnäolo tiimin arjessa

- Suorituksen johtaminen, palautteenanto ja sitoutumisen tukeminen

- Vastaat oman tiimisi uintiopetuksen laadusta, asiakaskohtaamisista ja siitä, että toiminta vastaa FitPitin 5 tähden palvelulupausta

- Seuraat ja kehität oman tiimisi toimintaa asiakaskokemuksen, laadun ja kaupallisuuden näkökulmasta

- Uusien uimaopettajien rekrytointi ja perehdyttäminen

- Työvuorosuunnittelun kokonaisuudesta vastaaminen


**MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA**

- Kokemusta uimaopetuksesta tai liikunta-alalta

- Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai vahva halu kehittyä esihenkilönä

- Kykyä hahmottaa isoja kokonaisuuksia ja hyviä organisointitaitoja

- Kykyä kohdata ihmiset arjessa ja johtaa käytännön tasolla

- Kykyä tehdä päätöksiä ja kantaa vastuuta

- Nautit arjen johtamisesta ja haluat aidosti vaikuttaa oman tiimisi onnistumiseen, ilmapiiriin ja asiakaskokemukseen

- Otteesi työhön on aktiivinen, ratkaisukeskeinen ja vastuunkantoon tottunut

- Ymmärrät, että hyvä asiakaskokemus syntyy laadukkaasta opetuksesta, toimivasta tiimityöstä ja aktiivisesta läsnäolosta arjessa

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun
jobs.description:
Etsimme työntekijää lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun
Etsimme ammattitaitoista, luotettavaa ja oma-aloitteista työntekijää lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun pääkaupunkiseudulle.

Työ tapahtuu perheiden kodeissa ja on itsenäistä, vastuullista ja vaihtelevaa. Asiakasperheissämme on myös neuropsykiatrisesti oireilevia (nepsy) lapsia sekä erityistä tukea tarvitsevia lapsia, joten kokemus heidän ja heidän perheidensä kanssa työskentelystä on tehtävässä erittäin tärkeää.

Tehtävän koulutusvaatimus on soveltuva sosiaali- tai terveysalan tutkinto. Soveltuvia tutkintoja ovat esimerkiksi lähihoitaja, sosionomi, sosiaaliohjaaja, kodinhoitaja, lastenhoitaja tai kehitysvammaistenhoitaja.

Tehtävään voidaan valita myös varhaiskasvatuksen kandidaatti tai maisteri tai lastentarhanopettaja. Myös sosionomin, sairaanhoitajan, terveydenhoitajan tai kätilön opiskelija voi hakea, kun opinnoista on suoritettu vähintään 75 %. Koulutus tai vaadittu määrä opintoja tulee pystyä todentamaan ennen työn aloittamista.

Edellytämme aikaisempaa kokemusta lasten ja perheiden kanssa työskentelystä, itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta sekä sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Aikaisempi kokemus nepsy-lasten tai erityistä tukea tarvitsevien lasten kanssa työskentelystä on vahva etu.

jobs.title: Sjåfør og montør
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en fleksibel ekstrajobb der du kan jobbe når det passer deg?

Utleiekompaniet søker praktiske og pålitelige personer som kan hjelpe oss med montering, demontering, transport av utstyr til arrangementer og selskaper.

Vi har varierende arbeidsmengde gjennom året og trenger derfor ekstra mannskap som kan stille opp ved behov.

Stillingen innebærer tunge løft og arbeidet foregår for det meste utendørs eller i bil.

Vi har egne lastebiler og varebiler.

Arbeidstiden er normalt fra kl. 8.00 - 16.00. Kvelds- og helgejobbing forekommer.

Vi har ordnede arbeidsforhold. Opplæring vil bli gitt.

Krav til kompetanse

  • Snakke norsk eller engelsk

  • Førerkort kl. B

  • Erfaring som sjåfør på stor varebil (3500 kg)

Ønsket kompetanse

  • Henger BE

  • Truckførerbevis T2-T5

Personlige egenskaper

  • God arbeidsvilje

  • Serviceinnstilt

  • Du må kunne utføre fysisk krevende arbeidsoppgaver, inkludert tunge løft.

  • Pålitelig, fleksibel og samarbeider godt i team

Vi søker ekstra medarbeidere til konkrete oppdrag og midlertidige arbeidstopper gjennom året, spesielt i forbindelse med arrangementer, festivaler og vår travle sommersesong.

Arbeidsmengden vil variere, og dette er tilkallingsarbeid uten garantert antall arbeidstimer. Du får tilbud om oppdrag når vi trenger ekstra hjelp, og står fritt til å takke ja eller nei.

I sommersesongen kan det også være aktuelt med egne tidsavgrensede arbeidsavtaler med opptil 100 % stilling i noen sammenhengende måneder.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Utleiekompaniet driver med utleie av partytelt, møbler, dekketøy og arrangementutstyr til festivaler, bryllup og alle typer events. Vi er en totalleverandør og vårt konsept er at man kan leie alt på et sted. Våre kunder holder til i hele østlandsområdet.

Utleiekompaniet har gjennom 30 år opparbeidet et godt renome og vi anser oss selv som en betydelig og seriøs aktør innen utleie. Pålitelighet og kvalitet er vårt varemerke og våre største kunder er eventbyråer, festivalarrangører og bryllupsverter. Vi er 6 heltidsansatte med 15 sesongarbeidere. Vi har stort lager og kontorer på Solgaard skog.

Vi søker flere fleksible sjåfører, montører og tilkallingshjelp.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Productivity Lead
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate technologist to lead the ways of working across all of Bittium groups software development: about 300 developers building everything from firmware to web frontends. You will set the standard for how we build, review, test, document and ship software, and roll it out hands-on with the teams. You get real authority, direct access to R&D leadership and backing from group management.

You might be the person who

- argued the team into a better merge strategy, and was right.
- tried the new build tool the weekend it came out.
- replaced a team's creaking toolchain with something modern, and nobody wanted to go back.
- has been told no about a rewrite more than once.
- moved into a lead, architect or managerial role years ago and never stopped writing code or tinkering with the pipelines.
- has rolled a new way of working out across several teams, and knows the hard part was never the tooling.

If a couple of these sound like you, keep reading. Whether you are a senior engineer ready to take your first step into leading and owning change beyond your own team, or a leader who has done this before and still wants to get your hands dirty, this role is built for you.

What you will own

- You define what modern software engineering means at Bittium: the standard every team builds against, and you keep raising it as the industry moves.
- You set our group-wide engineering workflow: version control strategy, branching, code review and CI/CD, from commit to release, with room for what each product and team needs and built for agentic-first development.
- You decide the quality bar a release has to clear: what we require from test automation, documentation and review before software ships.
- You author an engineering handbook with our senior engineers: a practical guide to how we build software, clear enough that any team can pick it up and use it.
- You help shape how we measure engineering health.

Product teams choose the right technology for their product. You are the engineers' engineer: you define, and help build, the engineering infrastructure and ways of working they stand on: pipelines, quality gates, test and documentation tooling, ready to use and maintained like products. Adoption is supported, not dumped on the teams. The work does not end with the first rollout. The foundation keeps evolving, and you keep pushing it forward.

Your first six months

- Help write the first version of our engineering handbook: a practical guide to how we build software, in one place.
- Set the group's ways of working, starting with source control and CI/CD, with the first teams already building on it.
- Get the first shared pipeline, quality gates and documentation tooling live with real teams. Working, not a slide deck.
- Put the first release quality gates into production use.

Where we are headed

Our goal is simple: well-tested, well-documented software, built on a shared, modern development platform. Software development is shifting toward agentic workflows, and we want our codebases ready for that: modular, containerized and verifiable, so an agent can check one out, build it, run the tests and trust the result. You define what that readiness means in practice, together with our Head of AI. We are also investing heavily in hardware-in-the-loop test automation against real devices, and your standards set the bar there too.

What we ask

- A software engineering background strong enough to hold your own with our senior engineers.
- A track record of changing how teams work, whether as the engineer who pushed for better Git workflows and modern tooling and made it stick, or as the lead who ran that change across an organisation.
- Strong opinions and dirty hands. You prototype, build and fix things yourself, and you lead the change at the same time: you own the direction, carry it through and answer for the outcome.
- You know modern DevOps and the engineering platform behind it well: version control, CI/CD, test automation, developer documentation.
- Agentic software development has clicked for you. You work with coding agents daily, you see where this goes as agents take on whole tasks with less and less supervision, and you have opinions about what that demands from codebases, tests, environments and documentation.
- You can work across very different stacks. Ours include, among other things, C/C++, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, web frontends, embedded Linux and FPGA.
- Fluent Finnish and good English.
- Due to the nature of Bittiums business and our customers expectations, you are a Finnish citizen and able to pass security clearance conducted by the Finnish Security Intelligence Service (SUPO).

We do not count years of experience. Skill, will and passion decide.

What we offer

- Group-wide authority over engineering standards.
- Deep technology with real stakes, from military radios in national defence to ECG monitors in hospitals.
- Room to stay hands-on. Prototype, experiment, pick the best tools. IT supports the infrastructure.
- Hybrid work in Oulu, our headquarters software site, or Espoo. Flexible inside Finland. Competitive pay.

Interested?

Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.

About Bittium

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

jobs.title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
jobs.description:
Description

BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

What You'll Own

Email & Retention Design

  • Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
  • Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
  • Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms

Web Creative & CRO Support

  • Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
  • Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses â not just personal taste
  • Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs

Social & Ad Creative

  • Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
  • Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
  • Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed

Process & Quality

  • Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
  • Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
  • Present work with a clear rationale â why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA â to internal teams and, when needed, clients
  • Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
  • Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks â while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines
Who You Are

Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:

  • An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color â your portfolio speaks for itself
  • Conversion-minded â you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
  • Detail-obsessed â you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
  • A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
  • Excellent at managing your time â you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
  • AI-curious and AI-capable â you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
  • Adaptable â you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.
What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days:

  • You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
  • You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
  • You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
  • You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
  • Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests

Must-Have:

  • 2â4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)
  • A portfolio showing e-commerce work â ideally with context on goals and results
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow
  • Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices
  • Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands
  • Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team

Strong Differentiators:

  • Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)
  • Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms
  • Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built
  • Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data
  • Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)
  • Agency background preferred

This role is fully remote.

Time Commitment and Availability

  • Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow
  • Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST

Compensation

$20â25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate.

• You have excellent communication skills and attention to detail;

HR Business Partner (M/W)

Rockids, a network of nurseries operated by the La Maison Bleue Group, supports children and their families every day through a caring, innovative educational approach focused on children's development. Rockids is a recognized leader in the early childhood sector and operates 24 small-scale centers across Luxembourg, where quality of care, educational excellence, and staff well-being are at the heart of every project.
Joining Rockids means becoming part of a leading international group in the early childhood sector while working within a local, close-knit organization.

As an HR Business Partner, you will help shape the company's HR practices, support managers in their day-to-day challenges, and foster a high-performing work environment that promotes employee development.

Your primary mission will be to support the company's growth by implementing and continuously improving the HR processes that underpin its development.

As a true partner to senior management and teams, you will work across a broad range of responsibilities, including recruitment, HR development, HR administration, project management, and employee relations.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Recruitment and Onboarding

You will be responsible for the full recruitment process, from identifying staffing needs to onboarding new employees.
In this role, you will:

• Analyze hiring needs with facility directors and managers, taking into account staffing levels, operational requirements, and regulatory staff-to-resident ratios.
• Define candidate profiles and draft job descriptions and job postings.
• Post job openings and develop new recruitment channels.
• Proactively propose initiatives to strengthen the Group's attractiveness and employer brand.
• Conduct telephone pre-screenings for key roles across our facilities, including educational assistants, care assistants, educators, and facility managers.
• Conduct interviews and support managers throughout the recruitment process.
• Take a direct role in critical or sensitive hires and support less experienced managers in conducting interviews.
• Support newly appointed department heads as they develop their recruitment skills.
• Manage the administrative follow-up of applications.
• Coordinate the onboarding of new employees and monitor their probationary periods.

Supporting Managers and Teams

As a partner to managers and teams, you will support them in addressing their day-to-day HR challenges.

In particular, you will:

• Provide HR oversight and support to teams.
• Monitor and address absenteeism and turnover.
• Advise managers on disciplinary matters.
• Support skills development and employee development initiatives.
• Support the implementation of HR policies and procedures.
• Provide managers with practical HR advice tailored to operational realities and the specific needs of each location.

HR Administration

Working closely with our third-party service providers and internal teams, you will ensure the reliability and smooth execution of HR administrative processes.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Managing payroll processes, including preparing and submitting payroll data and generating monthly reports.
• Preparing employment contracts and contract amendments.
• Managing and maintaining the HRIS.
• Monitoring administrative procedures related to medical examinations and other regulatory requirements.
• Coordinating end-of-contract procedures.
• Maintaining relationships with our payroll service provider, government authorities, and other HR service providers.

HR Management and Reporting

You will contribute to the effective management of the HR function by producing and analyzing HR data.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Maintaining HR dashboards and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of HR data, including turnover and absenteeism figures.
• Analyzing key HR metrics related to absenteeism, turnover, recruitment, and payroll costs.
• Identifying trends and areas of concern and proposing appropriate corrective actions.
• Preparing HR reports and presentations for senior management.

As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

The role?
At ISL, we believe our young learners are capable, curious and full of ideas. They learn through relationships, play, inquiry and meaningful exploration of the world around them. We are seeking a Lower School Classroom Teaching Assistant to assist our Grade 2 teachers (students ages 7-8) in creating caring, inclusive environments where every student feels a sense of belonging, develops agency and independence, and experiences the joy of learning.

Working in partnership with the classroom teacher and wider Lower School team, the Teaching Assistant is an important resource for students and parents.

What will you do?

Working alongside the Grade 2 classroom teachers, you will:

• help create a caring and inquiry-rich learning environment;
• support individuals and small groups during student-initiated and teacher-directed learning;
• encourage curiosity, communication, collaboration, creativity and problem-solving;
• observe and document students' learning and emerging needs;
• prepare materials and learning spaces that invite exploration;
• support arrival, dismissal, transitions, specialist lessons, lunch, playground and other daily routines;
• help children develop positive relationships, independence and a sense of responsibility; and
• supervise and accompany students during activities, field trips and other experiences beyond the classroom.

What skills do you bring?

We are interested in what you can do, how you work with others and your potential to learn and grow. Your skills may have been developed through education, employment, volunteering, or community activities.

You will be able to demonstrate your ability to:

• Build trusting relationships with young students, helping them feel safe, known and valued.
• Support learning through inquiry, using conversation, thoughtful questions and exploration to extend students' thinking.
• Notice and respond to learners, observing students and collaborating with the teachers to document learning and development.
• Foster agency and independence, knowing when to support, when to question and when to give students space to try for themselves.
• Support multilingual learners and communicate clearly and sensitively with students developing English as an additional language.

• Collaborate effectively with teachers and colleagues and build positive, professional relationships with
• families.

• Adapt and take initiative in the dynamic environment of a classroom.

You genuinely enjoy being with young students and see them as capable learners. You are patient, curious, dependable and proactive. jobs.title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.


General Information:

• Reference: UOL08508 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)
• Publication date: -
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Working Hours:  
• Location: Belval Campus
• Planned starting date: 01/11/2026


Gender equality:

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

Senior Product Manager, EU FBA Supply Chain
Job ID: 10561353 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Removals Seller Experience within EU FBA Supply Chain. This is a highly cross-functional role: you'll define strategy and build the roadmap for the 250M+ units (7% of outbound) removed from our network annually, partnering with WW FBA, tech and science, fulfillment operations, and seller experience teams to durably reduce removals damages, improve removals speed, and deliver the consolidation and traceability sellers need.

You're analytical, curious, and relentless. You ask "why" five times, work across org boundaries with ease, and obsess over the seller and customer experience. You bring high judgment, deep conviction, and the grit to turn complex, cross-functional problems into durable solutions.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the removals SX roadmap. Define product and program strategy to overhaul the end-to-end removal experience, from order creation through FC processing, carrier handoff, and delivery. Prioritize across three core seller frictions (damages, speed, and consolidation/traceability), balancing seller trust against cost-to-serve and FC capacity guardrails.
• Bring EU voice to the S-Team working group. Serve as a key member of the cross-team working group with WW FBA and all partner teams to finalize the S-Team Removals overhaul goal and feeder goals. Own and deliver on the EU feeder goals, reporting progress through the working group's mechanisms.
• Eliminate defects, damages, and cancellations. Build mechanisms to identify and resolve recurring defects at the root cause. Own the strategy to reduce inaccurate removals from system gaps. Deliver Seller-facing tools for damage reporting, claims resolution, and proactive communication.
• Fix removals speed and traceability. Drive removal lead time reduction by partnering with FC Operations and enable end-to-end removal tracking so sellers have full visibility from order creation to delivery.
• Scale automated removals. Drive auto-removal adoption by defining the engagement tiers (default, agentic, guided self-service) and the guardrails that give sellers control while enabling automation.
• Be the metric and mechanism owner. Define, instrument, and reporting on Removals SX metrics. Decompose into actionable drivers and size each opportunity. Build the business case, write the narratives (PRFAQ, OP1/OP2 inputs, MBR/QBR updates), and manage the review cadence with senior leadership.

About the team

Today, over 60% of worldwide purchases on Amazon are for products from third-party businesses, mostly from Small- and Medium-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses (our Selling Partners) to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery returns and customer service to Amazon, utilizing the capabilities that Amazon has built over the last 25+ years. Sellers can list and sell their products across all of our European sites from a single account. This frees them to concentrate on what they do best - finding and developing new products and marketing them to potential customers.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience in problem solving and data analytics
- Experience in leading large, cross functional projects
- Experience presenting complex ideas in writing in the form of authoring white papers, proposals, or other formal strategy documents

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field

Description

Launch - Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe

Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
