The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.

• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)

jobs.title: Risk Officer – UCITS (m/f)
jobs.description:
Risk Officer – UCITS (m/f)

Fundsight is looking for a Risk Officer to join its UCITS Risk Management team.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing the risk management framework for a portfolio of UCITS clients.

Your role

• Assist the UCITS Risk Management team with the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework.
• Prepare periodic risk reports on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
• Perform risk assessments for existing and new UCITS, determine their risk profiles and monitor applicable risk limits, including market risk (commitment and VaR), credit risk, liquidity risk, counterparty risk and operational risk indicators (including TER, PTR and NAV errors).
• Contribute to the integration and monitoring of sustainability risks, including ESG, SFDR and EU Taxonomy considerations, within the risk management process.
• Support the Head of Risk Management on a range of risk management matters.
• Review the existing risk management framework against regulatory and internal requirements, in close cooperation with other departments.
• Monitor UCITS liquidity and analyse the results of liquidity stress tests.
• Provide regular updates to the Head of Risk Management and the relevant governing bodies.

Your skills and experience

• Master's degree in economics, finance, mathematics or a related field.
• At least 2 years of previous experience in risk management, control and/or audit functions.
• Good knowledge and understanding of the Luxembourg investment fund industry and the UCITS regulatory framework.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English; proficiency in French or Italian would be an asset.

Who we are

FundSight is an independent third-party Management Company (ManCo) based in Luxembourg, regulated by the CSSF and holding a dual AIFM and UCITS license as well as a MiFID authorization. Its business has been licensed since 1971 and was carved out and wholly acquired (100%) by BlackFin in 2025; FundSight has since been an independent company, with no operational or capital ties to Lemanik. It has a center of excellence in Porto, a branch in Paris, and representative offices in Hong Kong and Tokyo. The Group is also established in New York and Atlanta. FundSight today supports more than 120 institutional clients and manages more than €40 billion in assets under management. For more information: www.fundsight.com.

How to apply

If you are interested in this opportunity and would like to develop your career in a young, dynamic and international environment, please send your cover letter and detailed CV in English to recruitment@fundsight.com (reference: “Risk Officer – UCITS”).

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Before the employment agreement is signed, a copy of an official criminal record certificate (Bulletin No. 3), issued within the previous two months, must be provided for review.

Description

Job Summary

Amazon Logistics (AMZL) delivers millions of packages to customers every day across Amazon's Last Mile network. Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) operates a complex, dynamic Surface Transportation (ST) business. Supporting AMZL and ATS, the Global Fleet and Products (GFP) organization manages Fleet technology, capacity, vehicle in-life services programs, vendor management, planning and execution, and establishes vehicle requirements to move goods between Amazon Operations locations and deliver parcels to customers' doorsteps.

EU Fleet Finance is a specialized team of 8 finance professionals partnering with GFP in EU to drive strategic investment decisions and optimize fleet performance across 10 European countries. Finance is providing planning, analysis, and cost controllership for the middle and last mile fleet of tractors, trailers and delivery vehicles. Together with operations leaders and AMZL, ATS and DSP Finance organizations we optimize fleet costs, define vehicle economics, and shape Amazon's delivery model. Our work directly influences strategic decisions on preferred vehicle types, alternative mobility solutions, and partner remuneration models. We are continuously expanding this business partnership to international GFP activities.

The team is seeking a Finance Manager to connect team activities across sourcing, project and program activities, for both middle and last mile, coordinating and consolidating quantitative and qualitative information when it comes to planning and reporting. This role requires an experienced finance professional who will independently assess and handle priorities in an increasingly complex environment, ensuring appropriate stakeholder management.

Given our team's size and scope, you'll engage with numerous stakeholders across GFP operations teams and Finance organizations, providing subject matter expertise to senior leaders. You'll define, track and help to improve metrics measuring vehicle operating costs, cost per package, route economics, and kilometer efficiency. The role combines European-wide perspective with country-level insights, evolving with fleet lifecycle management, new vehicle acquisitions, and innovative sourcing models.

Description

We are the Global Procurement Organization, and we're on a mission to reshape how one of the world's largest companies powers its operations with clean energy. We're looking for a Category manager to own and scale our on site solar energy portfolio across Europe, the UK, and the Middle East, driving hundreds of megawatts of new capacity and tens of millions in cost savings.

You'll be building the playbook for solar procurement in some of the fastest growing renewable energy markets on the planet. Own the full solar portfolio across a diverse set of markets from Western Europe to the Arabian Peninsula, where solar capacity is projected to grow 10x by 2035

Navigate complex regulatory landscapes from EU clean energy mandates to Saudi Vision 2030 and UAE's ambitious renewable targets

Structure creative deals deciding when to deploy capital purchases vs. power purchase agreements vs. operating lease models across markets with very different economics

Drive real sustainability impact your work will directly eliminate thousands of metric tons of CO2 annually while reducing grid dependency across hundreds of logistics facilities. Shape a category from the ground up in emerging Middle East markets, where solar is unlocking operations in locations where traditional grid connections aren't even possible

If you love solving complex problems across cultures and borders, and want your work to have measurable environmental and financial impact, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities

- Develop and execute the long term sourcing strategy for on site solar across Europe, UK, and Middle East covering rooftop, carport, and ground mount technologies
- Lead portfolio based tenders, bundling demand across multiple countries to maximize negotiation leverage and reduce procurement cycle times
- Build financial models including net present value, total cost of ownership, and payback analysis to support investment decisions and senior leadership recommendations
- Own strategic supplier relationships through quarterly business reviews, performance tracking, and capacity planning while maintaining competitive tension across the vendor base

Your day starts with a portfolio review call across European markets, then shifts to negotiating contract terms with a supplier for a compliance driven deployment. You'll join the Power and Utilities team within Amazon's Global Procurement Organization. We manage the full energy lifecycle for Amazon's worldwide operations across five areas: utilities supply and audits, power infrastructure and grid services, on site renewables and storage, EV charging infrastructure, and hydrogen mobility solutions. This role sits within the renewables and storage pillar, but you'll work alongside colleagues tackling everything from microgrids and demand response to hydrogen refueling and electric vehicle charging. jobs.description:
Senior Treasury Dealer, Treasury
Job ID: 10563607 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl - D40

Description

Amazon seeks a Senior Treasury Dealer to join the Treasury Strategy and Markets Team, which oversees global foreign exchange trading, commodities, and equities execution. This role sits at the heart of Amazon's trading operations, where you will be responsible for executing and managing multi-asset class trading strategies across FX, equities, and commodities markets. As a key member of the team, you will leverage trading platforms and analytics to drive efficient execution while ensuring best-in-class trading practices. The successful candidate should be comfortable with ambiguity and balancing multiple competing priorities, demonstrating strong decision-making capabilities in fast-paced market conditions. You will build and maintain strategic relationships with key banking counterparties and work cross-functionally across Amazon's diverse business lines to support the company's global trading needs.
This position requires a self-starter who will work to continuously improve Treasury processes while maintaining a rigorous control environment and compliance with various Amazon policies.

Key Responsibilities include:

• Execute foreign exchange, equity, rates, and commodity trades to support Amazon's global business operations
• Develop and maintain real-time monitoring of market conditions, liquidity, and pricing across multiple venues and counterparties to ensure optimal execution
• Implement best execution practices and conduct regular Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) to optimize trading performance
• Create and monitor detailed reports that track the performance of execution metrics, including fill rates, rejection rates, and price improvements against internal KPIs
• Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers to ensure competitive pricing and market access across all asset classes
• Analyze market microstructure and implement algorithmic trading strategies to minimize market impact and improve execution efficiency
• Work with banking partners to develop and implement new execution methodologies for restricted currencies and emerging markets
• Collaborate with technology teams to enhance trading platforms, implement API connectivity, and automate execution processes
• Monitor trade settlement processes and resolve any trading-related issues with counterparties
• Work extensively with internal groups including Global Payments, Finance Operations, and Technology teams on trading infrastructure improvements
• Design and maintain trading dashboards that provide real-time visibility into execution performance, market conditions, and liquidity metrics
• Develop and document standard operating procedures for trading activities across all asset classes
• Participate in periodic reviews of counterparty performance and recommend changes to the counterparty panel as needed
• Stay current with market developments, regulatory changes, and new trading technologies that could impact execution strategies
• Conduct regular reviews of execution policies and procedures to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
- Experience in a finance role including partnering with a variety of stakeholders across the business
- Experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to support business decisions
- Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 5+ years of finance experience or a related analytical field. Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)

Preferred Qualifications

- MBA, or CFA
- Advanced or master's degree in finance, economics, or mathematics, such as a CA, CMA, CWA, or MBA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Knowledge of of financial reporting tools (Cognos, Redshift)
- Experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan
- Experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)

- roční bonus až do výše jedné mzdy (nenárokové, metodiku vysvětlíme na pohovoru), po zkušební době příspěvek 500 Kč na penzijní připojištění, možnost multisport karty, fasování pracovních oděvů, občerstvení na pracovišti, automyčka zdarma, vstup na wellness v hotelu Savannah zdarma, týmová slevová karta FreePass k obchodníkům ve Freeport Fashion Outlet a VIP partnerům centra, parkování a autobusová zastávka přímo u budovy.

KEY STRENGTHS: STRONG FOCUS AND SENSE OF RESPONSIBILITY, A FRIENDLY AND EMPATHETIC ATTITUDE, EASE IN OPERATING BASIC CONTROL PANELS AND MANUAL TOOLS, GOOD PHYSICAL FITNESS, AND A WILLINGNESS TO WORK OUTDOORS UNDER CHANGING HIGH-MOUNTAIN WEATHER CONDITIONS. jobs.title: Perheohjaaja
jobs.description:
**Haemme perhetyöntekijöitä ja ammatillisia tukihenkilöitä tuntityöhön Länsi-Uudenmaan Hyvivointialueelle LUVN.**

Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden parissa ja samalla työskennellä joustavasti oman aikataulusi mukaan?

Onniperhe Oy hakee kasvavaan toimintaansa tuntityöntekijöitä ammatillisen tukihenkilötoiminnan sekä perhetyön tehtäviin koko Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueelle (LUVN).

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**

**Ammatillinen tukihenkilötyö** Ammatillisena tukihenkilönä työskentelet lapsen tai nuoren kanssa hänen arjessaan. Tuet häntä esimerkiksi koulunkäynnissä, vapaa-ajassa ja arjen hallinnassa. Työ sisältää keskustelua, yhdessä tekemistä ja harrastuksiin osallistumista. Tavoitteena on vahvistaa nuoren itseluottamusta, sosiaalisia taitoja ja arjen sujumista. Toimit turvallisena aikuisena, joka kuuntelee, kannustaa ja tukee.

**Perhetyö / tehostettu perhetyö** Perhetyössä työskentelet koko perheen kanssa heidän arjessaan. Tuet vanhemmuutta, arjen sujuvuutta ja perheen vuorovaikutusta. Työ on käytännönläheistä ja tavoitteellista, ja siinä etsitään yhdessä ratkaisuja arjen haasteisiin. Työ sisältää ohjausta, keskustelua ja konkreettista tukea. Teet yhteistyötä myös perheen verkostojen, kuten koulun ja sosiaalitoimen kanssa.

**Tietoa meistä**

Onniperhe Oy on vuonna 2023 perustettu sosiaalialan yritys, joka tarjoaa monipuolisia sosiaalihuollon avopalveluita lapsille, nuorille ja perheille.

Tarjoamme erityisesti perhetyötä, tehostettua perhetyötä sekä ammatillista tukihenkilötoimintaa. Työmme tavoitteena on tukea perheiden arkea, vahvistaa heidän voimavarojaan ja edistää koko perheen hyvinvointia.

Lähestymme jokaista perhettä yksilöllisesti ja työskentelemme heidän omassa arkiympäristössään. Tavoitteenamme on tarjota käytännönläheistä tukea, ohjausta ja ratkaisuja arjen haasteisiin.

Monikielisyys ja kulttuurisensitiivisyys ovat meille keskeisiä. Huomioimme asiakkaidemme erilaiset kielelliset ja kulttuuriset taustat.

**Odotamme sinulta**

- Sinulla on sosiaali- tai terveysalan tutkinto (esim. sosionomi AMK). Sinulla on vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemus lastensuojelutyöstä.

- Työ edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä iltapäivä- ja iltapainotteisesti.

- Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi

- Edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen taitoa (suullinen ja kirjallinen). Englannin, ruotsin ja muun kielen taito katsotaan eduksi.

- Valitun hakijan tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain (770/1993) 6 §:n 2 mukainen lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rekisteriote.

- Olet rekisteröitynyt Valviran JulkiTerhikki- tai JulkiSuosikki-rekisteriin.


**Mitä saat meiltä?**

- Palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukainen (G25EG27) kokemuksesta riippuen. Lisäksi maksetaan ilta- ja viikonloppulisät sekä lomakorvaus.

- Sinulla on mahdollisuus suunnitella oma työaikasi vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihin.

- Korvaamme työajot kilometrikorvauksina.

- Saat kattavan ja rauhallisen perehdytyksen työhön.

- Meillä työskentelet osana välittävää ja ammatillista työyhteisöä. Tarjoamme työyhteisön, jossa tuetaan toisia ja jaetaan osaamista.

- Tarjoamme työterveyshuollon, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja työssä jaksamista.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Support
jobs.description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

  • Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
  • Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

  • Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

  • Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

  • Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

  • Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
  • Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
  • The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

  • Contract type: full-time or part-time
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable

Nordhealth (OB:NORDH) is the leading provider of cloud-based Practice Information Management Software (PIMS) to veterinary and therapy professionals.

We are here to create great healthcare products. Thats at our very core, but its the people who make companies great, not the other way around. jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Fatigue Assessment and Enhancement of Aluminium Welded Structures
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) has a vacancy for a PhD candidate within fatigue and structural integrity, funded through the Centre for Research-based Innovation SFI FAST Future Aluminium Structures. 

The position is 3-year doctoral research fellowships starting in 2026. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the fatigue and structural integrity research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Associate Professor Nima Razavi.


About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. 

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

PhD project

This PhD position focuses on the fatigue performance of welded aluminium structures, with particular emphasis on understanding and improving fatigue-critical regions in the weldment. Welding introduces local variations in microstructure, mechanical properties, residual stresses and defects across the heat-affected zone (HAZ) and fusion zone, which can strongly influence fatigue crack initiation and propagation. The research will investigate how these local characteristics, together with weld geometry and the processing route of the substrates, govern fatigue performance and the transferability of fatigue assessment methods across different structural configurations.

The candidate will investigate strategies for fatigue-life enhancement through selected local post-weld heat treatments, mechanical treatments and in-situ thermo-mechanical modification techniques. Experimental work will include fatigue testing supported by relevant local characterization, XCT-based defect characterization and in-situ mechanical testing to study damage and crack evolution. The experimental findings will be combined with local, defect-based and fracture-mechanics-based fatigue prediction approaches to assess fatigue performance and treatment effectiveness. The research will also explore the implications of thickness-dependent behaviour and local weld properties for existing fatigue design approaches and potential future design recommendations.

The candidate will work in close collaboration with industrial partners and other researchers within FAST and will be responsible for reporting progress and delivering research outputs to the centre.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Investigate the fatigue behaviour and damage mechanisms of aluminium weldments, considering local variations in mechanical properties, microstructure, residual stresses, and weld-induced defects
  • Develop and evaluate local post-weld heat treatment and mechanical modification strategies to improve the properties and fatigue performance of critical weld regions
  • Investigate the applicability of in-situ thermal and mechanical modification techniques during welding for controlling local material properties and improving fatigue resistance
  • Perform fatigue testing combined with XCT-based defect characterization and in-situ mechanical testing to investigate fatigue crack initiation and evolution and their relationship with local material and geometrical features
  • Develop and validate local, defect-based and fracture-mechanics-based fatigue prediction approaches using the experimental findings, and assess their applicability to welded aluminium structures
  • Evaluate the implications of the obtained results for existing fatigue design approaches, particularly regarding material thickness, local weld properties, presence of post-consumer scrap, and potential recommendations for fatigue design standards
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Material Engineering, Solid Mechanics or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Documented strong background in experimental mechanics, solid mechanics, and mechanics of materials
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Scandinavian language skills
  • Knowledge of fatigue and fracture mechanics
  • Knowledge and testing skills in material characterization and microstructural analysis  
  • Knowledge and experience in mechanical testing of materials or components
  • Experience in using Finite Element Codes such as ABAQUS, ANSYS, etc. for numerical analysis

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

jobs.title: Technician for lab management and user support
jobs.description:
Technician for lab management and user support

CONTEXT:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) is an international centre for scientific research situated in Grenoble, France. It is Europe's leading neutron science facility. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research in a wide variety of scientific fields. The Biology, Deuteration, Chemistry and Soft Matter (BDCS) group operates the Chemistry and Soft Matter support laboratories, which offer equipment, lab space and support for sample preparation and characterisation, serving both external users and in-house scientists. The BDCS group also operates the Lipid and Deuteration laboratories, which are equipped with state-of-the-art instrumentation for the production and characterisation of tailor-made deuterated biological molecules for the ILL user community.

YOUR TASKS:
In the context of the European FEDER EPN-AVENIR-ILL project and the arrival of new laboratory equipment in the BDCS group, you will reinforce the team in the management of the different labs, support the users with their scientific projects, including the activities of the ILL Science Hubs, and liaise between the members of the group. You will welcome and interact with users before, during and after their stay, assist with operating equipment, and help with sample preparation. Your activities will include:
. Supporting the scientists and lab managers by communicating with, welcoming and assisting users with their scientific projects in the different labs
. Management of laboratory supplies and stocks, and regular calibration of lab equipment
. Organisation of lab space and equipment, as well as participation in waste management and the chemical inventory
. Supporting the Lipid Lab staff with the user programme, in particular with running the chromatography equipment (HPLC, GC, TLC,.), including the new FEDER equipment
. The successful candidate will interact with various actors at ILL, including members of the BDCS group, safety engineers, technicians, as well as ILL users and external companies.

YOUR PROFILE:
You have a Level 5 qualification (HND or equivalent) in chemistry (or biochemistry)
. Expertise in the operation of standard (bio-)chemistry laboratory equipment
. Sound knowledge of laboratory safety rules and regulations
. Autonomy and good communication skills
. Experience of working in a research facility, in industry or at a large-scale research infrastructure would be an asset
. You must have a sound knowledge of written and spoken English. Knowledge of French would be a plus (a language course could be paid for by the ILL)

QUALITY OF LIFE:
This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Produktionen av FPA-taxitjänster inleds den 1 januari 2027, och i och med den nya tjänsteproduktionen söker vi nu nya kundrådgivare till våra beställningscentraler.

Tidigare erfarenhet av kundservice eller arbete i en callcentermiljö är meriterande, men det viktigaste är rätt inställning och en vilja att lära sig.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Ilomantsiin
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Hei sinä, joka viihdyt tuotantolaitoksessa yhtä hyvin kuin neuvotteluhuoneessa!


Me olemme InSolution – 35 osaajan joukko teollisen softan ja automaation asiantuntijoita, jotka syttyvät ongelmien ratkaisemisesta, uuden oppimisesta sekä tuloksekkaasta asiakastyöstä. * InSolutionin palveluiden ja ratkaisujen tavoitteellinen myynti

* Markkinatrendien seuraaminen, asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistaminen ja sopivien ratkaisujen rakentaminen yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa

Hae meille, mikäli tunnistat itsesti alhaalta:

* Kyky ja aito halu ymmärtää asiakkaan liiketoimintaa ja tarpeita teknistaloudellisesta näkökulmasta

jobs.title: Plant Engineer Layout, Lappeenranta or Espoo
jobs.description:

You will support equipment engineering and collaborate with internal stakeholders to deliver high-quality layout solutions. This position is specifically designed as a career-building stepping stone toward a Chief Engineer role.

You are offered
We offer a structured career development path with dedicated mentorship from senior experts. You will work on diverse, large-scale global projects within a stable and growing business environment. Additionally, we provide a flexible hybrid work model and modern tools to support your success.

Work tasks

- Coordinate and manage subcontracted engineering work.
- Provide layout and plant design support to equipment engineering, procurement, and customer interfaces.

We are looking for

- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to work.

jobs.title: Varaosamyyjä Maakunan Auto Seinäjoki
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

VARAOSAMYYJÄ Maakunnan Auto Seinäjoki

Haluatko olla tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa, että korjaamon työt etenevät sujuvasti ja asiakkaiden autot valmistuvat ajallaan?
Etsimme vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen varaosamyyjää Seinäjoen Maakunnan Autolle vahvistamaan Toyota-huoltomme varaosatiimiä.

Maakunnan Auto ja Autoliike Nystedt muodostavat yhdessä kuudella paikkakunnalla toimivan autoalan yrityksen, jossa työskentelee suuri joukko myynnin, huollon, korikorjauksen ja varaosatoimintojen ammattilaisia. Olemme osa Osuuskauppa KPO konsernia. Nyt etsimme tähän joukkoon uutta osaajaa Seinäjoen varaosatiimiin.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?
Varaosamyyjänä vastaat varaosien saatavuudesta Toyota-huollon ja vauriokorjaamon tarpeisiin. Huolehdit varaosien tilaamisesta, vastaanotosta, keräilystä ja varaston ylläpidosta sekä työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä työnjohdon, huoltoneuvojien ja asentajien kanssa. Tehtävän keskiössä on korjaamomme toiminnan tukeminen ja korjaustöiden sujuvuuden varmistaminen.
Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:
varaosien tilaaminen ja hankinta huollon sekä vauriokorjaamon tarpeisiin
varaosien vastaanotto, tarkastus ja käsittely
varaosien keräily työmääräimille
varaosavaraston ylläpito ja kehittäminen
yhteistyö työnjohdon, huoltoneuvojien ja asentajien kanssa
varaosaratkaisujen etsiminen Toyota-ajoneuvoihin sekä muihin automerkkeihin

Toyota on päämerkkimme, mutta huollamme ja korjaamme kaikkia automerkkejä. Lisäksi toimipisteessämme toimii vauriokorjaamo, mikä tekee työstä monipuolisen ja tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamista laajasti autoalan jälkimarkkinoinnin parissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?
Arvostamme ennen kaikkea oikeaa asennetta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua oppia uutta.
Toivomme, että sinulla on:
kiinnostusta autoalaa ja ajoneuvotekniikkaa kohtaan
hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot
järjestelmällinen ja vastuullinen työote
kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti
halu kehittyä varaosa-alan ammattilaisena

Aiempi kokemus varaosamyynnistä tai autoalalta katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätöntä. Perehdytämme tehtävään ja tuemme sinua onnistumaan työssäsi. B-ajokortti on tehtävässä tarpeellinen.

Mitä tarjoamme?
Tarjoamme sinulle:
vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn vakaassa ja tunnetussa yrityksessä
mahdollisuuden työskennellä alan johtavan automerkin, Toyotan, parissa
monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa näet läheltä huollon ja vauriokorjaamon arjen
osaavan sekä nuorekkaan työyhteisön
kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan kouluttautumismahdollisuuden
S-ryhmän ja Osuuskauppa KPO:n kattavat henkilöstöedut

Kiinnostuitko?
Jätä hakemus ja cv viimeistään 31.10.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa huoltopäällikkö Jarkko Viitala, puh. 050 9136163.

120- vuotias Osuuskauppa KPO on lähes 1,2 miljardin euron vuosimyynnillään Suomen suurimpia alueosuuskauppoja. Toimimme Kokkolan, Pietarsaaren, Vaasan ja Ylivieskan talousalueilla. Olemme alueemme marketkaupan markkina- ja hintajohtaja sekä markkinajohtajia polttoneste-, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa. Lisäksi harjoitamme autokauppaa. Meillä on 140 000 asiakasomistajaa ja työllistämme noin 2 300 palvelualan ammattilaista. Osuuskauppa KPO on useampana vuonna saanut Suomen innostavimmat työpaikat -tunnustuksen. Toimintamme taloudellinen menestys päätyy kokonaisuudessaan kauppapalvelujemme kestävään kehittämiseen ja asiakasomistajiemme eduksi.

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitajan sijaisuus, Ikääntyneiden palvelut, Kuntouttava arviointijakso kotona, Uusikaupunki
jobs.description:
Sairaanhoitajana työskentelet kuntouttavalla arviointijaksolla asiakkaan kotiympäristössä. Jakso on ajallisesti rajattu, suunniteltu ja tavoitteellinen kokonaisuus, joka käynnistyy palveluohjaajan palvelutarpeen arvioinnin, sairaalasta suunnitellun kotiutumisen tai asiakkaan tai hänen läheistensä huolen perusteella.

Työ toteutuu tehostettuna ja intensiivisenä kotihoitona, jossa pääpaino on asiakkaan toimintakyvyn ja itsenäisen suoriutumisen tukemisessa kuntoutumista edistävillä toimenpiteillä. Tavoitteena on, että asiakas voi hyödyntää omia voimavarojaan ja asua omassa kodissaan mahdollisimman omatoimisesti ja turvallisesti.

Jakson aikana ja sen päätteeksi osallistut moniammatilliseen arviointiin yhdessä asiakkaan ja hänen läheistensä kanssa. Arvioinnin pohjalta määritellään tarvittavat yksilölliset kotona asumista tukevat ja turvaavat palvelut. RAI-arviointi on keskeinen osa arviointijaksoa ja palveluiden myöntämistä. Sairaanhoitajan tehtäviin kuuluu olennaisesti myös asiakkaan lääkitykseen ja sairauksien hoitoon liittyvät tehtävät. Työ on itsenäistä, monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa, mutta et työskentele yksin. Työ on kaksivuorotyötä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen ja vastuullisen työn, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan asiakkaiden arkeen ja kotona pärjäämiseen. Saat aloittaessasi perusteellisen perehdytyksen, ja työssäsi sinua tukevat osaava tiimi, vastaava sairaanhoitaja sekä esihenkilö. Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää ja kehittää ammattitaitoasi vaihtelevassa ja liikkuvassa työympäristössä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta kykyä tiimin päivittäisen työn organisointiin asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaan, itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, joustavuutta ja innostusta uuden oppimiseen. Työkokemus ikääntyneiden palveluista on eduksi tehtävässä menestymiseen.

Edellytämme hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa sekä voimassa olevaa ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Eduksi katsomme voimassa olevan LOVe-lääkeluvan, RAI-arviointimittariston tuntemuksen sekä hyvät tietotekniset taidot

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) mukainen sairaanhoitajan laillistus

Kiinnostuitko? Hae mukaan merkitykselliseen työhön iäkkäiden kotona asumisen tukemiseksi ja jätä hakemuksesi - odotamme sinua osaksi osaavaa tiimiä.

jobs.title: BLIV OPERATØR PÅ VORES MOBILE GRANULERINGSANLÆG
jobs.description:
Kan du lide maskiner, praktisk arbejde og nye arbejdssteder?

PH Plastic Recycling ApS søger 2 operatører, der har lyst til at tage ansvar for driften av vores mobile granuleringsanlæg og samtidig blive en del af en branche med fokus på genanvendelse.

Her får du ikke en ensformig hverdag. Du arbejder ude hos kunder i Danmark og resten af Norden, hvor du er med til at omdanne plastaffald til nye råmaterialer.

Vi søger både dig, der kommer alene, og jer, der allerede kender hinanden og gerne vil arbejde sammen. Arbejdet indebærer stor rejseaktivitet, og du skal derfor trives med at være væk hjemmefra i længere perioder.

 

EN PRAKTISK HVERDAG MED ANSVAR

Som operatør bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige drift. Du arbejder tæt på anlægget, følger produktionen og sørger for, at processen kører sikkert og effektivt.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Betjening og overvågning af granuleringsanlægget

  • Justering af anlægget under produktionen

  • Kontrol af det færdige granulat

  • Påfyldning og håndtering af plastmaterialer

  • Klargøring af materialer og arbejdsområde

  • Daglig rengøring og vedligeholdelse

  • Mindre fejlfinding og praktiske reparationer

  • Samarbejde med kolleger og kunder på arbejdsstedet

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med granulering. Vi sørger for en grundig oplæring, så du bliver tryg ved både anlægget, arbejdsprocesserne og ansvaret.

 

VI SØGER DIG, DER KAN LIDE AT FÅ TINGENE TIL AT VIRKE

Du behøver ikke have en bestemt uddannelse. Det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt, tager ansvar og har lyst til at arbejde med maskiner.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har interesse for maskiner, teknik og produktion

  • Kan lide at arbejde praktisk og tage fat

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og løsningsorienteret

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og bevare overblikket

  • Trives med en hverdag, hvor arbejdsstedet skifter

  • Har dit bagland i orden, så du kan være væk hjemmefra i længere tid ad gangen

  • Kan samarbejde med både kolleger og kunder på pladsen

  • Kan gøre dig forståelig på dansk eller engelsk

Erfaring fra f.eks. produktion, landbrug, entreprenørbranchen, maskinbetjening eller lignende er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

 

Krav og certifikater:

  • Gyldigt kørekort B er et krav.

  • Truckkort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

 

REJSEARBEJDE I DANMARK OG NORDEN

Vores mobile anlæg flyttes mellem forskellige arbejdssteder, hvor vi genanvender plast fra blandt andet affaldsbeholdere. Du kan derfor forvente arbejdsdage på forskellige lokationer i:

  • Danmark

  • Sverige

  • Norge

  • Finland

Når du arbejder ude, sørger vi naturligvis for overnatning, og du får udbetalt diæter.

Projekterne kan strække sig over længere perioder, og du vil derfor ikke være hjemme hver dag. Til gengæld får du mulighed for at opleve nye steder, møde forskellige kunder og arbejde med en løsning, der gør en konkret forskel for miljøet.

 

VI TILBYDER

  • Fast arbejde i en sund virksomhed i udvikling

  • Fast timeløn og diæter efter reglerne ved rejsearbejde

  • Længerevarende projekter i hele Norden

  • Grundig og sikker oplæring i vores mobile granuleringsanlæg

  • Et selvstændigt job med masser af ansvar

  • En varieret og aktiv arbejdsdag

♻️ BLIV EN DEL AF PH PLASTIC RECYCLING

Hos PH Plastic Recycling arbejder vi med at give plastaffald nyt liv. Vi har udviklet en mobil løsning, der gør det muligt at bearbejde plast direkte hos kunden. Det betyder, at du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor maskiner, genanvendelse og rejsearbejde går hånd i hånd.

Udgangspunkt:
PH Plastic Recycling ApS – Ringsted (Arbejdet foregår primært ude hos kunderne).

HAR DU LYST TIL AT KOMME MED PÅ HOLDET?

Overvejer du at søge alene, eller har du en god makker, du gerne vil arbejde sammen med på landevejen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Send dit CV eller en kort beskrivelse af dig selv på mail til henrik@phplastic.dk – eller ring direkte til Henrik på tlf. +45 93 39 22 77 for en uforpligtende snak om stillingen.

Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt (vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og lukker opslaget, når de rette kandidater er fundet).
Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale.

jobs.title: Senior Security Consultant – Incident Response
jobs.description:
Do you want to be on the frontline when serious cyber incidents hit? You will lead complex investigations, guide customers through crises, and help shape our incident response services. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative team working with some of the most interesting and challenging cyber cases in the market. 

 

Make a real impact in high‑stakes incidents 

You will be part of a small, expert Incident Response team handling everything from ransomware to targeted attacks across large, complex environments. You will work closely with customers, helping them stay calm, informed and in control during critical situations. You will collaborate with specialists across MDR, Intelligence and Consulting, learn from unique cases, and contribute to the development of tools, methodologies and publications. At CSIS, we invest in your growth with dedicated training time, certifications, and peer learning - in an open, diverse and friendly culture built on “We commit, We care, We succeed together.” 

When you join CSIS, you will get an interesting job in a company and an industry which is growing. You will get interesting challenges, that truly make a difference for our customers, and you will be able to take ownership for your work from start to finish. And you will not least get 130+ fantastic colleagues from all over the world. Besides that, you will get: 

  • Flexible work from home arrangements 

  • A competitive salary and personal benefit package 

  • 5 weeks holiday, plus 5 extra days off each year 

  • Health Insurance, a pension, plus life and disability insurance 

  • Healthy, varied lunches (incl. vegetarian and allergy options) 

  • Home-baked goods, healthy snacks, coffee, tea and sodas in the office

  • Social activities and company events throughout the year

  • Paid mobile phone subscription and home internet 

 

Your new job 

In this client-facing role, you will lead major incident response engagements, support multiple customers, guide junior responders, and help clients strengthen their detection and response capabilities. You will work across diverse environments, industries, and technologies, making adaptability and strong communication essential.  

Your responsibilities will be: 

  • Incident Response & Investigations (Client-Facing) 

  • Lead complex and high-severity incident response engagements for customers across varied infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, hybrid). 

  • Perform advanced forensic analysis across a variety of data sources (disk, memory, network, malware, cloud) and provide clients with clear, actionable findings. 

  • Coordinate response activities with client technical teams, management, and legal/compliance contacts. 

  • Develop accurate incident timelines, attribution assessments (where possible), and root-cause analyses. 

  • Customer Communication & Advisory 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients during and after incidents, providing guidance on containment, recovery, and long-term improvements. 

  • Deliver polished, professional technical reports and executive summaries for clients. 

  • Present findings to technical teams as well as to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Preparedness, Consulting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Assist clients with incident readiness assessments, IR playbook creation, tabletop exercises, and contribute to CSIS’s MDR detection engineering. 

  • Contribute to development of internal incident response methodologies, tooling, and best practices. 

  • Mentor and guide junior team members during engagements and internal training. 

 

About you 

You are an experienced incident responder who remains calm and structured under pressure. You enjoy working closely with customers, translating complex technical issues into clear business language, and you value collaboration and knowledge sharing. You are curious, proactive and driven by making a real difference in the fight against cybercrime. 

You bring most of the following: 

Qualifications & Technical Expertise 

  • Hands-on incident response experience, ideally in a consultancy, MSSP, DFIR, or CSIRT environment. 

  • Proven track record leading multi-client or multi-environment incident investigations. 

  • Deep knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory security.  

  • Strong knowledge of network protocols and security 

  • Strong experience with SIEM and EDR tools, including detection logic, log correlation, and threat analysis. Hands-on experience with Sentinel/Defender and CrowdStrike a plus. 

  • Advanced digital forensics experience (memory, disk, log, network). 

  • Familiarity with evidence handling, chain-of-custody standards, and forensic reporting. 

  • Strong understanding of attack techniques and threat actor behaviours (MITRE ATT&CK). 

  • Experience in cloud investigations (Azure/AWS/GCP logs, identity, telemetry). 

 

Consultancy-Specific Requirements 

  • Ability to manage multiple parallel client engagements and prioritize effectively. 

  • Excellent client-facing communication: confident, calm, and credible during crises. 

  • Strong written documentation skills for both highly technical and non-technical readers. 

  • Ability to scope engagements, set expectations, and represent the company professionally. 

 

Regulatory & Governance Knowledge 

  • Familiarity with European cybersecurity requirements, especially NIS2, GDPR breach handling, and relevant ISO standards. 

  • Ability to advise clients on improving governance, detection maturity, and incident readiness. 

 

Preferred Skills 

  • Danish speaker – English only can be accomodated. 

  • Threat hunting experience or development of hunting hypotheses. 

  • Scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash). 

  • Experience in red team/purple team activities or adversary emulation. 

  • Experience providing IR training or running tabletop exercises. 

 

Relevant Certifications  

  • GIAC: GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCFE, GPEN, GNFA. 

  • OSCP, CISSP, CISM, or cloud security certs (Azure/AWS/GCP). 

  • Equivalent real-world experience also highly considered and appriciated. 

 

Personal Competencies 

  • Professional, customer-oriented communication style. 

  • Ability to remain composed and decisive under pressure. 

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail. 

  • Leadership qualities and ability to mentor junior responders. 

  • Curiosity and passion for threat research, attacker behaviour, and continuous learning.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja
jobs.description:
Tulisitko sinä töihin Spesiolle henkilökohtaisen avun pariin? Haemme lämminhenkistä ihmistä, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä asiakkaidemme kanssa. Tutkintoa tärkeämpää on hyvä asenne sekä sosiaaliset taidot.

Etsimme avustajaa Leppävirran pitäjille **Riihirannalle** (etäisyys Leppävirran keskustasta on n. 30 km, Varkaudesta n. 20 km). Asiakas on n. 60-vuotias nainen, joka sairastaa etenevää lihassairautta. Liikkuminen on huonoa ja vointi vaihtelee suuresti. Apuvälineinä on pyörätuoli, kyynärsauvat ja rollaattori. Asiakas asuu puolisonsa kanssa omakotitalossa. Asiakas on hyväntuulinen ja rempseä ja avustajalta toivotaan joustavuutta sekä oma-aloitteisuutta - hyvä huumorintaju ei ole pahitteeksi! Avustamisen tunteja on yhteensä n. 42 t/kk. Tunnit koostuvat päivittäisestä avusta, vapaa-ajan tunneista sekä allasavustamisen tunneista. Tunnit tulevat vielä tarkentumaan ja siihen vaikuttaa se, montako allaskäyntiä on kuukaudessa. Huom. avustajaa voidaan tarvita myös altaassa, joten valmius altaaseen menoon on oltava. Asiakkaan terapia-ajan voi käyttää myös omatoimiuimiseen, kunhan on saatavilla tarvittaessa. Työssä pääset allaskäyntien lisäksi mukaan asiointikäynneille, askartelemaan ja leipomaan sekä auttamaan pienesti kotitöissä.

Työpäivien pituus on 6-8 tuntia/pvä ja työpäiviä on 6–8 kuukaudessa. Lisätietoja saat palveluesihenkilö Anne Rajapolvelta (anne.rajapolvi@spesio.fi tai p. 0400183218) saadaksesi lisätietoja! Käytössämme on sähköiset järjestelmät mm. työajankirjaukseen, joten omaathan riittävät tietotekniset taidot.

Lupaamme sinulle:

\- mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen

\- työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi

\- lähiesihenkilön tuen

\- monipuolisen työnkuvan

\- työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan

\- palkkaluokka on G16A + 13 snt/tunti eli palvelusvuosien mukaan 13,33 € - 14,63 € / tunti (+TES:n mukaiset lisät)

Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa: Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. Työntekijöitä meillä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä reilut 700 ja toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Kuopiossa, Joensuussa ja Tampereella. Palvelutarjontaamme kuuluu henkilökohtainen apu, omaishoidon vapaa, vammaisten kotihoito, vammaisten päivätoiminta, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä kotiin vietävät palvelut yksityisasiakkaille. Me haluamme, että kaikilla on mahdollisuus omanlaiseensa elämään, ja uskomme että omalla työllä voimme tehdä maailmasta paremman paikan. Jos uskot samaan ja haluat tulla mukaan, laita meille hakemus.

Hae työtä osoitteessa: https://tyoviesti.fi/hakemusrekisteri/hakemus/hae-avustajaksi. Lisää hakemukseen viite Riihiranta.

jobs.title: Personnel de cuisine chez Club Med (France) H/F/X
jobs.description:
Vos tâches et responsabilités

En tant que commis de cuisine:

  • Vous vous assurez de la bonne présentation des plats et appliquer les ajustements si nécessaire
  • Vous vérifiez la mise en place, la mise en valeur et le réassortiment des buffets (600 à 1000 couverts par service)
  • Vous intégrez une brigade dynamique de 40 à 80 cuisiniers, favorisant l'esprit d'équipe
  • Vous proposez un service à l'assiette au buffet en personnalisant la relation client

En tant que chef de partie :

  • Vous encadrez une équipe de 4 à 6 cuisiniers
  • Vous gérez les commandes et les stocks de votre partie (chaud, froid, petit déjeuner)
  • Vous vérifiez la mise en place, la mise en valeur et le réassortiment des buffets (600 à 1000 couverts par service)
  • Vous proposez un service à l'assiette au buffet ou au restaurant bistronomique en personnalisant la relation client
  • Vous garantissez la qualité des prestations, le respect des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité Club Med ainsi que l'entretien du patrimoine
  • Vous fédérez et motivez vos équipes autour d'objectifs définis et les accompagnez dans leur développement

En tant que demi chef de partie :

  • Vous élaborez les plats de votre partie (chaud, froid, petit déjeuner)
  • Vous vérifiez la mise en place, la mise en valeur et le réassortiment des buffets (300 à 1000 couverts par service)
  • Vous proposez un service à l'assiette au buffet en personnalisant la relation client
  • Vous encadrez une équipe de 2 cuisiniers minimum
  • Vous garantissez la qualité des prestations, le respect des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité Club Med ainsi que l'entretien du patrimoine

La liste des tâches n'est pas exhaustive. Des tâches spécifiques aux métiers pâtissier, boucher, chef de cuisine etc sont attendues.

Vos conditions de travail

  • CDD saisonnier de plusieurs mois en France (renouvelable)
  • Début de contrat : possibilité de commencer à partir de mi-novembre (en fonction de vos disponibilités)
  • Vous êtes impérativement disponible jusqu'à fin avril 2027
  • Vous êtes logé et nourri sur place

Cliquez ici pour en savoir plus sur les conditions de travail chez Club Med.

#winterjob #clubmed

Vos qualifications

  • Vous avez une formation / un diplôme en cuisine
  • Vous avez minimum 2 ans d'expérience récente en cuisine dans un poste similaire (commis de cuisine, demi-chef de partie, chef de partie, assistant boucher, boucher, pâtissier, commis pâtissier...)

Vos compétences linguistiques

  • Vous parlez couramment le français
  • La pratique de l'anglais est appréciée

Vos compétences personnelles principales

Vous êtes :

  • Créatif, vous savez surprendre nos clients par votre technique et créer des explosions de saveurs
  • Rigoureux, vous maîtriser à la perfection les normes d'hygiène et de sécurité
  • Passionné, vous aimez transmettre et avant tout créer de l'émotion pour nos clients
  • Prêt à partir travailler dans un village Club Med en France pendant plusieurs mois
  • Poste logé et nourri sur place
  • Rejoindre le Club Med, c'est aussi une occasion unique de vivre et de travailler avec des personnes venues de tous horizons, dans des sites les plus instagrammables au monde
  • Vous vous créez une expérience en or sur votre CV, au sein d'une entreprise qui vous accompagne et qui vous forme en continu pour vous aider à devenir la meilleure version de vous-même

Alors? Etes-vous prêt pour une expérience qui change la vie?

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Metso
jobs.description:
Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.

Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/0caa4c4f-4e73-4f0c-aa33-154152533e2f/original.png]

Would you be our new Electrical Engineer?

We are looking for an Electrical Engineer to join the EIA Delivery team within Metso, working on large-scale international plant delivery projects. In this role, you will participate in the design and delivery of process electrification solutions for metallurgical plants, including MV and LV systems, transformers, drives, and cabling. You will also support conceptual design, cost estimation, and technical sales activities, while occasionally participating in installation supervision and commissioning at customer sites. Most of our projects are delivered internationally, and project durations vary depending on their scope and complexity.

You will work alongside experience engineers who will support you in project work. As your expertise grows, you will gradually take on greater responsibility and manage larger project entities independently.

This is a full-time, permanent position, and you will be employed by Biisoni. The role is based at our Espoo office, and we offer a flexible hybrid working model with the possibility to work remotely a few days per week. As our projects are global, occasional travel may also be part of the role.

What are we looking for?

To succeed in this position, you will need a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in a relevant field (e.g., Electrical Engineering or Electrical Power Engineering) and some experience in industrial process electrification projects. Familiarity with industrial electrification, power distribution systems, electrical drives, and international standards such as IEC and NEMA is considered an advantage. You may be a recent graduate or already have a few years of experience, but we hope you have gained exposure to heavy industrial environments, for example through internships or summer jobs. As you will be working in an international environment, fluent written and spoken English skills are required.

As a person, you are a detail-oriented and self-driven problem solver who takes ownership of your work. You work systematically and remain calm and solution-focused even in demanding situations. You have good interpersonal and communication skills, which help you work smoothly with different stakeholders. You are committed to continuous learning and eager to deepen your expertise.

Why us?

We value our dedicated and driven professionals. As an important part of our highly motivated and skilled team, you contribute directly to our shared success. We offer you an exciting opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders, supported by an open-minded, international, and friendly community of experts. Once you have a solid grasp of the job, you will have the flexibility to work partly remotely, along with excellent opportunities to develop your professional skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge company at the forefront of its industry. We're committed to your success and will provide you with a comprehensive onboarding and a supportive environment where you can truly thrive.

Are you interested?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application in either English or Finnish via the link by 2.11.2026. The interviewing process will begin during the application period. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide relocation assistance to Finland.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Elise Niinimäki, HR Coordinator, e-mail: elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi [elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi].

jobs.title: Agroforestry Manager til Grove Farm Management
jobs.description:
Hos Grove Farm Management bygger for fremtidens landbrug. Vi etablerer og driver produktionssystemer med træer og buske. Vi oplever stor vækst og leder efter en operationel, faglig og handlekraftig person der kan tage ansvar for plantning og drift i Midtjylland og Sønderjylland. 

Rollen 

Du bliver ansvarlig for at planlægge og etablere beplantninger med træer og buske på vores egne arealer og hos kunder. Derudover får du ansvaret for drift af vores eget skovlandbrug på 50 ha samt løbende drift-opgaver for vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere. 

Dine ansvarsområder 

  • Etablering: Lede planlægning og etablering af skovlandbrug på tværs af vores lokationer. 

  • Drift: Drift og pleje af arealer med træer. Renholdelse af beplantninger, beskæring, gødskning. Vi driver alle vores arealer økologisk. 

  • Høst: Høst af nødder, bær, frugt, gavntræ, biomasse. 

  • Planteskole: Bistå i driften af vores planteskole – fra indkøb af frømateriale og stiklinger til podning og klargøring af salgsklare træer.

  • Plantesundhed & Vedligehold: Sikre systematisk beskæring, ukrudtshåndtering og høstoptimering, så vores udbytte matcher vores kommercielle kontrakter. 

  • Udvikling og innovation: Arbejde tæt sammen med vores udviklings-team om udvikling og innovation indenfor skovlandbrug. Vi søger hele tiden at skubbe grænserne for kommercielle skovlandbrug og laver løbende markforsøg på vores kommercielle arealer og deltager i forskningsprojekter. 

  • Rundvisninger: Faciliteter rundvisninger og markvandringer for diverse grupper (landbrugsskoler, kommuner, virksomheder, ERFA, ). 

Om dig

  • Du har en stærk faglig baggrund (skov- og landskabsingeniør, agronom, produktionsgartner, jordbrugsteknolog eller lignende).

  • Du trives i et tværfagligt miljø hvor hoved og hænder skal arbejde sammen. Du kan planlægge en beplantning om morgenen og sidde på traktoren eller beskære træer om eftermiddagen. 

  • Du har maskinerfaring og er vant til at side bare rattet i større maskiner. 

  • Ideelt set bor du omkring Kolding, Vejle eller Skanderborg, da det er herfra vi har flest aktiviteter. 

Vi tilbyder

  • En absolut nøglerolle i en af Danmarks mest ambitiøse landbrugsvirksomheder. 

  • Muligheden for at bygge og forme morgendagens landbrugs-infrastruktur fra bunden.

  • Et dynamisk, uformelt miljø, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og stor mulighed for at vokse med virksomheden, når vi skalerer mod 500+ hektar skovlandbrug under drift. 

Ansøgning Send dit CV og en kort, mail om, hvorfor du er den rette til at drive vores marker. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

Your role and responsibilities

Why you and us?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps
