In some cases, the Individuals you support may have physical and cognitive difficulties and behaviours that challenge. Key Responsibilities Facilitate and promote a person-centred approach, appropriate to the needs and wishes of the Service User Work with Service Users, to enable them live in a community of their choosing, facilitating their ongoing involvement in their interests and hobbies ensuring access to local resources Work with Service Users in a way that promotes safeguarding, equality, dignity, diversity and their rights Supporting Service Users in directing their own lives, ensuring positive risk taking, in an environment that reflects the comforts of home Supporting Service Users to enjoy the good things in life, make sense of their environment, learn new skills and maximise their independence Assist with cooking, cleaning, shopping and general domestic tasks in the Service User’s home Understand and facilitate Service User’s needs, using their preferred communication system Establish, through continuity of work with Service Users, trusting professional relationships Ensure respect of the Service User’s will and preference to take on new tasks ensuring a positive risk assessment is carried out Provide assistance with aspects of personal care, people handling, ensuring dignity, safe practices for Service User’s Accompany Service Users to appointments and other events Act as advocate for Service users, who may have difficulty in expressing their needs Support Service User’s to have meaningful relationships, keep in contact with family and friends and to develop their social networks if they choose to. Assist with keyworking Adopt a positive behaviour support approach to respond effectively to any potentially challenging situations Adhere to all ASC Policies, Employee Handbook and work practices Adhere to all relevant national policies, including (but not limited to) HIQA Standards, HSE Policies, safeguarding Adhere to procedures to maintain the Service User’s home to the appropriate standards Adhere to Health & Safety standards and ensure that the health and safety of each Service user is central Maintain a high level of infection prevention and control within the Service User’s home Report any health and safety issues to the Health and Safety officer Ask questions to check when unsure of protocols, share information with the team that has a direct impact on Service users, be clear and factual in communications Attend Team Meeting Complete daily logs and show respect to other team members Reach out to more experienced RSWs and learn from them Work collaboratively and supportively with the multi-disciplinary team Undertake duties as may be assigned by the Manager or Team Leader to support the care of Service users.

jobs.title: Kunnossapidon esihenkilö Espooseen Blominmäen jätevedenpuhdistamolle
jobs.description:
Hei, ja tervetuloa HSY:lle töihin!

Teemme työtä, jolla on suuri merkitys. Huolehdimme siitä, että yli miljoonan pääkaupunkiseudun asukkaan elintärkeät peruspalvelut – vesi- ja jätehuolto – toimivat mahdollisimman kestävästi nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Tuotamme myös monipuolista ympäristötietoa, jonka avulla elinympäristöämme voidaan parantaa.

Liity joukkoomme ja hae meille!

Haemme Espooseen Blominmäen jätevedenpuhdistamolle

KUNNOSSAPIDON ESIHENKILÖÄ

ottamaan vastuulleen osaavan kunnossapitotiimin vetämisen nykyisen esihenkilön jäädessä eläkkeelle.

Me vesihuollon jätevedenpuhdistuksessa huolehdimme HSY:n alueen sekä sitä ympäröivien kuntien jätevesien tehokkaasta puhdistamisesta jätevedenpuhdistamoissa Viikinmäessä Helsingissä ja Blominmäessä Espoossa. Hallinnoimme alueen jätevedenpumppaamoita ja huolehdimme teollisuudesta peräisin olevien poikkeavien jätevesien puhdistamisesta.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Vastaat Blominmäen uuden ja modernin jätevedenpuhdistamon mekaanisen kunnossapidon päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja henkilöstön johtamisesta. Johdat kunnossapitotöiden suunnittelua, priorisointia ja toteutusta sekä varmistat osaltasi, että jätevedenpuhdistamomme prosessit toimivat turvallisesti, luotettavasti ja tehokkaasti.

Tehtävässä

- Johdat mekaanisen kunnossapidon ammattilaisten tiimiä
- Suunnittelet ja koordinoit huolto-, korjaus- ja muutostöitä
- Vastaat varaosa- ja palveluhankinnoista sekä kriittisten varaosien hallinnasta
- Hyödynnät kunnossapitojärjestelmää toiminnan ohjauksessa ja kehittämisessä
- Osallistut investointi-, kehitys- ja muutoshankkeisiin kunnossapidon asiantuntijana
- Kehität työturvallisuutta, toimintatapoja ja resurssien tehokasta käyttöä yhdessä eri sidosryhmien kanssa.

Tehtävässä korostuvat esihenkilötyö, suunnitelmallisuus sekä työturvallisuuden jatkuva kehittäminen. Lisäksi odotamme kykyä kehittää kunnossapidon toimintaa ja yhteisiä toimintatapoja yhteistyössä eri sidosryhmien kanssa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- tehtävään soveltuva tekninen koulutus
- kokemus kunnossapidon työnjohdosta tai vastaavista esihenkilötehtävistä
- vahva työturvallisuusosaaminen sekä ymmärrys turvallisuuden merkityksestä kunnossapidon johtamisessa
- kyky johtaa ihmisiä, resursseja ja päivittäistä toimintaa tavoitteellisesti
- oma-aloitteisuus, itseohjautuvuus ja kyky viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin
- ratkaisukeskeinen työote ja hyvät yhteistyötaidot
- valmius osallistua varallaoloon ja B-ajokortti.

Lisäksi tehtävässä on eduksi kokemus mekaanisesta kunnossapidosta teollisuusympäristössä, kunnossapidon järjestelmien tuntemus sekä alan pätevyydet ja sertifikaatit. Arvostamme myös kokemusta investointi- ja kehityshankkeista.

Tarjoamme

- Olemme vakaa ja vastuullinen työnantaja, joka pyrkii aina parempaan. Meillä viihdytään usein pitkään, sillä isona toimijana työtehtäviemme kirjo ja työnkuvien monipuolisuus on valtaisa.
- Työturvallisuus on meille tärkeää ja panostamme perehdytykseen. Käytössäsi ovat laadukkaat työkalut ja laitteet. Teemme myös jatkuvasti työtä työolojen riskien kartoittamiseksi, koska huolella tehty riskien arviointi on yksi työturvallisuuden perusta.
- Tueksesi asiantuntevat kollegat ja monialaisen työyhteisömme osaamisen. Tehtävässä pääset johtamaan kunnossapitoa ainutlaatuisessa toimintaympäristössä, jossa yhdistyvät huipputeknologia, ympäristövastuu ja yhteiskunnan toiminnan kannalta kriittinen infrastruktuuri.
- Huolehdimme ympäristön ohella myös työntekijöidemme hyvinvoinnista. Henkilöstöetuihimme kuuluvat muun muassa HSL:n työsuhdematkaetu, Epassin lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuri-, hieronta- ja hammashoitoetu sekä henkilöstön harrastuskerhotoiminta. Tutustu tarkemmin henkilöstöetuihimme ja työskentelyyn HSY:llä [verkkosivuillamme.](https://www.hsy.fi/hsy/hsy-tyonantajana/)
- Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja asiantuntijuuttasi sisäisissä ja ulkoisissa koulutuksissa. Kehitämme henkilöstön osaamista muun muassa mentoroinnin ja tehtäväkierron kautta.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 4 268,37 €/kk, jonka lisäksi on mahdollista saada aikaisemman työkokemuksen perusteella työehtosopimuksen mukainen ammattialalisä 4 % tai 8 %.

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Pakettiautohuolto -franchisingyrittäjä Tampereelle
jobs.description:
Pakettiautohuolto on erikoistunut pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluihin. Ketjun toiminnan perustana ovat laadukas palvelukokemus, asiantuntijuus ja tulevaisuuden rakentaminen. Ketju keskittyy erityisesti yritys- ja ammattiasiakkaisiin, yhtenä merkittävä kilpailuetuna mm. huollon sijaispakettiautot. Tällä hetkellä toimintaa on kolmella eri paikkakunnalla Suomessa, ketjun laajentuminen tulee tapahtumaan Suomen kaikkiin kasvukeskuksiin. Kasvunäkymät ovat vahvat ja konseptin mukaisella toiminnalla sekä ketjun vahvalla tuella on erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kannattavaan sekä laadukkaaseen yritystoimintaan. Ketju hyödyntää alan uusinta teknologiaa ja panostaa jatkuvaan kehitykseen, jotta palvelut pysyvät kilpailukykyisinä ja laadukkaina.

Franchising-yrittäjänä vastaat oman yksikkösi ja yhtiösi päivittäisestä toiminnasta. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat erityisesti asiakaspalvelu, huoltotöiden organisointi sekä henkilöstön johtaminen. Yrittäjänä olet myös vastuussa liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, paikallisesta markkinoinnista ja asiakassuhteiden rakentamisesta. Työ on monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä – päivät voivat sisältää sekä teknistä työtä että yrityksen hallinnollisia tehtäviä. Ketjun tuki ja selkeät toimintamallit auttavat sinua onnistumaan yrittäjänä.

Menestyvä Pakettiautohuollon yrittäjä on:

1. Yrittäjähenkinen ja toimialasta kiinnostunut
Kokemus autoalalta on hyödyksi, mutta tärkeintä on halu ja motivaatio oppia sekä kasvaa yrittäjänä
Riskinkantokyky ja vastuunotto yrityksen toiminnasta

2. Asiakaslähtöinen ja myyntihenkinen
Asiakaspalveluhenkinen, asiakaslähtöinen ajattelutapa ja myynnillinen ote

3. Tiimin ja tiimityöskentelyn johtaja
Yhteistyökykyinen ja luotettava tiimipelaaja
Rekrytoi ja kehittää henkilöstöä

4. Toiminnan kehittäjä ja laadun varmistaja
Järjestelmällinen ja pitkäjänteiseen kehittymiseen sitoutuva
Myönteinen ketjuasenne ja ketjun konseptin mukaiseen toimintaan sekä laatuvaatimuksiin sitoutuva

5. Taloudelliset edellytykset omaava
Vakaa ja hyvä taloudellinen tilanne, mahdollisuus rahoittaa alkuinvestointi joko vapaana omana pääomana tai ulkopuolisella rahoituksella. Yksikön alkuinvestointivaatimus on: 20.000-50.000€
Yrityksen talouden ymmärrys ja tarkka talouden hallinta

Miksi yrittäjäksi Pakettiautohuolto-ketjuun:

1. Valmis konsepti ja toimintamallit
2. Tunnettuutta ja luottavuutta omaava Pakettiautohuollon brändi
3. Kilpailukyiset hankintasopimukset ja pakettiautoihin erikoistuminen. Lopputuloksena suoraviivainen ja tehokas korjaamotoiminta, onnistunut asiakaspalvelukokemus ja kannattava yritystoiminta
4. Markkinoinnin ja myynnin tuki ketjulta, ketjun valmiit asiakasrekisterit ja valtakunnalliset asiakkuudet
5. Ketjun kattava perehdytys, tärkeät tukipalvelut, valmiit järjestelmät ja jatkuva koulutus
6. Yhteistyö muiden yrittäjien kanssa

Yhteisössämme jokainen yrittäjä saa olla osa suurempaa joukkoa, jossa apua ja kannustusta on aina saatavilla – yksin ei tarvitse pärjätä ja yrittää. Aloitus on helppoa, autamme liikepaikan löytämisessä ja sopimusneuvotteluissa. Koneiden ja työkalujen hankinnan osalta meillä on valmiit paketit olemassa.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, lue lisää ja jätä hakemus:
https://ketju.fi/fi/ketju/429/pakettiautohuolto
tai soita Ketju.fi rekrytointikonsultti Katja Makkonen, rekrytointi@ketju.fi, 020 730 7490

(HUOM! Etsimme yrittäjää, emme työntekijää.)

www.ketju.fi - sivusto on yrittäjyydestä kiinnostuneiden henkilöiden ja uusia yrittäjiä hakevien ketjujen kohtaamispaikka. Ketju.fi tarjoaa ketjuyrittäjyydestä kiinnostuneille ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden tutustua erilaisten ketjujen tarjoamiin yrittäjämahdollisuuksiin.

jobs.title: Montør med hænderne skruet rigtigt på søges til Sjælland
jobs.description:
Er du praktisk anlagt, har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og lyst til at lære noget nyt? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Vi søger en dygtig og ansvarsbevidst montør til en spændende virksomhed på Sjælland med opstart den 1. november 2026.

Du behøver ikke være uddannet glarmester eller tømrer. Det vigtigste er, at du har god praktisk sans, teknisk forståelse og trives med at arbejde med hænderne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer til at arbejde med forskellige montageopgaver hos både private kunder og på nybyggerier rundt omkring på Sjælland.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Opmåling og montering af bruseglas og andre glasløsninger

  • Montering af New Yorker-vægge, spejle og badeværelsestilbehør

  • Opmåling, tilskæring og montering af aluminiumsprofiler

  • Selvstændig udførelse af montageopgaver hos kunder

Du vil i den første periode køre sammen med en erfaren kollega, som sørger for grundig oplæring, så du bliver godt klædt på til opgaverne.


Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og god praktisk forståelse

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for detaljen

  • Er selvstændig, mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har lyst til at lære og udvikle dine færdigheder

  • Har almindeligt kørekort (kategori B)

  • Gerne bor centralt på Sjælland, da arbejdet foregår forskellige steder på øen

Erfaring med montage, håndværk eller lignende er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig hverdag med varierende arbejdsopgaver

  • Grundig oplæring af en erfaren kollega

  • En startløn på 200–210 kr. i timen afhængigt af kvalifikationer

  • Opstart den 1. november 2026

  • Et Try & Hire-forløb med henblik på fastansættelse hos virksomheden

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send dit CV til os hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Haemme prosessiteollisuuden osaajia
jobs.description:
Toimintamme laajentuessa erikoispaperitehtaallamme Tervakoskella, haemme kokeneita prosessiteollisuuden osaajia. Käynnistämme syksyllä 2027 uuden tuotantolinjan, jossa tullaan valmistamaan sähköeristemateriaaleja (mm. puristekuitulevyjä). Investointi on merkittävä askel Tervakoski Oy:n kasvulle, ja tarjoaa nyt ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa uutta tuotantolinjaa alusta lähtien.

Haemme ensimmäisessä hakuvaiheessa osaajia sekä uudelle tuotantolinjalle että sen myötä sisäisesti vapautuviin tuotannon tehtäviin nykyisille paperikoneille. Uudelle tuotantolinjalle sijoittuvat henkilöt osallistuvat tuotantolinjan käyttöönottoon, testaukseen ja prosessien kehittämiseen ennen varsinaisen tuotannon käynnistymistä, toimien mahdollisesti samalla myös tuotantomme muissa työtehtävissä.

Työ uudella tuotantolinjalla tulee käynnistysvaiheen jälkeen olemaan vuorotyötä. Erityisesti käynnistysvaiheessa työ voi sisältää myös muita työaikajärjestelyjä, jonka vuoksi arvostamme joustavuutta. Paperikoneille sijoittuvat henkilöt tulevat työskentelemään työaikamuodossa TAM37 12 h.



Odotamme sinulta:

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa prosessiteollisuuden ammatti-, erikoisammatti- tai AMK-tutkintoa
- Kokemusta paperi- tai kartonkituotannosta
- Ideanikkarimaista ongelmaratkaisijaluonnetta
- Kehitysmyönteisyyttä, joustavuutta sekä valmiutta toimia muuttuvassa ympäristössä
- Aitoa kiinnostusta uuden oppimiseen ja tuotannon kehittämiseen
- Sitoutunutta, motivoitunutta ja innovatiivista asennetta
- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja



Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Vakituisen työsuhteen kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä
- Monipuolisia työtehtäviä alan johtavassa yrityksessä

jobs.title: Tenure-track position in Archaeology
jobs.description:
About the position 

A tenure-track position (tenure-track in a postdoctoral position and tenured as associate professor) in Archaeology is available at The Department of Archaeology, Conservation and History (IAKH), University of Oslo. IAKH comprises the three disciplinary fields of archaeology conservation and history. The archaeology section has nine academic faculty positions, each with teaching and research components. The section’s research profile and teaching program are internationally oriented and span archaeologies of the Stone Age to the present. The announced position is focused on GIS, statistics and Mesolithic archaeology in Scandinavia.

The announced tenure-track position starts as a full-time postdoctoral position (SKO 1352) for a period of six years, including a 25 % component devoted to teaching and administrative duties. These duties include obtaining basic pedagogical qualifications. A formal midterm evaluation will be held in the fourth year of this period, and the candidate will receive feedback on performance relative to the requirements for the six-year tenure-track period. Toward the end of the six-year period, the candidate will be evaluated for a tenured position as associate professor (SKO 1011). During the final assessment, the candidate’s research performance will first be assessed by an expert (adjudication) committee within the candidate’s subject area. Subsequently, the candidate will be interviewed by an internal interview committee assessing the full range of criteria in the contract of employment.


More about the position 

Applicants apply with a research project including GIS, statistics and the Mesolithic in Scandinavia to be carried out in the initial six years period. In the application letter, candidates should also describe long term plans for building an international research group, for future development of the teaching in Stone Age Archaeology, for contributing to the public dissemination of research, and for developing their own academic career. 

The contract of employment will specify results, requirements, and criteria regarding academic production, public dissemination, research leadership and teaching that the candidate must fulfil during the six-years period to be favourably evaluated for a tenured position. According to the Regulations on appointments to tenure-track positions, with supplementary provisions for UiO, the contract of employment will also specify the criteria for the midterm and final assessment of competencies and milestones. Candidates will also be evaluated on personal suitability and ability to contribute to academic citizenship, both during the initial hiring process and during the mid-term and final evaluations. The contract of employment will further outline the Department’s obligations in supporting the candidate’s research as well as offering academic mentorship, guidance and training. 

Make sure to follow the description of required results necessary in order to be eligible for the tenured position as associate professor.


Requirements 
  • PhD or equivalent academic qualifications within archaeology of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, with a clear profile in GIS and statistical analysis, granted within the past five years (excluding documented parental and sickness leaves) 
  • Thorough knowledge of the material culture of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia 
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large datasets, geographical information systems and theoretical perspectives on archaeological methodology/practice 
  • Experience in handling of archaeological data using high-end digital tools for quantitative and/or qualitative analysis 
  • Experience with interdisciplinary research approaches within the environmental humanities and/or crossing over to natural sciences 
  • Documented pedagogical skills (either a teaching course certificate or based on teaching experience), see how to document your pedagogical skills 
  • Documented potential for project acquisition 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language 
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the position 

To be eligible, candidates must have submitted for final evaluation or defended their doctoral dissertation within five years preceding the application deadline. In the former case, the appointment will be contingent upon the successful defence of the thesis. Someone who has been employed for more than one year in an ordinary postdoctoral position at the University of Oslo cannot be employed in a postdoctoral position on tenure-track terms.


In the evaluation of the applications, emphasis will be placed on:
  • The research project’s scientific merit and contribution to GIS-based and statistical approaches to the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, including the applicant’s academic and personal ability to carry out the project 
  • The applicant’s long-term plans for building and leading an international research group and successfully join in academic collaboration within and across disciplines, including plans for obtaining external research funding 
  • Academic qualifications and academic production. Originality and quality of publications will be weighted more heavily than quantity 
  • Interest in and motivation for teaching, ability to inspire and provide guidance to students, and potential to teach university-level courses about Stone Age Archaeology and within Archaeology more generally 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration, including collaborative skillsExperience with and potential for popular dissemination and public outreach 
  • Academic citizenship, personal suitability and potential to contribute to a positive working environment and the long-term development of teaching and research at the Department 

In the evaluation of the qualified candidates the full range of these criteria will be explicitly addressed and assessed. Academic quality, development, potential and breadth will be prioritised in this order. 

The appointed candidate should demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages.


We can offer you 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 677 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


Application

Your application must include: 

  • Application letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (including list of education, previous and current positions, teaching experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities) 
  • List of publications 
  • Project description (3 - 5 pages, maximum 14,000 characters. See Template for project descriptions) 
  • A realistic progress plan for all six years, including activities beyond the postdoctoral research project itself, such as teaching, professional development and project development 
  • Two writing samples (e.g. two chapters from the PhD dissertation or two academic articles) 
  • Copies of educational certificates 

Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language), either in the original or in translation. 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system, jobbnorge.no. Applicants with education from non-Norwegian universities must attach an explanation of their grading systems.


Selection procedure

As the first step in the evaluation process, a Selection Committee will assess all applications and invite the most qualified applicants to submit a teaching portfolio and academic works (up to 7 publications) for expert assessment. Academic texts, except for the two writing samples, shall therefore not be enclosed with the initial application. Applicants who are invited to submit academic works are asked to select three works, published within the last 5 years, to be considered as most relevant for the position. In longer publications (monographs), applicants should specify the most relevant pages. Applicants are also asked to submit a teaching portfolio of 3-6 pages documenting educational certificates, competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own practice and learning vision is anchored in the principles of Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL). 

Finally, the most highly ranked candidates will be invited for at least one interview and trial lecture. Ranked candidates will be asked to provide a list of 3 reference persons (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). References are contacted after the interviews.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of archaeology, conservation and history (IAKH) is comprised of three disciplines which in different ways study the past.The department has internationally oriented archaeologists, the only conservation program in Norway and the biggest group of historians in Scandinavia. The department has close to 100 employees, including non-permanent research fellows. The study programs span archaeology from the Stone Age to the Middle Ages, object and paintings conservation, and history from Antiquity to the present age.

Et sabbatår i udlandet er for mange en livsforandrende oplevelse. Du får mulighed for at arbejde i et nyt land, møde mennesker fra hele verden, udvikle dig personligt og styrke dit CV med international erfaring. Men det, som de fleste ikke ved, er hvor tidligt processen faktisk bør starte.

Hvis du drømmer om at rejse ud i januar 2027, så er det allerede nu, du skal tage de første skridt. De bedste jobmuligheder, de mest stabile projekter og de mest attraktive destinationer bliver nemlig fyldt langt før afrejse. Samtidig tager det tid at finde det rette match, gennemføre interviews og få styr på alle praktiske detaljer.

Hvorfor starte processen nu – hvis du vil afsted i januar 2027?

1. Du får adgang til de bedste stillinger

Virksomhederne vi samarbejder med rekrutterer løbende, og mange stillinger bliver besat flere måneder før opstart. Starter du processen nu, øger du chancen for at få præcis den rolle og det land, du ønsker.

Når du starter i god tid, kan du planlægge dit sabbatår uden tidspres. Du får ro til at afslutte dit studie, nyde efteråret og samtidig være klar til at rejse ud i januar — uden at skulle haste gennem interviews og praktiske forberedelser.

3. Vi kan matche dig med den helt rigtige virksomhed

Vi arbejder ikke med “første og bedste” løsning. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker, dine styrker og dine mål for sabbatåret. Det kræver tid — og det er en klar fordel at starte før alle andre.

4. Du får fuld rådgivning hele vejen

Fra første samtale til du står på flyet, hjælper vi dig med:

  • Jobmuligheder

  • Kontrakt og løn

  • Bolig og økonomi

  • Kultur og hverdagsliv

  • Interviewforberedelse

  • Praktiske forhold som bank, skat og relocation

Jo tidligere du starter, desto mere ro og overblik får du.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Kort sagt får du:

  • Gratis og uforpligtende samtale

  • Hjælp til at finde det rette job i udlandet

  • Rådgivning om bolig, økonomi og kontrakt

  • Relocation‑support (fly, hotel, firmabolig m.m.)

  • Løbende kontakt med relevante virksomheder

  • Tryghed og støtte hele vejen til afrejse

Du kan booke en samtale med os allerede i dag, og så starter vi løbende interviews op med de virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker og din profil.

jobs.description:
Maalahti on elinvoimainen rannikkokunta Pohjanmaalla, lähellä Vaasaa. Meri ja saaristo, hyvät paikalliset palvelut ja aktiivinen yhdistystoiminta luovat viihtyisän ympäristön työlle ja arjelle.
Etsimme päällikköä, joka haluaa ottaa kokonaisvastuun kunnan vesihuollosta. Itsenäisessä tehtävässä yhdistyvät tekninen osaaminen, johtaminen ja kehittäminen.

Tehtäväsi
Vastaat toiminnasta, taloudesta ja henkilöstöstä painottaen luotettavaa palvelua, kestävää taloutta ja hyvää varautumista. Maalahden Vedellä työskentelee päällikkö mukaan lukien kuusi henkilöä. Liikevaihto on noin 1,5 miljoonaa euroa. Toimintaan kuuluu kolme vesilaitosta, kaksi jätevedenpuhdistamoa ja laaja johtoverkosto.
Johdat henkilöstöä ja päivittäistä toimintaa sekä vastaat talousarviosta ja talouden seurannasta.
Johdat laitosten ja johtoverkostojen investointeja, kunnossapitoa ja uudistamista sekä niihin liittyviä hankintoja ja sopimuksia.
Kehität omaisuudenhallintaa, varautumista ja toimintatapoja muun muassa digitalisaation avulla.
Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä kunnan johdon kanssa, toimit Maalahden Veden johtokunnan esittelijänä ja pidät yhteyttä asiakkaisiin, viranomaisiin ja ulkoisiin yhteistyökumppaneihin.

Osaamisesi
Työskentelet järjestelmällisesti ja itsenäisesti, tartut toimeen ja teet päätöksiä. Arvostamme rakennus-, LVI- ja/tai laitostekniikan osaamista sekä kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä. Ymmärrät taloutta, hankintoja ja sopimuksia, käytät digitaalisia työkaluja ja pystyt perehtymään teknisiin kysymyksiin ja säädöksiin. Halu oppia ja kyky rakentaa luottamuksellisia suhteita ovat tärkeitä.

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset
Soveltuva korkeakoulu- tai ammattikorkeakoulututkinto.
Hyvä ruotsin ja suomen kielen ymmärtämisen, puhumisen ja kirjoittamisen taito.
B-luokan ajokortti.
Kunnan hallintokieli on ruotsi.

Tarjoamme
Merkityksellisen päällikkötehtävän, jossa voit vaikuttaa toimintaan ja kehittää sitä tiiviissä yhteistyössä kunnan johdon kanssa sekä talous- ja hallintopalvelujen tuella.
Työpaikka on Maalahden kunnantalolla. Tarjoamme liukuvan työajan ja mahdollisuuden etätyöhön tehtävien salliessa. Sopimusehtojen mukainen vuosiloma voi olla 38 päivää vuodessa.

Hakeminen ja viran vastaanottaminen
Virka otetaan vastaan sopimuksen mukaan, mielellään viimeistään 15. tammikuuta 2027. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta. Valitun tulee ennen viran vastaanottamista esittää hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan.

Haluatko johtaa Maalahden Veden kehittämistä? Odotamme hakemustasi.

jobs.title: Postdoc in environmental medicine
jobs.description:
The translational pharmacology research group at Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM), Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a fully funded 18 months postdoctoral position. The position is to be filled from January 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.


About the Research Environment

The research areas of CPPEM span from pharmacoepidemiology to clinical studies, and cell-based basic pharmacology and environmental medicine. Collectively, CPPEM has a strong background in exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Specifically, the translational pharmacology group aims to understand variability in drug toxicity, drug metabolism and drug transport. Examples of this include cell-based models such as induced-pluripotent stem cells, primary human hepatocytes, and clinical studies. The pharmacoepidemiological research group utilizes the world-class Danish registries as well as international data sources to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. The environmental medicine group studies the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. In particular PFAS is a focus area, with studies of the adverse health effects of exposure, biomonitoring and advising national and international authorities. The analytical chemistry laboratory analyzes concentrations of drugs or environmental chemicals in various matrices. 

In the Environmental Medicine group we are looking for a post doc funded by Novo Nordic Foundation and ERC advanced grant. The projects focus on the Odense Child Cohort and study the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. Especially PFAS and their adverse effects on maternal and child health (e.g. the brain, immune, metabolic and reproductive system). In addition, we aim to identify toxicity of short PFAS including trifluoroacetic acid, widely used but considered less toxic due to their short half-life. 

We are seeking a candidate with a PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline. Work within environmental medicine is an advance, and epidemiological and statistical skills are essential. Motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to excel in environmental research are very important. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English is a requirement. The position includes independent scientific writing, clinical project leading, and supervision of students. You should be interested in contributing both to the scientific armamentarium in our department and to our collegial culture. It is also expected that the post doc contributes to additional fundraising for the projects as well as research collaborations and the continuation of the Odense Child Cohort, and takes on teaching responsibilities within the department. You will, in your daily work, refer to Professor Tina Kold Jensen, but also engage in a very active collaboration with the full research group.


Your qualifications

  • PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.

  • Experience within environmental medicine is considered an advantage

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ability to work independently with scientific writing and publication

  • Interest in and experience with supervision of students

  • Commitment to contributing to both scientific excellence and a positive collegial culture within the department

  • Interest in establishing and maintaining national and international research collaboration
     

Further information

Interviews can be performed online if needed. If you will need to relocate to Denmark for the position, both the University and the research group will provide ample support.

Additional information about the position can be obtained from Tina Kold Jensen (tkjensen@health.sdu.dk; 0045 29464350).


Salary and terms of employment

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).


Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now".

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivational letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (including documentation of Master’s and PhD degree) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • Up to 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a description of research experience

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 


Application deadline

November 4, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).


Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.


Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.
 

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark is a world-class university driven by an ambition to promote research results that develop society. The major challenges of the 21st century are complex and multifaceted; sustainable change and solutions require new – often interdisciplinary – research-based knowledge, and the University of Southern Denmark is an indispensable stakeholder in the transition process. 

Value, quality, talented people and outstanding environments are pivotal for the University of Southern Denmark’s strategic initiatives. 

Read more: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om_sdu

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark
Email: wuc@igt.sdu.dk

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

jobs.title: IT Business Partner, Norlandia Health & Care Group, Espoo
jobs.description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR AN IT BUSINESS PARTNER - FINLAND TO JOIN NORLANDIA HEALTH & CARE GROUP AT OUR ESPOO OFFICE

Norlandia Health & Care Group, NHC, provides high-quality early childhood education, elderly care, disability services, child welfare services, patient hotel services, and home care services across Finland. Our operations are built on high quality, responsibility, and a people-centered approach. We are now looking for an experienced IT professional to join our Finnish support organization to strengthen IT services for our businesses and support the continuous development of our operations.

ABOUT THE ROLE
As an IT Business Partner - Finland, you will be responsible for the overall IT function of Norlandia Finland and serve as a trusted IT partner to the business. The role acts as the primary IT partner for the Finnish business while working as an integrated member of the NHC IT organization. The role reports to the Finland Country Manager and NHC IT.

You will work closely with business functions, managers, service providers, and NHC IT team. You approach IT challenges in a practical, proactive, and service-oriented manner, finding effective solutions that support daily operations. Success in this role requires the ability to understand the bigger picture while also being willing to take hands-on responsibility when operational situations require it.

The role includes travel to our locations across Finland sometimes even on a short notice.

NHC has an external IT operation partner, Sopra Steria, who delivers first line support and operates the M365 tenant for all countries in NHC Group. In addition, NHC Group has a centralized internal IT department, NHC IT, which is located in Oslo and Stockholm. NHC IT delivers second and third line support, including network Services to all countries in NHC Group.

EXPECTED SKILLS
Experience in managing outsourced IT services and suppliers
Service Level Agreement (SLA) follow-up
IT Service Management
Vendor Management
Experience in coordinating site openings, acquisitions and IT integrations
Network competence (patching, IPv4, Meraki, Unifi, etc.)
M365, AD DS, Windows 11, Intune environment
Project management in IT projects (startups, system implementation, etc.)
Basic knowledge of office hardware
Ability to develop AI use in the organization is regarded as a benefit

IT uses ServiceNow as a ticketing system and CMDB, and it is an advantage if you are used to ServiceNow or other ticketing systems.

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU
Relevant education and several years of experience in managing, maintaining, and developing IT systems
Strong knowledge of Microsoft environments and related services
Experience in coordinating IT services, vendor relationships, and technical solutions
Ability to work independently, systematically, and in a solution-oriented manner, strong ability to actively seek for solutions for future challenges as well
Excellent collaboration, communication, and customer service skills
Willingness to travel between locations across Finland when required
Experience working in a multi-site organization or service business environment is considered an advantage
Excellent Finnish language skills as well as good written and spoken English

WHAT WE OFFER
A responsible and versatile key role in a growing nationwide organization
The opportunity to influence the development of NHC's IT environment and digital solutions
An independent role where you can make full use of your expertise
Support from a professional and caring work community
Flexible working arrangements and the possibility of partial remote work
Comprehensive Norlandia employee benefits

APPLICATION
Interested in the role?
Please submit your application by 31.10.2026. We will review applications and interview candidates throughout the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been identified.

For more information about the position, please contact:
Elisabeth Dragseth, Head of NHC Group IT, by phone at +4748503114 or by email at elisabeth.dragseth@nhceurope.com

Robert Larsson, Head of IT Operations - NHC Group IT, by phone at +46721580079 or my email at robert.larsson@nhceurope.com

jobs.title: Nordic Head Chef & QA Lead
jobs.description:
**Location: Helsinki Airport, Finland or Stockholm Arlanda Airport, Sweden**

**Shape the future of food safety, quality and culinary excellence across the Nordics**

Are you an experienced food safety and quality professional with strong culinary credibility? Do you thrive in a role where you can influence standards across multiple countries, locations and concepts?

We are looking for a **Nordic Head Chef & Quality Assurance Lead** to take ownership of food safety, quality assurance and culinary standards across Avolta's Nordic food & beverage operations. In this highly visible regional role, you will safeguard compliance, drive continuous improvement and help ensure that every guest experience meets the highest standards of quality and food safety.

**Your Mission**

As Nordic Head Chef & Quality Assurance Lead, you will lead food safety and culinary standards across the Nordics, ensuring full HACCP compliance, operational excellence, regulatory adherence and a consistently high-quality guest experience while protecting the company's reputation and supporting business performance.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**Lead Food Safety & Quality Assurance**

- Own and continuously develop the Nordic HACCP and Food Safety framework.

- Drive compliance with food safety legislation, policies and company standards across the Nordic countries (Sweden, Finland and from 2027 also Latvia).

- Lead food safety audits, inspections and corrective action processes.

- Own the governance of product specifications, allergen declarations and nutritional information.

- Investigate food safety incidents and drive preventive actions.

- Ensure all locations remain audit-ready and operate to the highest hygiene and food safety standards.


**Drive Culinary Excellence**

- Define and maintain culinary standards across the Nordic region.

- Own recipe development, recipe costing and product specifications.

- Ensure consistency in food quality, preparation methods and presentation.

- Support menu launches, new concepts and commercial initiatives.

- Monitor food quality performance and drive continuous improvement.


**Partner with the Business**

- Work closely with Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain and F&B teams.

- Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturers to ensure quality and specification compliance.

- Act as the key food safety expert for the business.

- Coach and develop Kitchen Managers and kitchen teams across the Nordics.

- Build a strong food safety culture and capability within the organisation.


**What We're Looking For**

- Professional culinary qualification or equivalent experience.

- At least five years' leadership experience in multi-site food service, hospitality, travel retail, catering, restaurant or retail food operations.

- Strong expertise in HACCP, food safety management systems and food legislation.

- Proven experience leading audits, inspections and compliance programmes.

- Experience developing standards, processes and training programmes.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

- Fluent English and either Swedish or Finnish.

- Ability and willingness to travel regularly within the Nordic region.


**It Would Be Great If You Also Have**

- Experience from an international or multi-country organisation.

- Food safety or quality management certifications.

- Experience leading food safety initiatives across multiple countries.

- Knowledge of Nordic food authorities and regulatory frameworks.


**Why Join Avolta?**

This is a unique opportunity to make a visible impact across one of the Nordic region's leading travel food & beverage businesses. You will have the freedom to shape food safety and quality standards, influence culinary development and work closely with colleagues across multiple countries and concepts.

You'll join a business that values collaboration, continuous improvement and a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences.

**Practical Information**

This is a full-time, permanent position based at either **Helsinki Airport** or **Stockholm Arlanda Airport**.

As the role operates within a security-classified airport environment, successful candidates must pass a security clearance and hold a valid work and residence permit in Finland or Sweden.

**Interested?**

We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing how your expertise can help us elevate food safety, quality assurance and culinary excellence across the Nordics.

Please submit your CV and eventual cover letter by 26 October 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the closing date.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just four years, we’ve grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 50,000 collars across multiple markets. We are now entering a new phase of international growth, and the next generation of products and capabilities will be critical to our success.

At the heart of our solution is a collar that combines animal interaction, sensors, positioning, and wireless communication. Operating in remote environments with only a small solar panel as its energy source, the collar must reliably deliver virtual fencing and continuous livestock monitoring under strict energy and connectivity constraints.

We're looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer who wants to build products that operate in the real world and have a direct impact on sustainable agriculture and animal welfare.


Key responsibilities

  • Design and develop embedded software for next-generation livestock monitoring devices

  • Lead firmware development from concept through deployment and field validation

  • Build reliable low-power systems using cellular, GNSS, wireless communication, sensors, and on-device machine learning

  • Work closely with hardware, cloud, and product teams to bring new features from concept to field deployment

  • Drive software quality, architecture, and technical best practices across the platform


We believe you have

  • 5+ years of experience in embedded software development

  • Strong C/C++ skills and experience developing firmware for resource-constrained systems

  • Experience with modern embedded software architectures, development practices, and CI/CD

  • Experience building connected embedded systems and working with communication protocols

  • Solid understanding of low-power system design and energy-constrained devices

  • Experience with one or more of the following:

    • Cellular technologies (LTE-M, NB-IoT, 4G/5G)

    • GNSS

    • Bluetooth Low Energy and other wireless technologies

    • Sensor integration, signal processing, edge ML

    • Device management and OTA updates


We believe you are

  • Passionate about building reliable products that operate in challenging real-world environments

  • Comfortable taking ownership and driving projects from idea to deployment

  • Pragmatic, curious, and motivated by solving complex engineering challenges

  • A strong collaborator who communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams


We offer

  • Meaningful impact on animal welfare and sustainable agriculture

  • Challenging engineering problems in low-power, connected systems

  • Opportunity to shape industry-leading products during a period of international growth

  • A collaborative environment with significant ownership and learning opportunities

  • Competitive compensation and benefits


Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area. Application deadline: August 16th 2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

Stillingen består hovedsakelig av digital forvaltning. Det vil si at du som utleieforvalter har ansvar for kommunikasjon med gjester før, under og etter oppholdet, samt koordinering av det praktiske rundt utleien. Siden arbeidet i all hovedsak er digitalt, kan de fleste arbeidsoppgaver gjennomføres uavhengig av sted, og de fleste henvendelser lar seg løse uten fysisk oppmøte.

Den resterende delen av stillingen innebærer fysisk oppmøte ved behov - eksempelvis bistand til gjester på stedet eller befaring av nye eiendommer som skal inn i porteføljen.

Arbeidsmengden varierer gjennom året, og stillingen egner seg godt som en fleksibel deltidsjobb.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss kan du forvente varierte arbeidsoppgaver - alt fra digitalt arbeid i form av kommunikasjon med gjester og koordinering av renhold mellom gjesteoppholdene, til fysisk arbeid som befaring av nye eiendommer.

Hos oss kan du også forvente en god mengde fleksibilitet. Mesteparten av arbeidet kan du gjennomføre digitalt, noe som gir deg muligheten til å jobbe fra der det passer deg best.

Du kan også forvente en rettferdig og konkurransedyktig lønn. Vi er opptatt av at alle som jobber hos oss skal trives, føle mestring og få en lønn som gjenspeiler innsatsen de legger ned.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

EnkelBnb er et forvaltningsselskap som bistår eiendomseiere med utleie av deres eiendom gjennom utleie på plattformer som Airbnb, Booking.com, Finn.no.

Vi ivaretar hele utleieprosessen på vegne av eiere som ikke selv har anledning til å håndtere utleien - herunder annonsering, gjestekommunikasjon, inn- og utsjekk, og løpende oppfølging.

Vi har drift i både Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim og Tromsø, og høsten 2026 etablerer vi oss i Trysil. I den forbindelse søker vi lokale utleieforvaltere som kan bistå med driften i Trysil.

jobs.title: Vi søker avdelingsleder til Innlandet
jobs.description:
Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og virksomhet i 13 land. Felles for oss alle er én viktig oppgave: å få folk trygt hjem hver dag. I Norge består vi av over 500 medarbeidere og leverer sikkerhetstjenester på vei og byggeplasser

Nå ser vi etter en engasjert avdelingsleder som vil ta ansvar ved avdelingen vår på Hamar. Stillingen er et vikariat med ønsket oppstart snarest og varighet til og med juni 2027, med mulighet for forlengelse.

Vi ser etter deg som trives med å være i front, tør å gå nye veier og motiveres av å finne nye muligheter og spille andre gode. Som avdelingsleder får du ansvar for å lede, videreutvikle og styrke salgs- og prosjektorganisasjonen, med et tydelig fokus på mennesker, kunder og gode resultater.

 

Rollen som avdelingsleder

Som avdelingsleder får du ansvar for faglig og administrativ ledelse, organisering og drift av avdelingen. Du vil være tett på både medarbeidere, kunder og den daglige driften, samtidig som du får en sentral rolle i å utvikle avdelingen videre og sikre gode leveranser og resultater.

Dine viktigste ansvarsområder vil blant annet være:

  • Sikre god drift, kvalitet og lønnsomhet i prosjekter og leveranser
  • Videreutvikle relasjoner med eksisterende kunder og skape nye muligheter i markedet
  • Følge opp økonomi, budsjett, ressursplanlegging og resultater
  • Lede og utvikle medarbeidere og arbeidsmiljøet i avdelingen
  • Bygge samarbeid på tvers av avdelinger og fagområder
  • Sørge for at sikkerhet alltid ligger til grunn for det vi gjør 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en trygg og tydelig leder som trives med å være tett på den daglige driften. Du har god forståelse for helheten, samtidig som du er opptatt av menneskene og det som skjer i avdelingen.

Du kommuniserer godt og bygger gode relasjoner, både internt og med kunder. Du bidrar til struktur og godt samarbeid i avdelingen, har et tydelig kundefokus og god forretningsforståelse.

Vi tror du vil lykkes i rollen dersom du har:

  • Relevant utdanning, gjerne innen tekniske fag eller ledelse
  • Ledererfaring – gjerne fra virksomhet innen bygg- og anleggsbransjen eller industri
  • Erfaring med prosjektledelse og drift
  • Erfaring med kundeoppfølging og relasjonsbygging
  • Førerkort klasse B (BE er ønskelig)
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig

 

Hva får du hos oss?

Hos oss får du en sentral lederrolle hvor du får være tett på både kolleger, kunder og drift. Du blir en del av et selskap med høye ambisjoner og dyktige kolleger som deler kunnskap og spiller hverandre gode.

Vi tilbyr: 

  • Muligheten til å utvikle en viktig avdeling i et selskap med sterke vekstambisjoner
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo og stor takhøyde
  • Muligheten til å bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad. Vi vil gjerne høre mer om hvem du er, erfaringen din og hvorfor du ønsker å bli en del av Ramudden. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

jobs.title: Product Manager, Energy Management
jobs.description:
Location: Stavanger, Norway

Reports to: Head of Product Portfolio Management

Language Requirements: English

The Opportunity

At Easee, we're building technology that makes electrification effortless. Our products are used across Europe, and our success depends on attracting people who share our ambition, curiosity, and commitment to great results.

As our Product Manager, Energy Management, you'll play a key role in giving Easee's energy-management hardware portfolio, including the Equalizer products, accessories, and add-ons, clear end-to-end ownership. This is a new position, created to turn energy management from something that mainly helps sell chargers into a portfolio that creates value in its own right.

Working closely with Engineering (embedded, apps, platform and cloud, hardware), Energy Services, Commercial, Product Marketing, Operations, and the leadership team, you'll own the strategy, business case, and roadmap, and see products through discovery, launch, and phase-out. It's a chance to dive deep into customer and installer needs, hardware economics, and Europe's evolving energy market.

What's in it for you

  • Take part in shaping Easee's energy-management offering, working alongside some of the experts behind one of the world's best-selling EV chargers

  • Real ownership of a portfolio from strategy and commercial case through to field performance

  • Collaboration with CEO and leadership team for strategy input and portfolio decisions

  • A chance to define how Easee connects EV charging with local generation, storage, and the wider energy ecosystem

Core Outcomes

Short-term

  • You've established a clear strategy, value proposition, roadmap, and performance baseline for the energy-management hardware portfolio

  • You've identified and begun closing the most important product, installation, reliability, and ecosystem gaps for priority residential (SDU) and apartment-block/commercial (MDU) use cases

  • You've created a coherent end-to-end proposition across hardware, firmware, software experience, installation, compatibility, support, and commercial positioning

  • You've shown measurable improvement in customer, installer, product, and commercial outcomes

  • You're delivering a recognisable Easee experience in energy management: simple to install, intuitive to use, reliable in operation, and smart in how it manages energy

Long-term

  • Easee's energy-management products stand as value-creating products in their own right, not only as charger-sales enablers

  • You've validated commercial models that capture part of the customer value created, where there is evidence of willingness to pay

  • The offering is more intelligent and automated, so customers can lower costs, make better use of local energy, or manage capacity with minimal effort

  • The portfolio is a scalable, interoperable part of the wider energy ecosystem, connecting EV charging with controllable loads, local generation, storage, energy services, and third-party platforms

  • Compatibility extends beyond Easee hardware where it creates meaningful customer value

What you need to bring along

  • Industry experience in hardware products, ideally with software and in the energy or EV space (energy-management experience is a plus)

  • Experience in market research and voice-of-customer work, turning customer and installer needs into clear requirements, business cases, and roadmaps

  • Ability to weigh trade-offs across customer value, cost, quality, and time, and to influence teams you don't directly manage

  • Experience managing suppliers

  • A relevant degree in engineering, technology, or business. Relevant hands-on experience can compensate for formal education.

Interview Process

  • (30m) Recruiter Screen

  • (30m) Hiring Manager Screen

  • (60m) Hands-On Challenge and Technical Deep Dive

  • (30m) CEO and Leadership Conversations

We request two professional references in our final round. We may conduct background checks if necessary.

Who we are

Easee is a Norwegian technology company with a clear purpose: Effortless Electrification for All. We develop smart charging and energy solutions designed to make access to electrification simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

Our culture is built around three values:
Dare: We challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.
Care: We support each other, our partners, and our customers.
Deliver: We take ownership and follow through on our commitments.

We believe great results come from ambitious people who care about each other, challenge the status quo, and take ownership.

What we offer

  • A key role in developing Easee's next-generation EV chargers

  • The chance to work alongside some of the experts behind one of the world's best-selling EV chargers

  • Collaboration with skilled colleagues across hardware, software, and product

  • A part in Easee's international expansion into new markets

  • A modern company culture that values innovation, people, and fun

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
