Assumer la responsabilité de la relation commerciale avec ses clients :

* Il/Elle est le point d'entrée commercial de référence de son client
* Il/Elle définit son plan d'action individuel et se fixe des objectifs validés par la direction commerciale
* Il/Elle effectue le suivi régulier de sa performance commerciale face aux objectifs définis
* Il/Elle joue aussi bien le rôle de pilote que de contributeur dans les relations qu'il/elle entretient avec le client dans la gestion de la relation globale du dossier

Accroître et suivre la rentabilité de son portefeuille et des capitaux investis :

* Il/Elle développe le PNB de son fonds de commerce
* Il/Elle s'appuie sur le reseau ainsi que des produits du groupe BNP Paribas Il/Elle négocie les conditions avec ses clients au mieux des intérêts de la banque et en partenarait avec le client client
* Il/Elle gère les capitaux investis par ses ses clients dans le cadre des objectifs définis

Conduire une politique active de développement de son fonds de commerce, en favorisant le cross-selling :

* Il/Elle identifie le potentiel de développement de chacun de ses clients et les orientations commerciales appropriées
* Il/Elle coordonne les intervenants commerciaux de BNP Paribas chez son client
* Il/Elle favorise et développe le cross-selling sur sa clientèle
* Il/Elle prospecte régulièrement afin de développer son fonds de commerce
* Il/Elle met en avant les avantages du Network international BNP Paribas dans son approche commerciale et contribue par ses propres actions en tant que pilote et en tant que contributeur au succès du réseau

Maîtriser le risque de son fonds de commerce :

* Il/Elle est responsable des autorisations données au quotidien pour son portefeuille Il/Elle est en charge des préparations des demandes de crédit ensemble avec l'équipe Credit Structuring
*
* Il/Elle se doit d'assurer d'un pricing adapté au risque de la contrepartie Il/Elle veille à ce que ses clients soient toujours traités par l'interlocuteur le mieux placé au sein de la banque.
* Il/Elle veille également à fournir aux clients un service à valeur ajoutée adaptée

Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité de service au client :

* Il/Elle assure la qualité d'interaction lors des contacts téléphoniques ou des visites
* Il/Elle travaille en liaison étroite avec le Mid-Office et les autres entités de support pour assurer une fluidité de communication entre le client et la banque
* Il/Elle assure un bon niveau de réactivité face aux demandes du client
* Il/Elle documente rigoureusement les échanges avec ses clients au sujet des services livrés par la Banque (rapports de visite, etc)
* Il/Elle assure un travail continu et permanent en interne pour son client

LES MISSIONS C'EST IMPORTANT, L'ÉQUIPE ET L'ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL AUSSI !

Votre environnement de travail

Complétez les rubriques suivantes :

* Localisation du poste
* Description de l'équipe que le collaborateur va rejoindre (composition de l'équipe, ambiance…)
* Interactions que le candidat aura en dehors de son équipe (avec d'autres Métiers/Fonctions, le Comex, le Groupe…)

* Déplacements à prévoir ?
* Plan de formation envisagé ?
* Poste éligible au temps partiel ?
* Manager ou personne de l'équipe à contacter en cas de question

Les apports de ce poste ?

Votre expérience sur le terrain sera complétée par un trajet de formation adapté à la fonction de RM.

ÊTES-VOUS NOTRE FUTUR(E) Relationship Manager ?

Expérience professionnelle et/ou diplôme

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme Master à orientation économique ou disposez d'une expérience équivalente

Une expérience au mois de 4 ans comme Relationship Manager dans le segment Corporate Banking

Compétences comportementales

Proactivité

Capacité à collaborer / travail d'équipe
Capacité d'organisation
Etre orienté client
Créativité & Innovation / Capacité à résoudre des problèmes
Etre orienté résultats
Rigueur

Compétences transversales

Capacité à inspirer les autres et générer l'engagement
Capacité à mener une négociation
Capacité à établir et activer des réseaux
Capacité d'analyse

Compétences techniques

Experience Senior Relationship Manager dans le segment Corporate Banking
Bonnes connaisssances au niveau de l'analyse financière ainsi que de la gamme des produits Corporate & Investment Banking

Connaissances linguistiques

Vous disposez d'une bonne connaissance du français, allemand et de l'anglais. La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est considéré comme un avantage.

Dans un monde qui change, la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sont des valeurs clés pour le bien-être et la performance des équipes. Chez BNP Paribas, nous souhaitons accueillir et fidéliser tous les talents sans distinction : c'est ainsi que nous construirons, ensemble, la finance de demain, innovante, responsable et durable.

Dans le cadre de la finalisation du processus de recrutement, il sera demandé au candidat présélectionné un extrait de casier judiciaire datant de moins de 3 mois (bulletin n°3 pour le Grand-Duché de Luxembourg), conformément aux dispositions de la loi du 23 juillet 2016 relative au casier judiciaire, compte tenu du domaine d'activité de notre établissement.

Votre profil:

- Vous disposez d’une expérience dans le domaine commercial, idéalement dans le secteur du transport ou de la logistique.

jobs.title: Industrielektrikere til Kjærgaard A/S – Løsning
jobs.description:
Efterspørgslen fra vores industrikunder betyder, at vi har travlt på alle fronter. Derfor søger vi dygtige og engagerede industrielektrikere til stillinger hos vores faste industrikunder og til skiftende projektopgaver. Lyder dette som noget for dig, så læs stillingsopslaget her – og søg stillingen nederst på siden.

 

Om jobbet

Vi kan garantere dig for en spændende og afvekslende hverdag, der bl.a. byder på industriopgaver, projekter og serviceopgaver inden for industriens mange brancher.

Vores projektafdeling sørger løbende for nye projekter, samt udbygning af eksisterende anlæg, som du kan blive en del af. Ligesom vi hverdag udvikler nye løsninger til vores kunder, er vi interesserede I at udvikle vores medarbejderes kompetencer efter ønske.

Hos Kjærgaard stiler vi efter vores K7-værdier for at skabe konkurrencefordele for vores kunder og sikre en kultur, hvor vi er fælles om at skabe en god arbejdsplads og et sundt Kjærgaard – nu og i fremtiden.

Dine kvalifikationer

Du er uddannet industrielektriker, automatiktekniker eller lignende og med erfaring inden for industri og automatik. Du kunne også være installationselektriker med erfaring fra industri eller ønsker at dygtiggøre dig indenfor industri.

Din energi og dit gode humør smitter af på de opgaver og mennesker, du omgiver dig med. Du arbejder selvstændigt med et godt overblik og tager et stort ejerskab for dine opgaver.

Du er desuden kvalitetsbevidst og ligger vægt på ordentlighed i udførelsen af dit arbejde, så dine kunder får en tilfredsstillende service. Dine gode samarbejdsevner gør dig til en vellidt kollega og en god ambassadør for Kjærgaard ude hos kunden.

Du skal kunne identificere dig i overensstemmelse med vores værdisæt K7.

Kjærgaard tilbyder dig 

Du tilbydes en spændende og ansvarsfuld stilling som Industrielektriker i en virksomhed i sund udvikling og vækst. For den rette person vil der være rig mulighed for såvel faglig som personlig udvikling. Kjærgaard er en moderne og uformel arbejdsplads, hvor du vil få engagerede kollegaer. Vores tværfaglige profil gør os til et spændende team af medarbejdere, med mange forskellige kompetencer.

Vi bor i nye lokaler og arbejder med de nyeste teknologier. Vores organisation er flad og kan beskrives som uformel og hvor måldrevne, hurtige og effektive beslutninger indgår i virksomhedens DNA.

For at skabe et godt sammenhold og nærværende miljø, arrangeres der mange sociale arrangementer og vi griller gerne når solen skinner. Til de faste traditioner, som fastelavn og firmafest, bliver familien også inviteret med.

Ansøgning og CV

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Niels Abildgaard på tlf. 4080 0192.
Upload din ansøgning og dit CV via nedenstående link.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Trädgårdsunderhåll Trädgårdmästare Trädgårdsarbetare
jobs.description:
Vår franska trädgårdsfirma, Jardin Riviera, utgår utanför Nice på Franska Rivieran och arbetar i ett område på cirka 30 km.

Vi söker mer personal med heltidstjänst på tillsvidareanställning då vi har mer än fullt upp med våra projekt i olika trädgårdar.

Under vinterhalvåret bygger vi mycket trädgårdar och under sommarhalvåret är det underhåll som gäller. Vi utför i stort sett alla arbetsuppgifter som uppkommer i en trädgård.

Ni kan läsa mer om företaget och hur vi jobbar på vår hemsida www.jardinriviera.com

Vi behöver en morgonpigg, positiv och glad person som gillar att ta del av teamets kunskaper och vår service.

Du är proaktiv, ansvarstagande, har god lyssningsförmåga, visar nyfikenhet och är bra på att interagera och planera ditt arbete.

Vi letar efter dig som sätter ett värde i att utföra arbetet på bästa möjliga vis och som inte är rädd för att hugga i när och där det behövs.

För att lyckas och trivas i tjänsten behöver du vara serviceinriktad och ta ansvar för att hålla hög kvalitet i det arbete du utför.

Vi tror också att du har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och att du har lätt för att samarbeta.

För oss är det viktigt att ha ett trevligt och glatt bemötande, både mot varandra såväl som kunderna samt att ha ett intresse för trädgårdar.

B-körkort är ett måste då vi använder bilar för att ta oss till våra kunder.

Du ska förutom svenska även kunna prata engelska då nästan all kommunikation sker på engelska, franska är självklart en bra merit.

Detta är heltidstjänst med tillsvidareanställning, inte ett sommarjobb.

Om detta kan vara av intresse, lägg en mail till oss på info@jardinriviera.com där du berättar om dig själv samt erfarenhet osv.

Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig! ☀️🌴

Jardin Riviera

jobs.title: Sjúkraþjálfari - Physiotherapist
jobs.description:
Physiotherapist – Akureyri Hospital

We are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.
Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.
The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.
The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced physiotherapists and newly qualified professionals to deepen their knowledge and become part of a strong and supportive team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities
•    General physiotherapy practice in a multidisciplinary environment
•    Providing education and guidance to patients and their families
•    Multidisciplinary collaboration within hospital departments
•    Duties and responsibilities will be tailored to the applicant’s experience
•    Participation in professional development

Qualifications and Requirements
•    A recognised qualification in physiotherapy and a valid Icelandic professional licence (we will assist applicants in applying for icelandic license)
•    In the recruitment process, emphasis will be placed on professional knowledge, experience and interest, independence in working methods, and strong communication and teamwork skills
•    Applicants must demonstrate integrity and professionalism, including a good reputation and conduct, both inside and outside the workplace, that is compatible with the requirements of the position
•    A clean criminal record

Further Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Association of Physiotherapists.
All applications must be submitted electronically through the Icelandic government’s recruitment system. Applications should include detailed information about education and employment history, as well as copies of diplomas/certificates and professional licences, where applicable.
Akureyri Hospital’s equality policy is taken into consideration when recruiting staff. Applications may remain valid for six months from the date of publication of the advertisement, in accordance with Article 2, paragraph 2, item 3 of Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertising of vacant positions, as subsequently amended. All applicants will receive a response.
Akureyri Hospital provides internationally DNV-GL-certified healthcare services through an ISO-certified quality management system, with an emphasis on the active participation of all employees in meeting the quality requirements set out in the international standard under which the hospital is certified.
According to Akureyri Hospital’s human resources policy, emphasis is placed on recruiting and retaining talented individuals. When selecting employees, education, experience, skills and competence are taken into consideration. The human resources policy serves as a guiding principle for managers and staff, supporting the hospital as a progressive and desirable workplace. It is based on the hospital’s core values:

SAFETY, COLLABORATION and PROGRESSIVENESS
Employment percentage: 75–100%
Application deadline: 30 September 2026

Further Information

Chief Physiotherapist

Við leitum að sjúkraþjálfara í okkar góða hóp á Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri (SAk). Um er að ræða 75-100% ótímabundna stöðu og er staðan laus nú þegar eða eftir nánara samkomulagi.

Sjúkraþjálfarar við Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri starfa á bráðadeildum sjúkrahússins við Eyrarlandsveg og/eða á endurhæfingadeild. Vegna flutninga endurhæfingardeildar af Kristnesi verður nú annars vegar starfrækt legudeild endurhæfingar í húsnæði SAk á Eyrarlandsholti og hins vegar dag- og göngudeild utan spítalans. Þar mun fara fram þverfagleg endurhæfing á einstaklingsgrunni og/eða í hópum. Staðsetning starfs getur farið eftir áhugasviði umsækjenda.

Um er að ræða dagvinnu, vinnuvika starfsfólks í fullu starfi er nú 36 klst. Við það bætast stöku sinnum vaktir um helgar og á lögbundnum frídögum við bráðadeildir sjúkrahússins, sem greitt er aukalega fyrir og gefur aukna tekjumöguleika.

Starfið er fjölbreytt og býður upp á frábær tækifæri til að afla sér faglegrar og sérhæfðrar þekkingar og taka þátt í uppbyggingu dag- og göngudeildar á nýjum stað. Við tökum vel á móti nýju fólki og veitum góða aðlögun undir handleiðslu reyndra sjúkraþjálfara. Kjörið tækifæri fyrir reynslubolta sem og nýútskrifaða til að dýpka þekkingu og verða hluti af öflugri liðsheild.

Helstu verkefni og ábyrgð
Almenn vinna sjúkraþjálfara í þverfaglegu umhverfi

Fræðsla til sjúklinga og aðstandenda

Þverfaglegt samstarf innan deilda

Verkefni og ábyrgð eru í samræmi við reynslu

Þátttaka í faglegri þróun

Hæfniskröfur
Fullgilt próf í sjúkraþjálfun og íslenskt starfsleyfi

Við ráðningu verður lögð áhersla á faglega þekkingu, reynslu og áhuga, sjálfstæði í vinnubrögðum og hæfileika í samskiptum og samvinnu

Gerð er krafa um vammleysi, s.s. að vera með gott orðspor og að framkoma og athafnir á vinnustað og utan hans samrýmist starfinu

Hreint sakavottorð

Frekari upplýsingar um starfið
Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi sem fjármála- og efnahagsráðherra og Félag sjúkraþjálfara hafa gert.

Allar umsóknir þurfa að fara rafrænt í gegnum ráðningarkerfi ríkisins. Umsóknum skulu fylgja ítarlegar upplýsingar um nám og starfsferilskrá ásamt afriti af prófskírteinum og starfsleyfi, ef við á. Tekið er mið af jafnréttisstefnu Sjúkrahússins á Akureyri við ráðningar í störf á sjúkrahúsinu. Umsóknir geta gilt í 6 mánuði frá birtingu auglýsingar, sbr. 3. tl. 2. mgr. 2. gr. reglna nr. 1000/2019 um auglýsingar lausra starfa með síðari breytingum. Öllum umsóknum verður svarað.

Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri veitir alþjóðlega DNV-GL vottaða heilbrigðisþjónustu með ISO vottuðu gæðastjórnunarkerfi þar sem áhersla er á virka þátttöku allra starfsmanna til að uppfylla þær gæðakröfur sem gerðar eru í alþjóðlegum staðli sem sjúkrahúsið er vottað eftir.

jobs.title: Join Landspítali as a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine in Iceland
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine to join Landspítali University Hospital, with a start date of 1 November 2026 or as otherwise agreed.
The position is full-time; however, a lower employment ratio may be considered by mutual agreement.

Our Department of Pulmonary Medicine consists of a strong and ambitious team of physicians managing a broad range of clinical responsibilities in close collaboration with other healthcare professionals. We are looking for a dedicated and motivated specialist who wishes to contribute to highly specialised care and follow-up of patients with respiratory diseases.

Why Join Landspítali?

At Landspítali, we offer:
•    A stimulating and rewarding consultant-level position at Iceland's national university hospital, with diverse and interesting clinical responsibilities.
•    A 36-hour work week that supports a healthy work-life balance.
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams and specialists across a range of clinical disciplines.
•    An academic environment where clinical practice, research, teaching, and innovation go hand in hand.
•    A supportive workplace that values staff wellbeing, professional development, and continuous learning.
•    Opportunities to learn Icelandic, including language courses offered partly during working hours during the first two years of employment.
•    The opportunity to live and work in Iceland and enjoy a high quality of life in a safe and well-functioning society.
•    Easy access to spectacular nature, clean air, and year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, skiing, geothermal bathing, and unique natural experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities
•    Care of patients on hospital wards and in the intensive care unit.
•    Outpatient clinics and day-ward services involving a broad range of pulmonary conditions, including but not limited to:
   o    Interstitial lung diseases
   o    Severe asthma
   o    Lung cancer diagnostics and follow up
   o    Advanced COPD and other late-stage obstructive lung diseases
   o    Acute and chronic respiratory failure
   o    Home mechanical ventilation and other ventilatory support therapies
•    Performance of interventional procedures, including:
   o    Bronchoscopy
   o    Pleural procedures/thoracentesis
   o    Exercise testing (cardiopulmonary excercise testing)
•    Participation in the pulmonary medicine on-call service.
•    Participation in acute internal medicine services, including on-call duties, as agreed with the Head of Pulmonary Medicine.
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students, intern/foundation doctors, and specialty trainees.
•    Participation in research activities.
•    Other duties as agreed with the Head of Department.

Qualifications
•    Specialist certification in Pulmonology/Respiratory Medicine.
•    Icelandic medical licence and specialist recognition in Pulmonology, or eligibility to obtain these credentials.
•    Broad knowledge and experience in Internal Medicine and Pulmonology.
•    Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Positive attitude, flexibility, and strong collaborative skills.
•    Experience in teaching and research is considered an advantage.

Additional Information
A full-time position is exclusively affiliated with the hospital in accordance with Article 3.3 of the current collective agreement between physicians and the Icelandic State.

The position is available from 1 November 2026 or by mutual agreement. The application deadline is 23 October 2026.

For further information, please contact:
Sif Hansdóttir, Consultant Physician
E-mail: sifhan@landspitali.is

Application Requirements
Applications should include information on:
•    Previous employment, education, and professional qualifications
•    Positions of trust and references

Mandatory Attachments
•    Certified copies of degree certificates and specialist qualifications/licences
•    Curriculum Vitae (CV), including teaching, research, and leadership experience
•    List of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals. Applicants should either provide a link to their Google Scholar profile or submit publication documentation from PubMed.
•    Cover letter describing the applicant's qualifications and interest in the position

All attachments must be submitted in PDF format.

Selected candidates will be invited for interviews. Appointment decisions will be based on interviews and submitted documentation. Recruitment is conducted in accordance with Landspítali's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be informed of the outcome of the recruitment process.

Information regarding residence and work permits is available on our website.
To apply for the position, click the dark blue button "Sækja um starf" (Apply for Position). You may then switch the website language to English and log in to the Icelandic Government's recruitment system.

About Landspítali
Landspítali is a dynamic and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 employees work in multidisciplinary teams and in close collaboration across professional groups. The hospital's vision is to provide healthcare of the highest quality, based on science, professionalism, and compassion, delivered by skilled staff and supported by modern facilities and a positive working environment.
Landspítali is certified according to the Icelandic Equal Pay Standard ÍST 85:2012. The certification has been awarded following an audit conducted by Versa Vottun ehf.

Applications may remain valid for up to six months from the publication date of the advertisement, in accordance with Icelandic Government Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertisement of vacant public positions, as amended.

jobs.title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen

The University seeks to appoint a tenure track assistant professor to commence 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Information on the department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/.

Subject area: Infectious disease epidemiology, modelling, animal health, One Health, and sustainable health systems

The Tenure-Track Assistant Professor will lead research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, with particular emphasis on how changes in environmental conditions, animal populations, production systems, and management practices influence disease emergence, transmission, and control. The position will combine infectious disease epidemiology, mathematical and statistical modelling, data science, and economic analysis to generate evidence supporting disease preparedness, prevention, and control.

The successful candidate will:

  • Lead independent research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, including the influence of environmental and production system changes.
  • Develop and apply simulation, epidemiological, and statistical models to assess disease and spillover risks, evaluate mitigation and control strategies, and quantify their economic implications.
  • Demonstrate strong programming skills in R and other relevant programming languages, including experience in managing, processing, and analysing large and complex datasets.
  • Have experience in developing and applying epidemiological disease-spread models, including model calibration, validation, parameter estimation, and calculation of epidemiological indicators such as the basic reproduction number (R₀) across different animal species and production systems.
  • Design and implement epidemiological modelling frameworks.
  • Validate and calibrate models using large-scale national datasets, ensuring scientific robustness, methodological validity, and relevance for policy and decision-making.
  • Translate research findings into evidence supporting risk-based disease prevention, preparedness, and control.
  • Establish and maintain collaborations with key stakeholders, including the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration, industry partners such as SEGES and Landbrug & Fødevarer (L&F), and international organisations such as the FAO.
  • Lead and secure independent research funding through competitive national and international funding calls. The position requires demonstrated experience in securing external funding, as well as the ambition to develop research ideas into externally funded projects and provide scientific leadership for such projects within the TIPTON Research Group.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of One Health and sustainability teaching, with a particular focus on infectious diseases, disease preparedness, and the interactions between animal, human, and environmental health.
  • Contribute to teaching in data science, including data management, dataset preparation and handling, statistical analysis, programming, and the analysis of large-scale and complex datasets.
  • Supervise students and contribute to research capacity building within infectious disease epidemiology, disease modelling, data science, and One Health.
  • Contribute to the delivery of government services undertaken by the Department, including research-based advice, preparedness activities, risk assessments, and other activities relevant to infectious disease modelling and control.
The position is expected to combine methodological excellence in infectious disease modelling and data science with applied epidemiological research, generating evidence that is directly relevant to disease preparedness, private and public bodies, sustainable production systems, animal health and resilient health systems.

The tenure track assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
The tenure track assistant professor’s performance will be evaluated through annual evaluations. Furthermore, the tenure track assistant professor will be evaluated in a mid-track appraisal.

After no more than six years of employment and on condition of a positive final appraisal, the tenure track assistant professor will be employed as associate professor. Find more information about tenure track at the University of Copenhagen.

Required qualifications
To be qualified for an assistant professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

Furthermore, each applicant must be able to document:

  • a PhD degree or similar qualifications within the subject area
  • research experience within the field of the position
The tenure track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

The assistant professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

Salary and employment conditions
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is permanent.

Employment is as Tenure Track Assistant Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations.

There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector at www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information, please contact Research Group Leader: Professor Beate Conrady, bcon@sund.ku.dk

Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

Application
The application must be submitted in English, and must include the following documents:

  • Application (Including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages))
  • Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding)
  • Diplomas (Master’s, PhD and other relevant diplomas)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Research plan (2-4 pages)
  • Teaching plan
  • Uploads of maximum 5 publications to be considered in the assessment
  • Teaching portfolio, if applicable (Guidelines)
Please note: It is mandatory to upload a teaching plan in the online application form. Should you not be able to produce a teaching plan, please upload a blank document in this box instead.

Application procedure
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

The application will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested in this post to apply.

Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, 18 November 2026.

Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 7 April 2027.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking to hire a new Talent Sourcer in Tokyo to build top-of-funnel talent pipelines and shape talent strategy across our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you'll partner with regional leadership to fill critical GTM roles like Solutions Consultants https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/15dde0f5-b3fd-4d46-8ec2-0858ebdd888d and Outcomes Architects https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/7030916f-4277-45db-9fed-644bb3fba059 primarily in Japan.

 - You'll conduct initial qualification screenings and casual chats with candidates to assess fit and build relationships

 - You'll collaborate with the broader team on process improvements, programs, and strategic initiatives

 - You'll lead talent branding initiatives, including organizing hiring webinars and publishing blogs and articles that feature our employees

 - You'll provide talent mapping and market insights to support local and global recruiting and hiring teams

 - You'll make informed data-driven decisions that build efficiencies into the sourcing process

 - You'll find creative and unconventional ways to help us build a diverse top-of-funnel for GTM roles across all levels

 - You'll help build and manage partnerships to bring more underrepresented talent to Notion

 - You'll advance our Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) strategy, working to build more diverse and inclusive teams

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Chef - Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 


WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a reliable and hardworking terminal worker for Bring in Greve for the evening team.

The job mainly involves loading and unloading trucks, as well as operating an electric pallet truck. It is therefore important that you are used to physical work and preferably have experience operating an electric pallet truck.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience operating an electric pallet truck and can work at a fast pace

  • Is reliable and available Monday to Friday from 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM

  • Enjoys physical work and can maintain a good pace, even when it gets very busy

  • Has a good attitude and is not afraid to get stuck in

It is important that you are available all five days, as we need someone who can provide a stable presence throughout the week.

You will be employed under a collective agreement, and your total hourly wage will be DKK 190 per hour + evening shift allowance.The position will initially be a temporary position, but if you enjoy the job and prove to be the right person for the role, there is an opportunity for a permanent contract after approximately 3-4 months.

jobs.description:
Head of Vendor Management & Outsourcing (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1172

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

The Head of Vendor Management and Outsourcing is responsible for defining and executing the Bank's vendor strategy framework and leading end-to-end commercial, contractual, and regulatory vendor management activities. The role acts as the Finance-led control tower across the vendor lifecycle, ensuring financial discipline, contractual control, and regulatory compliance while optimizing vendor value and supporting outsourcing decisions.

Your next challenge:

• Define and maintain vendor segmentation (strategic / critical / commodity) and steer the vendor portfolio.
• Act as the Outsourcing Activity Manager and represent the Bank towards the Regulator on outsourcing.
• Support outsourcing and make-or-buy decisions and monitor vendor concentration and exposure.
• Own budgeting, forecasting, cost control, benchmarking and value realization for vendor spend.
• Establish and maintain comprehensive reportings, leveraging data analytics to drive decision-making, monitor performance, and provide actionable insights.
• Lead contract negotiation, lifecycle management, renewal and commercial governance.
• Act as primary commercial face to vendor and manage relationships with strategic vendors and group entities.
• Ensure compliance with DORA, EBA and CSSF requirements and maintain outsourcing register.
• Establish end-to-end vendor lifecycle governance and coordinate with CIO, Procurement, Legal and Risk.
• Lead change management initiatives related to vendor and outsourcing processes, and educate internal stakeholders on best practices, regulatory requirements, and risk awareness.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning, provide mentoring and coaching to team members, and promote knowledge sharing and best practices within the team.
• Maintain strong first line operational risk controls by overseeing vendor, facility and infrastructure processes, ensuring compliance with internal policies and escalating operational or safety risks.

Your skills:

• Master's degree in Business, Finance or Engineering.
• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in vendor management, procurement or outsourcing in regulated environment.
• Knowledge of DORA, EBA Outsourcing Guidelines and CSSF frameworks.
• Strong negotiation and financial management capabilities.
• Strong understanding of IT vendor management, including vendor selection, contract management, performance monitoring, and relationship management.
• Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to build, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, with a data-driven approach to strategy development.
• Demonstrated track record of leading strategic initiatives, business transformation programs, and organizational change at a senior level.
• Languages: English and French are required. Proficiency in any additional language would be considered as an asset.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN ATOMISTIC MODELLING OF FERROELECTRIC DYNAMICS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with atomistic modelling (DFT, second-principles, machine-learned force fields), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of ferroelectricity and/or molecular dynamics is a strong asset.

Within LIST's Sustainable Urban and Built Environment (SUBE) group, this position focuses on geospatial technologies for sustainable, climate-neutral and resilient built and natural environments. You will design and develop reusable geospatial software and analytics for a digital twin platform supporting European research and innovation projects. You will combine spatial data engineering, analytics, 2D/3D visualisation and GeoAI to turn heterogeneous data and models into interoperable services and decision-support applications for cities, regions and environmental systems.
Working with researchers, software engineers and domain experts across LIST and European partners, you will explore pragmatic AI-assisted and agentic workflows for discovering, combining and interpreting trusted geospatial data, models and services, with appropriate human oversight, validation, provenance and explainability. You will translate research concepts into robust prototypes and reusable solutions demonstrated with European cities and regions.

PHD IN ADVANCING SAFE AND SUSTAINABLE BY DESIGN (SSBD) ASSESSMENT OF NOVEL BIO-BASED POLYMERS: INTEGRATION OF NEW APPROACH METHODOLOGIES AND COMPUTATIONAL MODELLING FOR SAFETY ASSESSMENT (m/f)

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 Months (14 +22+12 )
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. The Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb, is one of the leading research and higher education institutions in Croatia, offering advanced training and research infrastructure in chemistry, biochemistry, nanotechnology, biosensors, environmental health, and biomedical sciences. The host group has expertise in Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) approaches, nanomaterials, advanced analytical methods, and translational biomedical research.

How will you contribute?
As a PhD Student within the AIM-PACE project, your main responsibilities will include:
• Supporting the scoping analysis of the AIM-PACE scenarios and products, as part of the SSbD framework implementation.
• Conducting a comprehensive literature review and data collection on hazard profiles of existing substances/materials and use of computational modelling for data gap filling.
• Identifying, reviewing and using models and tools for hazard screening, exposure assessment and risk assessment in the context of SSbD.
• Application of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including in vitro and computational tools, for hazard, exposure and risk assessment of AIM-PACE materials.
• Collaborating with project partners in integrating safety output with sustainability, techno-economic and social indicators.
• Collaborating with the team of Dr. Ivana Vinkovic Vrček to explore research activities, scientific training, conferences, and dissemination activities, and complete all doctoral requirements according to University of Zagreb regulations.
• Contributing to the dissemination of results through peer-reviewed scientific publications, conference presentations, and technical reports.
• Actively participating in AIM-PACE consortium activities, including meetings, workshops, and stakeholder engagement.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education
• Master's degree (or equivalent) in environmental science/engineering, toxicology, pharmacy, or a closely related field.

Experience and skills
• Familiarity with in vitro toxicology methods and/or New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) is an asset.
• Interest in or experience with computational approaches and modelling is a considered an asset.
• Experience in risk assessment and knowledge of the regulatory landscape is an asset.
• Basic understanding of Sustainability Assessment and Life Cycle Impact Assessment methodologies is valued.
• Ability to work in a multidisciplinary and international research environment.
• Proactive, curious, and motivated to develop scientific independence.

Soft skills
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks across projects.
• Team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously under the guidance of a supervisory team.

Language skills

jobs.description:
POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN AI-BASED ENERGY MANAGEMENT OF RESILIENT MICROGRIDS WITH SECOND-LIFE BATTERY (m/f)

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 20 Months
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will contribute to the ENERGY-RESILIENT-UA project, which aims to support vulnerable communities in Ukraine through resilient, low-carbon energy systems based on second-life electric vehicle batteries, solar PV, and advanced AI-based control. The project addresses the urgent need for reliable backup power for critical services such as schools, clinics and water facilities, while reducing dependence on diesel generators and promoting circular economy solutions.

The work will mainly focus on modelling, algorithm development, simulation, validation and remote technical support from Luxembourg. The successful candidate will not be required to travel to Ukraine.
You will be mainly in charge of:

• Developing and implementing AI-based and safety-aware control algorithms for microgrids integrating second-life EV batteries, solar PV and critical loads.
• Designing grid-forming and resilient control strategies to ensure stable operation under severe grid disturbances, outages and high uncertainty.
• Optimizing battery system operation, including state-of-charge management, reliability, lifetime-aware operation and backup power availability.
• Building simulation models of microgrids, second-life battery systems, solar PV generation and critical community loads.
• Validating the proposed control strategies using real-time simulation and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
• Providing remote technical support for the preparation, analysis and monitoring of a pilot microgrid demonstration in Ukraine, in collaboration with project partners.
• Analyzing technical performance, cost savings and emissions reduction compared with diesel-based backup solutions.
• Contributing to project deliverables, technical reports, scientific publications and dissemination activities.
• Collaborating closely with academic, industrial and humanitarian partners through remote meetings and digital collaboration tools.

- Power systems and microgrids

- Control systems
- Artificial intelligence or machine learning for energy applications

• Good analytical, problem-solving and scientific writing skills.
• Ability to work both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary project team.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with international partners in a remote working environment.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator - AMER
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:



CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.



COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.



BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $95,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. jobs.title: Berater für das Regionskontor & Infocenter (w/m/d) in Süddänemark (Bürokaufmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
Berater für das Regionskontor & Infocenter (w/m/d)

Haben Sie Interesse am grenzüberschreitenden Arbeitsmarkt und am EU-Recht? Fühlen Sie sich wohl in der Beratung, Informationsvermittlung und bei vielfältigen Aufgaben?

Dann sind Sie vielleicht genau die Person, die wir als Beraterin bzw. Berater für das Regionskontor & Infocenter in Padborg suchen.

Über den Arbeitsplatz

Die Region Sønderjylland-Schleswig mit ihren Partnern Region Syddanmark, den dänischen Kommunen Haderslev, Aabenraa, Sønderborg, Tønder und den deutschen Kreisen Nordfriesland und Schleswig-Flensburg sowie der Stadt Flensburg sucht einen Berater für das Regionskontor & Infocenter in Padborg.

Über den Job

Der Berater arbeitet mit den weiteren 4 Mitarbeitern des Infocenters eng zusammen und hilft Grenzpendlern, Übersiedlern sowie Arbeitgebern bei Fragen zum grenzüberschreitenden Arbeitsmarkt. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt in der Vermittlung von Informationen aus dem Bereich Europarecht, Aufbau und Funktion der EU sowie der Organisation von Austauschformaten.

Ihre Aufgaben

•  Persönliche, telefonische und schriftliche Beratung

•  Erstellen von Informationsmaterialien

•  Pflege von Netzwerkkontakten

•  Allgemeine Verwaltungsaufgaben

•  Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Informationsveranstaltungen

•  Kommunikation auf sozialen Medien

Über Sie

Wir erwarten, dass Sie fachlich

•  über eine abgeschlossene, einschlägige Ausbildung verfügen

•  Dänisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie Deutsch auf hohem Niveau beherrschen und mit den jeweiligen kulturellen Umgangsformen vertraut sind

•  Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Steuer und Sozialversicherungsrecht, idealerweise auf dem grenzüberschreitenden Arbeitsmarkt, mitbringen

•  Erfahrung in Verwaltung und öffentlicher Administration haben

•  den Umgang mit Gesetzestexten und Verordnungen gewohnt sind

•  kunden- und serviceorientiert handeln

•  Fahrerlaubnis B besitzen

Wir erwarten, dass Sie persönlich:

•  strukturiert und analytisch arbeiten

•  gerne im Team arbeiten und den Dialog suchen

•  Freude an vielfältigen Aufgaben haben

•  in einer politisch geleiteten Organisation arbeiten können

•  einen hohen Servicegedanken mitbringen

•  es gewohnt sind, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu koordinieren und den Überblick zu behalten.

Die Tätigkeit beinhaltet auch Dienst zu ungünstigen Zeiten und erfordert Reisebereitschaft.

Vergütung und Einstellungsmodalitäten:

Vergütung und Einstellungsmodalitäten gemäß dem dänischen Tarif für den öffentlichen Dienst.

Die Arbeitszeit beträgt 37 Wochenstunden. Die Stelle ist zum 01.12.2026 oder früher zu besetzen.

Die Stelle steht unter dem Vorbehalt des Vorhandenseins der erforderlichen Haushaltsmittel. Der Anstellungsträger ist die Kommune Aabenraa.

Die Bewerbungsgespräche finden am 3. und 5.11.2026 im Regionskontor & Infocenter, Lyren 1, DK-6330 Padborg statt.

Weitere Infos:

Bei Rückfragen wenden Sie sich bitte an:

Region Sønderjylland-Schleswig

Regionskontor & Infocenter

Peter Hansen

Tel.: +45 74 67 05 01

E-Mail: region@region.dk

Wir bitten Sie, Ihre Bewerbung in das Bewerbungsmanagementsystem der Aabenraa Kommune (https://portal.signatur.dk/ExtJobs/DefaultHosting/JobDetails.aspx?ClientId=2328&WebAdId=165593) einzugeben

Vejleder til Regionskontor & Infocenter - Ledig stilling

Die Bewerbungsfrist läuft bis zum 26.10.2026.

-----------------------------------------------------

Vejleder til Regionskontor & Infocenter

Har du interesse for det grænseoverskridende arbejdsmarked og EU-retten? Trives du med vejledning, informationsformidling og mange forskellige opgaver?

Så er det måske dig, vi har brug for som vejleder i Regionskontor & Infocenter i Padborg.

Om arbejdspladsen

Region Sønderjylland-Schleswig med partnerne på dansk side Region Syddanmark, Haderslev Kommune, Aabenraa Kommune, Sønderborg Kommune, Tønder Kommune og på tysk side Kreis Nordfriesland, Kreis Schleswig-Flensburg og Stadt Flensburg søger en vejleder til Regionskontor & Infocenter i Padborg.

Om jobbet

Vejlederen vil arbejde tæt sammen med Infocentrets øvrige fire medarbejdere og være grænsependlere, tilflyttere og arbejdsgivere behjælpelig omkring spørgsmål vedrørende det grænseoverskridende arbejdsmarked. Der lægges særlig vægt på formidling af viden om EUretten, EU’s opbygning og funktion samt på organiseringen af forskellige udvekslings- og dialogformater.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

•  Personlig, telefonisk og skriftlig vejledning

•  Udarbejdelse af informationsmateriale

•  Pleje af netværkskontakter

•  Generelle administrative opgaver

•  Forberedelse og gennemførelse af informationsarrangementer

•  Kommunikation på sociale medier

Om dig

Vi forventer, at du fagligt:

•  Har en relevant afsluttet uddannelse

•  behersker dansk på modersmålsniveau og tysk på højt niveau samt de respektive kulturelle omgangsformer

•  har erfaring inden for skat og socialsikringslovgivning, gerne på det grænseoverskridende arbejdsmarked

•  har erfaring med administration og forvaltning

•  er vant til at arbejde med lovtekster og forordninger

•  er kunde- og serviceorienteret

•  har kørekort

Vi forventer, at du personligt:

•  arbejder struktureret og analytisk

•  trives med teamarbejde og er dialogsøgende

•  kan lide at have mange forskellige opgaver

•  kan arbejde i en politisk ledet organisation

•  gerne vil yde en god service

•  er vant til at have mange bolde i luften

Jobbet indebærer også arbejde på skæve tidspunkter og rejseaktivitet.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende dansk overenskomst for offentligt ansatte.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt. Stillingen skal besættes senest den 01.12.2026. Stillingen oprettes med forbehold for tildeling af budgetmidlerne.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes den 3. og 5.11.2026 på Regionskontor & Infocenter, Lyren 1, DK-6330 Padborg.

Region Sønderjylland-Schleswig

Peter Hansen

jobs.title: Er du den fagperson, man kan regne med, når det bliver komplekst?
jobs.description:
Hos MerCare søger vi erfarne socialfaglige vikarer, der vil mere end bare tage en vagt.

Hos MerCare leder vi ikke efter flest muligt.

Vi leder efter de rigtige.

Vi arbejder med socialfaglige opgaver, hvor relation, stabilitet og faglighed gør en reel forskel.

Vi ved, at det ikke er ligegyldigt, hvem der træder ind ad døren – hvad enten det er på et bosted, i en institution, på en specialskole eller i en familie, hvor der er brug for en ekstra voksen.

Derfor matcher vi ikke bare mennesker med ledige timer.

Vi matcher faglighed, erfaring og menneske med den konkrete opgave. Er du den fagperson

Hvem er du?
Du har erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område og ved, hvad det vil sige at være en del af en hverdag, hvor mennesker har brug for tydelige, stabile og fagligt stærke voksne.

Din erfaring kan fx være fra:
  • bosteder eller botilbud
  • institutioner
  • specialskoler
  • børne- og ungehjem
  • støtteopgaver i hjemmet
  • arbejde med børn, unge eller voksne med særlige behov

Du behøver ikke have prøvet alt.

Men du skal have faglig erfaring, dømmekraft og lyst til at gøre en forskel i praksis. Er du den fagperson

Det lægger vi vægt på
Hos MerCare leder vi efter medarbejdere, der:
  • kan skabe ro – også når situationen bliver presset
  • kan balancere relation og struktur
  • arbejder fagligt og reflekteret
  • tager ansvar for det, de siger ja til
  • kan samarbejde og indgå i en eksisterende praksis
  • møder mennesker med respekt og ordentlighed
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og søge sparring, når det er nødvendigt

Du skal ikke være perfekt.
Men du skal være ansvarlig. Er du den fagperson

Hvilke opgaver kan du få?
Vi matcher altid opgaven med den medarbejder, der har de rette kompetencer og den relevante erfaring.

Det kan blandt andet være:
  • støtte på bosteder, botilbud og institutioner
  • støtte i skole- og specialtilbud
  • 1:1-støtte i hjemmet, skolen eller fritiden
  • ledsagelse
  • aflastning i hjemmet
  • støtte omkring struktur og trivsel i hverdagen
  • længerevarende individuelle støtteforløb

Nogle opgaver kræver bred socialpædagogisk erfaring. Andre kræver en mere specialiseret profil.

Det er netop derfor, vi matcher grundigt. Er du den fagperson

Hos MerCare bliver du valgt til opgaven
Når du bliver en del af MerCare, bliver du ikke bare oprettet i et system og sendt videre.

Vi lærer dig at kende og spørger ind til din erfaring, dine kompetencer og de opgaver, du fungerer bedst i.

Vi tager kun nye medarbejdere ind, når vi kan se et fagligt og menneskeligt match.

For kvalitet må aldrig være tilfældig. Er du den fagperson

Det får du hos os
  • opgaver, der matcher din erfaring og dine kompetencer
  • tæt dialog og opfølgning
  • mulighed for både fleksible opgaver og længerevarende forløb
  • et bureau med rødder i socialpædagogisk praksis
  • mulighed for faglig udvikling og undervisning
  • en organisation, der tager ansvar, også når noget bliver svært Er du den fagperson

Praktisk information
  • Arbejdet foregår primært på Sjælland
  • Opgaver kan ligge dag, aften, nat og weekend
  • Relevant erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område er et krav
  • Straffe- og børneattest skal kunne godkendes
  • Relevante referencer indhentes inden opstart
  • Dokumentation for uddannelse og kvalifikationer skal foreligge Er du den fagperson

Lyder MerCare som et sted for dig?
Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, vi beskriver, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være den, der kan mest.

Det handler om at være den medarbejder, der passer til opgaven – og som vi trygt kan sende ud.

Vi matcher ikke bare opgaver.

Vi matcher mennesker. Er du den fagperson

MerCare
Skabt af praksis – båret af ansvar.
